title: #ET19A - Rotor System Design H225/H215 Work Package Manager (H/F)
description:
Job Description:
We are looking for a Rotor System Design Work Package Manager for H225/H215 joining the Rotor System Design team in Marignane.

Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters.

The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.

You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters.
To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane

Your future missions :

By joining our dynamic team, you will dive into the heart of helicopter performance. You will drive a variety of critical activities centered entirely on Rotor Systems of Super Puma to start : from pioneering designs evolution and managing change design activities including corrective measures following in service events, to providing hands-on technical support for manufacturing, assembly, the flight line, laboratories, and flight tests.
You will be part of an agile nWoW (new Way of Working) environment, operating within the Operational Squads and the MCT (Métier Core Team). You will join a diverse group of highly experienced experts who thrive on continuous improvement, knowledge exchange, and technical excellence in rotor dynamics.
As a Super Puma Work Package Manager at the core of the Rotor System Design team, you will coordinate an operational team of several dedicated specialists. You will be empowered to:
• Drive the team to deliver cutting-edge rotor products, systems, and services in strict alignment with the mission letter.
• Inspire team adherence to the mission, ensuring absolute clarity and focus at all times.
• Actively manage relationships and workload with key stakeholders and customers.
• Engage closely with the Metier to guarantee technical standards and methodologies.
• Lead and participate in sprint iterations, system reviews, demos, and retrospectives.
• Report strategic progress directly to Squad Leaders and the Head of Department.
• Manage our make or buy design activities

Your technical missions at the heart of Rotor Systems will include:
• Leading the design and redesign of complex Rotor Systems, driving detailed design phases while guaranteeing absolute compliance with safety, performance, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability requirements.
• Steering the substantiation process through rigorous analysis and active involvement in flight, ground, and bench tests (from request and preparation to real-time attendance and final conclusions).
• Producing critical technical documentation, including Permit to Fly documents, requiring direct and high-level technical discussions with EASA and other airworthiness authorities.
• Driving maintenance engineering through the creation, update, or extension of maintenance manuals for rotor components.
• Capitalizing on critical knowledge to secure the future of our rotor technologies.

As a central hub for rotor technology, your squad will constantly interface with:
• Key AH departments: Ground and Flight Tests, Material and Expertise Laboratories, Production Preparation, Loads, Thermal, and other critical systems (Blades, Flight Controls, Transmissions, Airframe, etc.).
• Purchasing, Support, Projects, and Program management.
• Various AH sites (Paris Le Bourget, Donauwörth).
• Subcontracting partners and global suppliers.

Depending on your expertise, you may be entrusted with the highly strategic role of TVE (Technical Verification Engineer). As a technical referent for Rotor Systems, you will hold the authority to validate critical deliverables, ensuring they perfectly align with our rigorous design rules and methodologies (HTECH technical reference).
This position could be the best start point for an experienced engineer to develop his knowledge before joining either enlarged management position or expert path.

Your profile:
• Educated to 5 years' degree level (or equivalent) in mechanical engineering
• Over 10 years of experience into Aeronautical industry and Engineering  
• Synthesis spirit, rigorous, product and operation oriented
• Good leadership according to Airbus leadership model
• Good communication skills and relationship, team spirit
• Language Skills: Advanced level in English and negotiation level in French

Any of the following skills & experience would be plus:
• More than 5 years of experience in AH design office
• Experience in certification
• Experience in leading and manageing
• Language skills: German  

3 Reasons to join us:

Our Values: Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family.

Inclusion and diversity: We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment, where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving.

Compensation and benefits:
At Airbus, we build the future together and your success is our priority.
Expect a global, competitive, and transparent compensation package (including salaries, bonuses, profit-sharing, participation, and preferred share ownership plan), designed to reward the impact and performance you bring, both individually and collectively.
We invest in your complete well-being: professional development (training, mentoring, international mobility), health coverage, retirement, and a commitment to a supported work-life balance (parental support, flexibility).

And for your daily life, benefits that make a difference:
• A dynamic CSE (Social and Economic Committee) offering many advantages (company restaurant, children's leisure center, associations and sports complex, travel allowances, etc.).

• Transport facilities: Take advantage of our company shuttles or the reimbursement of your annual transport pass.

Our recruitment process:
• Apply online.
• Analysis of your application by the recruitment department.
• Our positions require a security clearance, complete the questionnaire that will be sent to you.
• Conduct recruitment interviews: HR interview and technical interview with your future manager
• Receive the job offer!
Ready to take off? Give a new dimension to your career by applying online now!

description:
Job Description:
Rejoignez l'aventure Airbus Protect en tant qu'Ingénieur Safety Aéronautique !

Ce que nous vous proposons : 
Plongez au cœur de l’innovation et contribuez à façonner l’avenir des systèmes d’hélicoptères. En tant qu'Ingénieur Sûreté de Fonctionnement, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement et la certification des équipements essentiels à bord de nos hélicoptères.

Ce que vous ferez au quotidien :
• Pionnier de la Sécurité et Fiabilité: Vous mènerez des études approfondies de sûreté à travers tous les systèmes de nos hélicoptères. Votre expertise garantira que chaque composant est non seulement performant mais aussi robuste pour nos clients.

• Participation active au Design : En collaboration étroite avec nos équipes de conception, vous évaluerez et validerez les propositions de design, veillant à ce qu’elles répondent aux plus hauts standards de sécurité.

• Influenceur de l’Innovation : Votre voix comptera dans la définition des architectures des nouveaux développements. Vous jouerez un rôle déterminant pour assurer le succès des programmes futurs et renforcer la position d’Airbus comme leader mondial.

• Gardien de la Sécurité Opérationnelle : Vous devrez comprendre le contexte opérationnel avec les équipes navigantes et proposerez des recommandations pour le manuel de vol, assurant que nos hélicoptères offrent non seulement des performances exceptionnelles mais aussi une sécurité en vol inégalée.

• Ambassadeur de la Certification : En collaboration avec les autorités internationales (OCCAR, NAHEMA, EASA...), vous démontrerez que nos solutions respectent et dépassent les exigences réglementaires, ouvrant la voie à l'approbation des modifications.

• Partenaire Stratégique : Vous apporterez votre expertise pour soutenir la navigabilité et guider l’équipe projet dans ses choix de conception et ses stratégies de certification.

Le profil idéal pour nous rejoindre :
• Formation & Expertise : Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur en aéronautique ou équivalent, avec une solide première expérience en aéronautique. Une connaissance approfondie des systèmes d’hélicoptères sera un atout majeur.

• Compétences Techniques : Maîtrise des méthodologies et référentiels clés (CS 27 / 29.1309, ARP 4754A / 4761, PASA, FHA, PSSA/SSA) ainsi que des concepts de conception ou d'architecture de systèmes.

• Qualités Personnelles : Flexibilité, rigueur, esprit d'équipe et proactivité sont des qualités indispensables pour réussir dans ce rôle.

• Langues & Sécurité : Un niveau avancé en anglais est indispensable dans notre environnement. Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou une éligibilité à celle-ci.

Pourquoi choisir Airbus Protect ?
• Un Management Humain : Vous évoluerez dans un cadre de travail bienveillant où l'accompagnement et la proximité managériale sont au cœur de notre culture.

• Un Environnement Dynamique : Participez à des projets innovants dans un contexte où chaque jour apporte de nouveaux défis et opportunités.

• Une Carrière sur Mesure : Développez vos compétences avec un parcours de carrière personnalisé et un catalogue de formations complet.

• Une Communauté d’Experts : Rejoignez une équipe d'experts reconnus et échangez avec les meilleurs dans leur domaine.

• Un Engagement pour l'Avenir : Prenez part à des projets de responsabilité sociétale et contribuez à un avenir durable.

• Télétravail & Avantages : Profitez de la flexibilité du télétravail et de nombreux autres avantages que nous serons ravis de vous présenter lors de nos futurs échanges.

Envie de faire décoller votre carrière ? Rejoignez-nous et vivez l’aventure Airbus Protect !

description:
Job Description:
Intégré(e) au sein de l’équipe Electronic & Computers, vous interviendrez sur les activités SDR liées aux systèmes embarqués et aux architectures avioniques hélicoptères.

Missions/Tâches
• Rédiger et mettre à jour les spécifications équipement et documents d’interface (RS, IDD).

• Étudier et analyser le remplacement d’anciens équipements par des COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf), TSO (Technical Standard Order).

• Gestion du fournisseur sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement (qualité, coût, calendrier, documentation)

• Diriger les principales revues de développement et de qualification (KoM, PDR, CDR, PI, QR)

• Assurer l'interface entre le fournisseur et les spécialistes d'Airbus Helicopters (qualification environnementale, réseau électrique, sécurité et fiabilité, testabilité, achats, design assurance ....)

• Apporter un support aux activités de développement, intégration et vérification systèmes, support en service.

• Contribuer aux activités de certification pour les autorités de navigabilité (EASA, FAA, DGA, …) : Technical Note, Déclaration de Design & Performance, Demande d’essais sol/vol, etc..

• Participer aux activités de Change: 
• Réaliser des analyses d’impact suite au remplacement et modifications d’équipements dans les systèmes avioniques.

• Assurer le suivi des modifications techniques et des impacts sur les architectures avioniques.

Lieu du poste
• Poste basé à Marignane (13), France, au sein des équipes Airbus Protect intégrées à Airbus Helicopters.

• Travail en environnement international, avec interactions régulières avec les différents métiers avioniques.

Cette fonction nécessite de conjuguer expertise technique, rigueur méthodologique et aptitude à collaborer avec des partenaires variés dans un environnement multiculturel.

Expérience Requise
• Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’une université avec spécialisation en électronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaines associés.

• Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en aéronautique, électronique ou systèmes avioniques.

Compétences Techniques
• Connaissances solides en électronique, avionique et systèmes embarqués.

• Maîtrise de la rédaction de spécifications et des activités de Verification & Validation (V&V).

• Familiarité avec les processus et base de certification aéronautique (TN, DDPi, essais sol/vol, CS/FAR 29 etc.).

• Connaissance des normes de design aéronautique (DO160, DO254, DO178, …)

Soft Skills
• Esprit de synthèse et solides qualités rédactionnelles.

• Être ouvert aux changements et curieux d'apprendre de nouvelles méthodes et technologies

• Organisation, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion des activités.

• Collaboration, esprit d’équipe et aisance relationnelle dans un contexte multiculturel.

• Capacité à gérer plusieurs activités en parallèle et à prendre des décisions éclairées.

• Prêt à effectuer des voyages d'affaires occasionnels (nationaux et internationaux)

Niveau de Langue
• Français : C2 – Maîtrise

• Anglais : C1 – Avancé (capacité à travailler dans un environnement international)

description:

En tant Qualiticien, assurance qualité (Niveau Technicien) sur nos pièces critiques d'hélicoptères, vous êtes le garant de la sécurité et de la conformité de nos produits.

Positionné(e) stratégiquement entre le Bureau d'Études (DO) et l'Ingénierie de Production (PO), vous veillez à la bonne application des exigences de conception en atelier ainsi qu'à la traçabilité des évolutions en vous appuyant sur nos référentiels

title: #DIGITAL CAMPUS - Solution & Data Architect (d/f/m)
description:
Job Description:
Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Solution & Data Architect to join our Information Management department based in Marignane, France.
You will be part of a team developing advanced data architectures and enterprise analytics solutions for helicopter engineering and manufacturing. As part of the Data & Analytics Product & Service Line, you will be involved in defining technical designs, mapping data urbanization, and aligning IT capabilities with business strategy. Your primary purpose will be to balance emerging technology opportunities with operational business requirements, ensuring that all data-driven products comply with strict Enterprise Architecture guidelines and operate seamlessly across platforms.

Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters.

The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.

You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters.
To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane

Your future missions: 
• Design and deliver global IT architectures, system components, and detailed Data Designs—including Conceptual, Logical, Canonical, and Physical data models, naming conventions, and corporate data referentials—while producing project Architecture Requirement Documents (ARDs) and framing studies.

• Lead data urbanization mapping across the IT landscape to identify authoring systems, secure seamless data integration across applications and platforms, and define standard ingestion patterns for collecting, mapping, and storing Data & Analytics (D&A) data.

• Drive demand management by effectively evaluating and scoping business requests for IT capabilities, ensuring the long-term ICT roadmap for your customers directly aligns with business process optimization and organizational change management.

• Ensure technical consistency across IT products and internal technical practices, managing the complete architecture lifecycle, documenting design patterns, and proactively anticipating software or platform obsolescence topics.

• Bridge the gap between business needs and technology by showcasing new technological opportunities to stakeholders, advising teams on the standard catalog of IT products, and facilitating issue resolution and risk mitigation between business contributors and IT.

​
Your profile:
• Min. 5 to 8 years of professional experience in IT Architecture Design, Component Integration, IT Product Design, and Product Development.

• Deep technical expertise in advanced Data Modeling methodologies (Conceptual, Logical, Physical, EDS) and corporate data mapping utilizing enterprise tools such as SPARX EA.

• Hands-on proficiency within complex Data & Analytics environments and related platforms, specifically Skywise (Palantir Foundry), SAP BW/4, SAP HANA web apps/LABs, SAP Analytics Cloud, and TIBCO Spotfire.

• Strong professional capabilities in IT & Business Strategy Alignment, IT/Business Change Management, Business Plan Development, and Program/Project Portfolio Control.

• Advanced, professional proficiency in English, paired with strong technical facilitation skills to navigate cross-functional scoping and align international technical teams.

This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

3 Reasons to join us:

Our Values: Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family.

Inclusion and diversity: We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment, where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving.

Compensation and benefits:
At Airbus, we build the future together and your success is our priority.

Expect a global, competitive, and transparent compensation package (including salaries, bonuses, profit-sharing, participation, and preferred share ownership plan), designed to reward the impact and performance you bring, both individually and collectively.

We invest in your complete well-being: professional development (training, mentoring, international mobility), health coverage, retirement, and a commitment to a supported work-life balance (parental support, flexibility).

And for your daily life, benefits that make a difference:
• A dynamic CSE (Social and Economic Committee) offering many advantages (company restaurant, children's leisure center, associations and sports complex, travel allowances, etc.).

• Transport facilities: Take advantage of our company shuttles or the reimbursement of your annual transport pass.

​
Our recruitment process:
• Apply online.

• Analysis of your application by the recruitment department.

• Our positions require a security clearance, complete the questionnaire that will be sent to you.

• Conduct recruitment interviews: HR interview and technical interview with your future manager

• Receive the job offer!

title: #DIGITALCAMPUS Platform Engineer (Infrastructure & Automation)
description:
Job Description:
The Challenge
Airbus Helicopters is accelerating its transition towards a Software Defined Infrastructure. We are looking for an Infrastructure & Automation Engineer to join our Cloud & DevOps team. Your mission is to drive our automation vision, moving away from manual operations toward a fully automated, robust, and service-oriented ecosystem across Private, Public (AWS, GCP), and future Sovereign Cloud environments.
You will hold end-to-end accountability for our virtualization hosting infrastructures and our multi-cloud landing zones. You will not just manage infrastructures; you will design solutions and ensure their evolution to meet critical business, hosting and security requirements. You will also support specific infrastructure layers of our Resilience strategy, contributing to the automation of our recovery environments.

Your Key Responsibilities
• Eliminate Toil through Automation: Following core SRE principles, your primary mandate is to identify and eliminate "toil"—manual, repetitive labor that scales with system growth. You will be responsible for architecting this automation framework entirely from the ground up, starting from a blank slate and leveraging LEAN principles to drive maximum efficiency. You will prioritize high-impact engineering tasks that systematically reduce manual work and human error across our cloud ecosystems.

• Platform Engineering & GitOps Standardization: You will act as a Platform Engineer to define infrastructure deployment standards. You will establish automated infrastructure patterns using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and GitOps principles to ensure agility and total consistency across on-premise environments, Public Cloud (AWS, GCP), and upcoming Sovereign Cloud initiatives.

• Sovereign Cloud Integration: Participate in the design and technical onboarding of our future Sovereign/Trusted Cloud platform. You will ensure that automation standards (IaC, security scanning) are successfully ported to this highly secure environment to support military and restricted data workloads.

• Operational Excellence & Continuous Security Patching: Ensure the robustness, security, and compliance of IT assets. You will lead the continuous follow-up and automation of security patching across the infrastructure. You will steer hardware providers, manage asset lifecycles, and guarantee the completeness of technical information within the CMDB (ServiceNow).

• Support for Resilience & Recovery: Contribute to the technical implementation of specific infrastructure layers for the Isolated Recovery Environment (IRE). You will focus on the automation of virtual machine lifecycles and recovery workflows within the Zero-Trust vault to support the restoration of our Minimum Viable Company (MVC).

• Team Synergy : As a core member of the Cloud & DevOps team, you will work on Private, Public, and Sovereign Cloud topics, ensuring continuity of expertise within the team. You will align infrastructure automation with the DevOps mindset of the OCP (OpenShift) team, leveraging shared platforms to ensure cross-team consistency. You will work closely with and rely on subject matter experts from neighboring teams to deliver integrated, high-quality solutions.

Your Profile
• Experience: ~8-10 years in Infrastructure Engineering with a "Service" mindset and the ability to navigate complex, high-constraint environments.

• Technical Expertise:
• Virtualization: Mastery of Nutanix and VMware, knowledge of the other virtualization landscape options (OpenStack, OpenShift Virt).

• Automation: Proficiency in virtualization automation (Terraform, PowerCLI, Puppet, ARIA Automation, Ansible)

• DevOps : Proven experience with GitOps principles, IaC principles, and familiarity with Public ecosystems (AWS, GCP, and future trusted cloud initiatives)

• Containers: Understanding of container orchestration (Kubernetes)

• Observability & Lifecycle: Knowledge of monitoring tools (Zabbix, Dynatrace, Grafana) and management suites (SCCM, RedHat Satellite, ServiceNow).

• Hardware & Network : Understanding of enterprise servers, storage architectures (SAN/vSAN), network architectures (LAN/WAN)

• Mindset & Soft Skills: Service-oriented with a focus on quality and simplicity. You possess a strong team spirit, the ability to work autonomously in critical situations, and a solid understanding of the ITIL framework.

• Communication: Fluent in English and French. You are a results-oriented professional capable of challenging providers and providing clear support to internal teams. You will need to demonstrate strong negotiation and alignment skills to coordinate effectively with the wider Hosting & Cloud Services department, ensuring technical consistency and shared goals.

Why Join Us?
You will hold a strategic position where your technical impact and product vision are directly visible. This role offers the unique opportunity to manage the convergence between traditional infrastructure, public cloud, and the next generation of sovereign automation while protecting the digital sovereignty of Airbus Helicopters.

Ready to build and secure the future of flight? Apply now!

description:
Job Description:
Architecte systèmes (F/H)

Qui sommes-nous ?
Au sein du Airbus Helicopters Drone Center, né de la fusion entre Survey Copter et Airbus Helicopters, nous concevons, fabriquons et assurons le maintien en conditions opérationnelles de systèmes de drones tactiques légers, destinés à des missions militaires et civiles. Nous couvrons l’ensemble du cycle de vie de ces systèmes, offrant à chacun la possibilité de contribuer pleinement à des projets technologiques et concrets.

Filiale à 100% du groupe Airbus depuis 2011, elle est le centre d’expertise drones d’Airbus Helicopters, implantée à Pierrelatte (sa maison mère) et à Aix les Milles.

Nous rejoindre, c’est intégrer des sites à taille humaine et des équipes passionnées, tout en profitant d’un cadre de vie privilégié dans la Drome ou les Bouches du Rhône, territoires dynamiques et ensoleillés.

Pour en savoir plus sur nos produits UAS (Uncrewed Aerial Systems) :
https://www.airbus.com/en/products-services/defence/uas

Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble :
Sur notre site d’Aix en Provence, au sein du département du bureau d’études, vous aurez pour missions principales de :
• Recueillir les besoins des parties prenantes (Projets/Programmes, Support, utilisateurs finaux et clients)

• Définir les cas d'utilisation pour l'ensemble du système avionique

• Réaliser l'analyse fonctionnelle et définir l'architecture fonctionnelle (y compris les flux fonctionnels)

• Spécifier l'ensemble des exigences (fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles) allouées au système avionique

• Valider et décliner (cascader) l'ensemble des exigences avioniques vers les fonctions avioniques

• Définir toutes les interfaces externes de l'avionique

• Proposer la conception avionique la plus efficace, issue de compromis (trade-offs), basée sur les contraintes et critères d'influence (sécurité/disponibilité, conformité aux besoins clients, coût/masse/volume, réutilisation, concept de famille, stratégie industrielle/partenariats, etc.)

• Diriger les comités de tri (Filter Boards) au niveau avionique pour l'analyse des rapports de problèmes (faits techniques)

• Préparer les dossiers de justification technique pour la qualification/certification au niveau avionique — piloter l'activité de flight clearance

Vous serez également amenés à :
• Être l’interface avec la gestion de projet, les achats, le service commercial et les autres acteurs du projet au sein de l'organisation

• Etre support aux essais sur banc d'intégration, au sol et en vol du système

• Contribuer aux phases de faisabilité technique des projets, en menant des pré-études et en participant aux réunions clients ou fournisseurs

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d’être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 

Qui êtes-vous ?
De formation supérieure Bac+5 avec une spécialité ingénierie système, ingénierie aérospatiale ou domaine similaire, vous avez au moins 7 années d’expérience dans l’industrie.

Ce que l’on reconnait chez vous :
• Vos connaissances connaissance approfondies en conception, développement, ingénierie et/ou intégration de systèmes complexes pour aéronefs (incl. drones)

• Votre connaissance des normes d'analyse de sûreté de fonctionnement (type ARP4754)

• Vos connaissances en MBSE

• Votre anglais professionnel

• Votre capacité à interagir avec différentes équipes et à travailler de manière agile dans un environnement complexe

Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :
• Bien-être / santé : complémentaire santé et prévoyance santé / décès financées à hauteur de 100 % par Survey Copter, Team Building.

• Avantages financiers : accord d’intéressement, politique salariale annuelle, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, salaire sur 13 mois.

Horaire de travail : Forfait jours

Airbus Helicopters’ Software Products department is responsible for the development and integration of embedded software, implementing safety critical functionalities.
The department is involved in the development of in house solutions and is supporting the development of products developed by other internal entities or external suppliers, ensuring that the development processes follow the applicable guidelines (eg ED-12/DO-178) for civil certification.
In order to ensure this mission, we are looking for a database engineer, supporting in particular the management of system interfaces

Major economic hub with Marseille-Provence Airport, Marignane is a dynamic city in the southeast of France. It is located near the cities of Aix-en-Provence and Marseille, which host a rich cultural and tourist offer. Close to the beaches of the Côte Bleue, it offers many options for water sports activities.

How we care for you:
• Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.

• Work / Life Balance:  Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.

• Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.

• Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:

You will join a team working transversely on all helicopters developing interfaces on new or exiting systems for development.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to :
• Design our system database arhcitecture to ease integrations on our fleet, ensuring it allows to demonstrate compliance with applicable regurlations

• Organize the update, with system architects, of system interfaces to integrate new features in our products

• Organize the backlog of activities performed by partners

• Participate in the process improvement, in particular to facilitate continuous integration of embedded systems

• Perform the update asscoated with some features in the database

Your profile:

The ideal candidate has the following experience and skills:
• Educated to 5 years’ degree level (or equivalent) in computer science, electronics or related discipline.

• ability to manage software developments/database

• Strong experience on database management

• Experience with python or other scripting languages

• Experience with ED-12/DO-178,  DO-330 or D0-220 certification process. Other industries standards (e.g.: IEC 61508, ISO 26262, ..) may also be interresting

You are also an curious team player willing to challenge the status quo, and to develop and push innovative solution.

Other experience in related domains will also be appreciated.
This includes:
• Familiarity with model based development (e.g. Scade, Simulink)

• Familiarity with continuous integration processes and tools (e.g: Jenkins)

description:
Alan is looking for dedicated GPs in Belgium to help transform Healthcare together! 🌟




🐼 WHO WE ARE

Alan is not just a health insurance company; we are the health partner, dedicated to the physical and mental well-being of our members every day. Since our establishment in 2016 in France, we have expanded our services to three countries (🇫🇷, 🇧🇪, 🇪🇸) and proudly support more than 500,000 members.


Our innovative approach places equal emphasis on prevention and treatment, making healthcare more accessible and holistic.




🇧🇪 OUR SERVICES IN BELGIUM

Today we offer two services in Belgium for which we are looking for motivated family physicians:

 - Teleconsultations: Connect with our members via video call and offer medical advice from the comfort of your own home or practice. 

 - Medical Chat: Engage with our members via our medical chat service, available 7 days a week, from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. You will provide fast, accurate and personalized medical advice within a 4-hour response time. So our members get the advice, when and where they need it.

GPs can apply for either service. It is not necessary to do both.




⭐ WHY WORK FOR ALAN?

 - Innovative Healthcare: Be at the forefront of healthcare innovation, making healthcare more accessible and working with cutting-edge technologies.

 - Professional growth : discover new and innovative ways to help your patients

 - Online & Flexible Terms: Enjoy the flexibility to work from the comfort of your own home or practice, with a schedule that fits your needs as a primary care physician. A perfect complement to your existing practice!

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive and market based compensation.

 - Team of healthcare professionals: Join our dedicated team of healthcare professionals..




🤩 REQUIREMENTS

 - Certified General Practitioner: with a 003 or 004 RIZIV/INAMI number and experience in patient care.

 - Language Skills: Proficiency in Dutch required + either English or French

 - Digital Skills: Familiar with the use of digital tools.

 - Empathy & Communication: Excellent communication skills and strong empathetic approach to patient care.

 - Licensed Software: Must possess licensed prescription and attestation software.





OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS


The recruitment process consists of two stages. Each stage will provide an opportunity for you to ask questions as we want to ensure the best fit for both you and Alan.

The first interview will be with the Health Professional team coordinator at Alan, and will last approximately 30 minutes. The purpose is to get to know each other, clarify the project, and determine if your profile aligns with our needs.

The second interview (~45 minutes) will be with our Medical Lead (General Practitioner). The goal is to discuss a clinical case, and your clinical experiences and knowledge.

title: CTO Founder Associate - internship
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ CTO FOUNDER ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐

The position is open for an immediate starting date, for a six-month internship.

CTO Founder Associates support the CTO and Senior Alaners on top business priorities, such as unlocking new growth, driving alignment on strategy and building new processes/standards internally and externally. It is a unique chance to work on many tasks in a different and non traditional environment.


You will be highly involved in key challenges for Alan, and will be asked to support high added value tasks for Alan.


 
⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

As such, you can’t be exhaustive on the missions you will perform as a CTO FA, as you can be asked to help on almost any subject.

title: Opticien (contrat freelance) 🇫🇷
description:
🐼 Qui est Alan ?

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

L'optique est au cœur de la promesse d’Alan "La santé ne peut pas attendre". Avec l'Alan Shop, nos membres achètent lunettes et lentilles de contact depuis l'application ; avec notre réseau d'opticiens partenaires, ils sont mieux remboursés en magasin ; et nos équipes Fraude veillent à ce que chaque euro remboursé le soit à bon escient. 

Nous avons prouvé qu'une assurance santé pouvait vendre de l'optique en ligne. Nous voulons maintenant passer à l'échelle, avec un·e opticien·ne supplémentaire dans l'équipe.


👓 Ce que nous recherchons
Ce opticien·ne diplômé·e, à l'aise avec le conseil à distance et motivé·e pour rejoindre l'équipe d'opticiens prenant en charge les différentes missions autours de l'optique d'Alan Shop.



Les missions :

 - Chat optique. Répondre à nos membres sur l'application (choix de monture, lecture d'ordonnance, verres, lentilles, questions d'optique au sens large), avec le ton Alan : clair, bienveillant, personnalisé.

 - Validation des commandes de lentilles de contact. Contrôler les ordonnances que notre outil automatique ne peut pas valider, et signaler les suspicions de fraude (dates modifiées, documents falsifiés) à notre équipe dédiée.

 - « Mon Opticien au Travail ». Animer des journées de conseil et de vente sur site chez nos entreprises clientes, sur la France entière et en priorité en Île-de-France : accueil des salariés, conseil visagiste, prise de mesures, aide au choix de la monture.

 - Amélioration continue. Partager vos retours terrain pour faire évoluer le service, et potentiellement être investi de potentielles missions additionnelles comme :
   
   - contribuer à la montée en puissance de Mo, notre compagnon santé IA, sur les questions d'optique simples
   
   - étoffer le catalogue de montures de l’Alan Shop en collaboration avec le Marketing pour créer les collections
   
   - accompagner la mise à l’échelle et les mises à jour du réseau Alan Optique notamment sur les mises à jour des grilles tarifaires
   
   - améliorer les journées “Mon Opticien au Travail” avec l’équipe commerciale pour maximiser la satisfaction, l’expérience et la conversion de ces évènements.
     
     

⭐️ Le profil
Est-ce que vous vous reconnaissez ?

 - ✅ Diplôme d'opticien·ne lunetier·ère (BTS Opticien Lunetier ou équivalent) — indispensable, avec numéro d'inscription à jour.

 - ✅ Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en magasin, idéalement avec une forte dimension conseil et style (visagisme, colorimétrie : un vrai plus).

 - ✅ Maîtrise des lentilles de contact et de la lecture d'ordonnances, y compris les cas complexes (toriques, multifocales).

 - ✅ Basé·e à Paris ou en Île-de-France, disponible pour des journées sur site.

 - ✅ Disponible sur des horaires flexibles, y compris le soir ou le weekend pour le chat, avec de la souplesse pour absorber des pics.

 - ✅ À l'aise avec les outils digitaux ; curieux·se d'une pratique de l'optique en ligne et enthousiaste à l'idée d'intégrer l'IA dans son quotidien.

 - ✅ Excellente expression écrite en français ; l'anglais est un plus.

 - ✅ Statut indépendant (micro-entreprise ou société), ou prêt·e à le créer.
   
   

🙌  Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?

 - 💰 Des conditions claires.
   
   - 25 € hors taxes de l'heure du lundi au samedi, 30 € hors taxes de l'heure le dimanche, facturés mensuellement sur la base des créneaux que vous déclarez. 
   
   - Les journées « Mon Opticien au Travail » sont rémunérées à la journée (de l'ordre de 500 à 750 € hors taxes selon le format), frais de déplacement et d'hébergement pris en charge.

 - 🕐 Une vraie flexibilité. Vous choisissez vos créneaux de chat en concertation avec l'équipe.

 - 🤝 Une petite équipe d'opticiens avec qui échanger sur les cas complexes, et une interlocutrice unique côté Alan.

 - 🚀 Un service en construction. Vous participez à la façon dont une assurance santé fait de l'optique en ligne et hors ligne : catalogue, parcours, nouveaux formats d'événements, place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soins. Chez Alan, les opticiens sont au cœur de ces réflexions et contribuent à faire évoluer les pratiques.

title: Médecin du travail
description:
🐼 POURQUOI PRÉVENIR

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici https://prevenir.fr/carrieres




🩺 LE POSTE, CONCRÈTEMENT

Vous êtes médecin du travail référent sur un portefeuille d'entreprises adhérentes, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes: 

 - Coordonner les trois missions des SPSTI (suivi individuel, action en milieu de travail, prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle) sur votre périmètre d'entreprises adhérentes, avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire que vous animez : IDEST, ASST, IPRP

 - Innovation et amélioration continue: test et déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques en santé au travail, optimisation des protocoles, collaboration avec les équipes de développement, etc.

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

 - Une délégation réelle. L'équipe pluridisciplinaire et les IDEST prennent en charge ce qui peut l'être. Vous concentrez votre temps médical là où il a le plus d'impact.

 - La téléconsultation à la demande du salarié, intégrée à votre pratique quand elle est cliniquement pertinente.

 - Des outils numériques co-construits en fonction de vos attentes. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les médecins les outils dont ils ont besoin — DMST, parcours de prévention, assistance à la rédaction de fiche d'entreprises, etc. 




👤 LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Indispensable :

 - Doctorat en médecine + DES ou CES de médecine du travail

 - Inscription à l'Ordre

Idéalement :

 - Goût pour le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et la délégation 

 - Curiosité pour les outils numériques et l'IA appliqués à la pratique médicale

 - Capacité à construire une relation de confiance avec salariés et adhérents

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même. Médecins en reconversion, jeunes diplômé·es, profils internationaux... n'hésitez pas à nous contacter !




💚 CE QU'ON OFFRE

 - Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

 - Rémunération selon profil, transparente et benchmarkée

 - Plan d'intéressement

 - Temps plein ou temps partiel (à discuter)

 - RTT

 - Prise en charge du transport quotidien

 - Restaurant d'entreprise

 - Formation linguistique offerte

 - Événements d'équipe réguliers

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time

Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality




 💡 THE MISSIONS


Alan has grown to nearly 900 Alaners, with close to 300 hires completed in H1 2026 alone. 

The Workplace team is the engine behind the experience Alaners have every day — from their first day to the daily rhythm of office life. As the company scales, we need to scale with it and enhancing Alaners' experience wherever they work from, whether through the operational backbone of the office (vendors, procurement, RSE).

The role will be affected to a single contract: Workplace Experience. 

While this profile comes with a clear focus area from the start, scopes are designed to evolve within the team, giving real room to grow over time.

The positions is based in Paris and require an onsite presence at least 4 days per week.

 

Detailed missions 

 - Lead and support projects for the long-term improvement of our work environment as we grow

 - Contribute to Alan's growth through building and running scalable processes and documentation, leveraging data, AI and automation

 - Manage external providers and stakeholders: contractualization, invoicing, performance monitoring, tenders

 - Create and maintain secure, safe and comfortable work environments for all Alaners, in line with our Healthy Business positioning

 - Interact daily with cross-functional teams:
   
   - People — culture, onboarding and offboarding, perks, analytics, labor law
   
   - IT — facilities, network, room equipment, process automation, analytics
   
   - Security — office and work environment safety policies, crisis reaction
   
   - Finance — budget monitoring, taxes, invoicing, cost optimization
   
   - Legal — compliance, agreements

 - Contribute to the "on-call" rotation (daily run Office Management tasks)




👀 MORE SPECIFICITIES ON THE PROFILE WE'RE LOOKING FOR (LEVEL RANGE TARGETED ON OUR LEVEL GRID: B0-B1)




Specific missions

 - Run day-to-day office operations at Valmy — our Paris HQ: office tours, maintenance follow-up, supply and equipment management

 - Manage and challenge the full vendor portfolio: onboarding, performance monitoring, contract tracking, invoicing, RFPs

 - Own office procurement: purchases, budget tracking, cost optimization, reporting

 - Lead Alan's RSE (Corporate Social Responsibility) approach: audit current practices, benchmark comparable organizations, build a prioritized action plan and drive concrete initiatives

 - Office operations at Valmy are running smoothly and reliably — daily rounds, maintenance follow-up and supply management are handled with no recurring gaps

 - Vendor portfolio is documented and tracked: contracts, invoices and performance are monitored consistently

 - Led at least two vendor reviews or benchmarking processes, produced clear findings and took corresponding decisions autonomously

 - Led an RSE audit: assessed what exists at Alan, benchmarked comparable organizations, proposed a realistic and prioritized action plan, and launched at least 2 concrete actions

 - Automated at least 3 manual or recurring tasks

🚀 WHY JOIN CARE OPS IN 2026? 🚀

You might look at Alan’s Care team today—managing high volumes seamlessly, supported by strong partners, and automating 50 of conversations—and ask: "It works, so why join now?"

Yet, the most exciting part is still ahead. We are at a turning point as we prepare to support millions of members and push to set the standards in the industry.

Here is why this is the moment to join.

 - People: This is the opportunity to join a team with incredibly high talent density, operating with distributed ownership—empowered Crew Leads, strong deputies, and Guillaume Poirier https://www.linkedin.com/in/guillaume-p-34602923/ as Care Ops Lead. It is a proven engine for creating talent and fueling internal mobility.

 - Processes: We absorb high volumes without glitches (including Ministry of Finance in France) and collaborate smoothly with Product and Sales. We trust and work hand-in-hand with solid external partners in France and Spain.

 - Innovation: We are one of the few companies in the world claiming to automate 40% of member conversations as of the end of 2025 (a true market benchmark).

We're building an organization capable of serving 3 million members with a lean team. To get there, we need people who can build scalable systems (analytical and operational) that make this possible.

What this means for the role you're joining:

 - Our operations are getting smarter, and our analytics need to keep up: We don't just need dashboards. We need to understand what drives performance, spot problems early, and help teams decide faster. You'll build this.

 - Our planning is getting more complex: More countries, more automation, more partner teams. We need better models to know how many people we need, where, and when.

 - Our tools need to scale: What works with manual effort today won't work at 3x the volume. You'll build AI-powered tools and workflows that make operations smoother across the board.

Recognition: We are building something unique, yet we are not yet known externally as the reference for Care operations.




⭐ THE CARE OPS ROLE ⭐

The Care Ops team supports the Care Community globally (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) by providing tools, processes, and data to deliver on our Roadmap and Strategic Plan. Care Ops is accountable for operational excellence and efficiency in Care, enabling the Community to scale without any compromise on user experience.

We are looking for a Care Ops who loves numbers, builds tools, and wants to have a real impact on how we run operations at scale.

You'll join a team of 10 and work across the full spectrum of our operations: understanding what drives our performance, building the tools and models that help us make better decisions, and collaborating daily with Data, Engineering, Product, and Care teams.

One week you'll be deep in a staffing model, the next you'll be building an AI-powered reporting tool, the next you'll be presenting a performance deep dive to Crew Leads.

Some of our missions include:

1/ Performance analytics and operational insights

 - Build and improve dashboards and reports that help teams understand what's happening and why. Not just track numbers — explain them.

 - Conduct deep dives into operational performance (response times, resolution quality, contact drivers) and deliver concrete recommendations.

 - Help define and maintain our key metrics across countries: what do we measure, where does the data live, how do we make it reliable.

 - Work closely with our Data team and Care Crew Leads to turn data into decisions.

2/ Planning, forecasting, and resource optimization

 - Help build and improve our staffing models: how many people do we need, when, and where? How does automation change the equation?

 - Contribute to simplifying our planning tools and processes

 - Work with our external partners on capacity planning and delivery tracking.

 - Challenge how we do things today.

3/ Tooling and AI

 - Build and improve operational tools using AI and no-code solutions (Dust, Claude, automation platforms). You'll probably build half your tools with AI.

 - Identify where current processes don't scale and propose solutions — sometimes a simple script, sometimes a product need.

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering crews to push efficiency needs into the roadmap.


⭐ JOIN THE CARE TEAM! ⭐️

You will excel as a Care Ops if you:

 - Communicate clearly in English and French, written and verbal. You'll work with many teams and clarity matters.

 - Think in numbers. You're comfortable with data, spreadsheets, and ideally SQL. You build models, not just read dashboards.

 - Have a performance mindset. You want to understand why a metric moves. You look for root causes and push for action.

 - Are curious about AI and tooling. You use AI tools in your daily work and see them as building blocks. You're excited to learn and experiment.

 - Get your hands dirty. You dig into the details, fix what's broken, and don't wait for someone else to do it.

 - Have 2-5 years of experience in operations, analytics, consulting, or a similar role — ideally in a tech or startup environment.

 - Have an organized and structured mindset.

 - Can work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Our ideal candidate thrives in a startup or tech company environment and is excited about the opportunity to make a significant impact in a growing company. If this sounds like you, then you might just be the Care Ops we're looking for.

In Alan's early expansion https://medium.com/alan/an-unexpected-journey-the-tale-of-the-backend-architecture-at-alan-ac8c5382df60, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024 https://medium.com/alan/engineering-challenges-at-alan-in-2024-686688f6b89d, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy https://medium.com/alan/alans-2025-technical-strategy-building-tomorrow-s-stack-today-a070bcb345a6.

 - Design Cross-Cutting Modules You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features

 - Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business

 - Orchestrate Data Transformations You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas

 - Build and Own What You Create You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create

 - Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams

 - Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles

 - Learn and Share Globalization Patterns As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work

 - You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design

 - You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries

 - You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them

 - You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles

 - You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.

description:
🤖 WHO WE ARE

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.




🚀 WHAT KEEPS US UP AT NIGHT

We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world, while delivering an outstanding conversational experience. Things we’re working on:

 - 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question. It means having a world-class snappy and delightful chatting experience, blazing fast time to answer, and rich content shared.

 - 🧱 Integrate Mo with Alan services and our healthcare system — You’ll work on integrating Mo with our other services (digital chat with HP, map of physical location of HPs, tailored prevention programs, …) to help members get from words to actions.

 - ➕ Extend our architecture to support the next chapters of Mo — You’ll work on our architecture, and agentic framework, to support Mo’s next needs (get more context, use new skills, be accessible in other countries we operate in)



If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. If you’re curious, here https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12808 is a paper we published recently.


 


🎯 IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

Alan is scaling internationally (900+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Operations Specialists to own device security, SaaS platforms, identity & access, and the daily IT experience of every Alaner, while contributing to build projects that remove operational toil.

IT at Alan is more than just a helpdesk. Operations and support ('Run') take roughly 60% of your time initially, while the rest goes toward owning project-based initiatives ('Build') tailored to your experience level. 
As you ramp up alongside senior engineers, your focus will naturally shift toward more build-focused work with wider impact.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. We staff people according to their strengths and interests, and it evolves over time.



SCOPE


🛟 SUPPORT & ONCALL

 - Own L1/L2 oncall for 900+ Alaners across 5+ countries, with a clear escalation path to engineers

 - Triage, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately

 - Document recurring issues and reduce ticket volume through self-service


💻 DEVICE LIFECYCLE & ENDPOINT COMPLIANCE

 - Own the full device lifecycle: procurement, zero-touch enrollment (Apple Business Manager, Kandji), repair, retrieval

 - Maintain role-based Kandji blueprints and least-privilege configurations

 - Contribute to device compliance across all countries (MDM, EDR, FileVault) and to audit evidence

 - Own the physical side: laptop locker, hardware inventory, office equipment

 - Take over day-to-day device operations as we bring them back in-house from our outsourced provider


🔑 IDENTITY, ACCESS & SAAS PLATFORMS

 - Own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end, across both automated and manually-managed tools

 - Administer Google Workspace, SSO/SAML, licences and access reviews

 - Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and procurement on your scope


⚙️ BUILD

 - Own a build project end-to-end, with a more experienced engineer to pair with and learn from

 - Examples from the current roadmap: rebuilding the onboarding intake, the meeting room audiovisual equipment and room-booking revamp, the IT playbook for new offices, ISO 27001 / ACPR evidence collection

 - Ship automation and self-service tooling that measurably reduces IT toil


MILESTONES

First 2 months

 - Join IT oncall rotation (helpdesk) with buddy/shadowing support

 - Discover Alan's processes, stack (Kandji, Apple Business Manager), SaaS ecosystem, and identity tools (Google Workspace, SSO, Alan Home)

 - Handle most typical IT operations issues autonomously (equipment, SaaS access, account provisioning)

First 6 months

 - Handle IT oncall shifts autonomously, solving most problems that do not require engineer input

 - Own onboarding/offboarding workflows end-to-end

 - Have wide knowledge of Alan's processes, equipment, and tools

 - Ship a first project

First year

 - Be regarded as an expert on at least one topic beyond the oncall rotation (e.g. MDM, SaaS admin, compliance documentation)

 - Contribute on device compliance improvements (MDM, EDR, FileVault) across all countries

 - Ship automation or self-service projects that measurably reduce IT toil, with limited guidance

 - Lead small to medium IT projects end-to-end

3 years

 - Fully autonomous on the User Experience & Platform workstreams

 - Lead medium to high-complexity IT projects end-to-end

 - Mentor newer team members, reduce bus factor through documentation, automation and knowledge sharing


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

 - 1-3 years in IT operations (or strong internship / student association background in a tech environment): device management (MDM, ideally Kandji), SaaS administration, basic identity & access management (Google Workspace, SSO)

 - Operational reflexes: can triage issues, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately. Has oncall or production support experience

 - Automation & AI appetite: scripting basics (Python, Bash) or low-code, and an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

 - Documentation mindset: writes clear, structured documentation

 - Learning velocity: Picks up new tools and processes quickly.

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

 - Written-First Communication: Clear, effective written communicator who instinctively documents workflows, shares knowledge transparently, and thrives in an asynchronous work culture.

 - Empathetic Problem-Solving: Balanced user-first service mindset with operational pragmatism—delighting colleagues while diagnosing root causes rather than applying band-aid fixes.

 - Autonomous Growth: Self-directed problem solver who takes early project ownership, learns rapidly alongside senior engineers, and actively seeks feedback to level up.

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

 - macOS fluency: comfortable troubleshooting macOS, understands the Apple ecosystem (Apple Business Manager, DEP enrollment)

 - Experience with Kandji specifically

 - Exposure to security compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS), even just awareness

 - SaaS vendor management and/or license administration

 - Interest in automation and coding (even from college/school projects)

 - Experience in a fast-growing, multi-country tech company

Languages: Fluent French & Professional English

🛠️ THE STACK

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.




🤖 THE INFRA CREW - WITHIN THE TECH FOUNDATIONS AREA

🎯 Mission:

 - Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

 - Infra - is one of its crews. Its mission: operate and evolve the foundations Alan runs on (multi-cloud infrastructure, data platforms, observability, and the operational practices around them) so that product crews ship safely and quickly, members never feel the platform underneath, and the business can expand to new countries without re-inventing how we run.

🔭 Scope:

 1. Cloud foundations & multi-cloud architecture: own and evolve Alan’s cloud footprint, Infrastructure-as-Code stack (Terraform, Terramate), and the architectural decisions enabling international expansion.

 2. Data & application platforms: operate and evolve the foundations product crews build on: PostgreSQL/Aurora, our events pipeline, async workloads, and database migration tooling, without leaking complexity into product code.

 3. Reliability, observability & on-call: own Alan's platform uptime and latency SLOs end-to-end. Evolve our observability stack (Datadog), the incident response process (Incident.io http://Incident.io), and the shared on-call rotation across the area to keep it sustainable as we scale.

 4. Governance & compliance enablement and FinOps: own the cross-cutting concerns no single domain holds, infrastructure cost (FinOps), IAM posture, backup and disaster recovery, exit strategy, with automation and reporting that scales beyond the crew.

 5. AI-augmented infrastructure operations: make AI assistants a first-class citizen for incident investigation, runbook execution, and toil reduction, so engineers spend their time on high-leverage work.

👀 Focus for 2026:

 - Multi-cloud expansion: revisit our cloud strategy as we go international, and launch new geographies.

 - Decoupling for scale: evolve service architecture to carry Alan 2.0 from 1M members today to 10M.

 - Operational excellence: raise the quality bar end-to-end by overhauling observability, on-call, and cost management practices.

 - AI-augmented infra ops: make AI assistants a first-class part of investigation, troubleshooting, and toil reduction, so engineers spend time where leverage is highest.

 - You have touched observability, monitoring, alerting or incident management tools and practices.

 - You are able to design and implement robust infrastructure systems with a focus on reliability and observability.

 - You can maintain our uptime targets while optimizing infrastructure costs.

 - You’ve built and maintained internal or external tooling (e.g. API, web interface, internal command line, configuration as code, etc) for other engineers.


MINDSET WE VALUE

   - You will support the identification and hiring of new talents for the team.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




⭐️ THE ROLE: PRODUCT LEAD, GROWTH ⭐️


We are looking for a proven product leader to lead the next phase of Alan’s growth.


Our self-serve business now brings in €1M of incremental ARR every week. We got there with a funnel that was ahead of the market for years, built for health insurance, one country and one way of buying. 

That playbook will not get us to the next 10x. Alan is moving to many products, many countries and new segments, and prospects are starting to buy through AI assistants. We need someone who has scaled growth before to write the next playbook and lead the product team that delivers it.

About the Growth area

The Growth area owns Alan’s self-serve business: every member and company that signs up without a sales account executive.

 - It covers individuals (freelancers, retirees, etc) and small companies.

 - It covers everything that happens before someone becomes a member: how prospects find Alan, how they decide we are right for them, and how they start.

 - On the go-to-market side, segment leaders own offer, pricing and channels for their segments, and marketing teams run paid, SEO / GEO, partnerships, brand and more.

 - On the product side, product crews build. Conversion owns the flows and referral surfaces that turn prospects into members. Growth Infrastructure owns the website, marketing measurement and marketing ops.
   

As Product Lead for Growth, you will lead the product side of the area and partner with our business and marketing leaders to accelerate growth.

A subset of hard questions to answer:

 - One funnel to many: how do we make launching a new funnel for a new product, country or partner as easy as writing a prompt? How do we empower business owners to iterate on the conversion flows?

 - Experience before signing: how does a prospect get to try Mo, the Clinic and the Shop before signing, without slowing down their decision?

 - The comparison moment: how do we become the place people compare insurance on fit and value, when comparison sites rank only on price?

 - Buying through AI: when the journey starts in ChatGPT, how do we become the answer it cites, and the product people can buy right there?

 - Channel leverage: how do we use technology to make each acquisition channel faster, cheaper and smarter, and how do we decide spend on incrementality?

 - Cross-sell at acquisition: how do we sell more than one product from the first signature?

We have strong convictions on some of these and open questions on others. We expect you to bring your own view and to change ours.




What you will do:

 - Set the vision. You will own the multi-year growth product vision, turn it into a small number of big bets, and align the roadmaps behind them. You will also decide what we stop doing, so that we both invest in incremental optimization and big bets.

 - Build an experimentation engine that compounds. We have a baseline of A/B testing and a shared bar for what counts as a win. You will take it to the level covering velocity, rigor, incrementality and learning loops.

 - Make Growth AI-native. You will lead conversational AI in our sales flows, AI-native acquisition surfaces and Alan’s presence in LLM ecosystems. You will also build the AI tooling our marketing teams need to scale their output (content, landing pages, campaigns, lead qualification) without scaling headcount at the same rate.

 - Lead and grow the team. You will manage the PMs in the area and help lead Design, Engineering and Data in the area.

 - Go deep yourself. At Alan, everyone is also an individual contributor, and AI makes that more true every month. We expect you to personally drive selected initiatives to kickstart or unblock them.

 - Partner with business leaders. You will work with segment leaders and marketing as a peer, and you will own growth outcomes jointly with them.

 

⭐️ ABOUT YOU ⭐️

 - You have 6+ years of experience leading product teams, with a track record of moving the numbers at scale. You have led growth for a product with significant self-serve or B2C acquisition, and you can point to the curves you bent.

 - You have led growth teams. You have managed PMs directly and you have handled hiring, coaching, hard feedback and performance calls.

 - You set the vision. You have a track record of setting the direction and balancing optimizations and big bets. You have brought business, marketing and engineering leaders along with you.

 - You coach. People you hired and coached have grown into strong PMs and leaders, and you raise the craft bar of the people around you.

 - You deep dive. You open the funnel analysis yourself, challenge an experiment read, question attribution and spot a vanity win before anyone else.

 - You are data-driven. Experimentation, incrementality and attribution are your native language, and you can push a data team to a high standard.

 - You have worked across a portfolio of products and countries, ideally by building shared platforms rather than one-off flows. This is a strong plus.

 - You have an opinionated view of where AI is taking acquisition and buying journeys (LLM discovery, conversational selling, agentic commerce), and you have turned that kind of view into shipped product.

 - You talk to prospects and members often, you enjoy it, and what you hear changes your mind.

 - You care about healthcare. Alan’s mission has to matter to you, and for us this is essential.

 - You are fluent in English. French is a nice-to-have.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F or higher level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

 - Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

 - Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

 - Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

 - Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A




⭐️ YOUR MISSION ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production.  This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

 - Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

 - Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

 


⭐️ WHAT YOU WILL DO ⭐️

 - Month-end close: own the end-to-end closing cycle across multiple legal entities; push pre-formatted journal entries into NetSuite, ensure completeness and accuracy, and deliver on schedule every month (target: J+5)

 - Accounting review: perform a thorough first-level review of balance sheet and P&L accounts at each close; identify unusual movements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure the overall reliability of the financial statements; build processes (routines, verification files, control procedures)

 - Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

 - Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

 - Tax and statutory compliance: prepare and file VAT returns, URSSAF declarations, and other statutory filings accurately and on time; coordinate with external advisors where needed




⭐️ QUALIFICATIONS ⭐️

Experience and technical skills

 - 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

 - Languages: full fluency in French and English

 - Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

 - Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

 - Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

 - Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); familiarity with modern accounting tools (Pennylane, Payflows, etc.) is a plus

 

Mindset and soft skills

 - Reliable and detail-oriented: you deliver on time, every time, and keep a clean audit trail

 - Autonomous and self-directed: you don't wait to be told what to do next; you manage your priorities, make decisions independently, and know how to take a step back to distinguish what truly matters from day-to-day noise

 - Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

 - Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

 - Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate
