Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


MISSION

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to one day a week on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.



SCOPE


⚙️ PLATFORM & AUTOMATION

 - Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

 - Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

 - Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices


🔑 IDENTITY & ACCESS

 - Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

 - Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

 - Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

 - Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

 - Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack


🔒 ENDPOINT & SAAS SECURITY

 - Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

 - Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

 - Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope


🩺 HEALTH PROFESSIONALS IT

 - The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

 - Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process


🌍 INTERNATIONALISATION

 - Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

 - Bring acquired entities onto that same platform


MILESTONES

First 3 months

 - Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

 - Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

 - Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

 - Own a workstream end-to-end

 - Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

 - Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

 - Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

 - Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

 - Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

 - Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

 - Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

 - Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

 - Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

 - Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

 - 3+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

 - Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

 - You write code: not as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

 - Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

 - Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

 - Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

 - Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

 - Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

 - Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

 - Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

 - Kandji or another MDM at scale

 - Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

 - Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

 - Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

 - Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

 - Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

⭐️ THE USER RESEARCHER ROLE ⭐️

At Alan, research is not a checkpoint. It's a compass. Our User Research team sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, making sure every decision is grounded in what our members actually need, feel, and experience.

As a User Researcher at Alan, you will gather and prioritize the most important questions from across the company, and design the right research to answer them. That means running interviews, diary studies, surveys, and usability sessions throughout the full product cycle, not just at the end. You'll then turn those findings into insights that are clear, compelling, and genuinely useful to the teams who need them.

You'll work hand in hand with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and collaborate closely with our analytics and data science teams to tell a complete story about our product. You'll also help grow research culture across Alan, sharing your craft and mentoring teammates along the way.

At Alan, great research drives great product. If you love figuring out what people truly need and translating that into decisions that matter, this role is for you.




⭐️ IF YOU HAVE SOME OF THE FOLLOWING, YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT ⭐️



You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

 - 4+ years of experience as a product/user researcher in a tech environment, with strong hands-on expertise in qualitative methods: interviews, diary studies, think-aloud usability testing, and direct observation

 - Solid quantitative research skills: you're comfortable with survey design, sampling, crosstabs, and core statistical concepts

 - Sharp critical thinking: you quickly identify what research is worth doing, scope it efficiently, and deliver insights that are focused and actionable

 - A strategic mindset: you know how to partner with product stakeholders, communicate the value of research, and tie your findings to concrete business impact

 - Compelling communication skills: you turn complex findings into clear narratives that resonate with any audience

 - Experience mentoring junior researchers or non-researchers, with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback that helps others grow

 - You're close to AI. Either you've built AI products, or you follow the space closely and have a clear view on where to leverage and how LLM systems behave in production.

 - You care about healthcare. Alan's mission has to genuinely matter to you. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.

 - English fluency, written and spoken

 - (As a plus) Fluency in French, Spanish, or another European language

For this role, we hire within the D-E level range.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Sénégal 🇸🇳
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Founded in Senegal in 2022, Tanel is the first digital health insurer in French-speaking West Africa. It operates in Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire, transforming a market dominated by paper-based processes and fragmented legacy players.

With more than 30,000 members, a network of over 1,200 healthcare providers and more than 400 pharmacies, as well as revenue that grew sevenfold in 2025, Tanel has demonstrated strong product-market fit in countries that were ready for a revolution in healthcare insurance.

In 2026, Alan, the European leader in prevention-focused health insurance, acquired Tanel to accelerate its expansion across the African continent. Alan serves more than one million members across France, Belgium, Spain and Canada, and generates more than €950 million in revenue.

Together, we are building the leading health insurance company in French-speaking West Africa, with the ambition of reaching $200 million in revenue by 2030.




THE BEST OF BOTH WORLDS

We bring together the best of both organisations: Tanel’s deep understanding of the local market, strong local relationships and trusted reputation, alongside Alan’s leading technology platform, actuarial expertise and experience operating across multiple countries.




⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

Within our Engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces and applications that allow us to deliver a first-class service to our members, healthcare providers and internal teams.

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a strong connection to product.

We move quickly, with a high level of ownership and autonomy, and we are proud to tackle complex problems.

Our way of working is simple: the people who make product decisions are also the people who build the solutions.

Our technology stack includes Python/Flask, React, React Native and PostgreSQL.

Want to learn more? Read this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan to discover what life is like as an engineer at Alan, as well as this article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c about our Engineering career path.




⭐ YOUR MISSION: BUILDING THE CONVERGENCE BETWEEN ALAN AND TANEL

You will play a central role in the gradual convergence of Alan and Tanel’s products and technologies.

The goal will be to preserve the best of both organisations: Tanel’s deep knowledge of the West African market, operational expertise and local relationships, together with Alan’s powerful platform, product practices and international experience.

You will contribute to:

 - Bringing together the product experiences and technology foundations of both companies.

 - Building reusable components and systems that can meet the specific needs of local markets.

 - Evolving our tools to support the growth of our product and operations.

 - Simplifying and automating processes that are currently managed manually.

 - Improving the flow and reliability of data between teams and systems.

 - Finding the right balance between global standardisation and adapting to the realities of Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire.

 - Laying the technical foundations for our medium-term expansion into new West African markets.

This is a rare opportunity to work on complex, concrete problems with a direct impact on how healthcare is funded, administered and experienced by thousands of people.

Est-ce vous que nous cherchons ?

Nous recherchons un(e) Software Engineer avec au moins trois ans d’expérience, capable de contribuer à des projets ambitieux dans un environnement en forte évolution.




IS THIS YOU?

We are looking for a Software Engineer with at least 4 years of experience, who is able to contribute to ambitious projects in a fast-changing environment.

You will be particularly well suited to this role if you:

 - Speak fluent French and English

 - Are legally authorised to work in Senegal and are based in Dakar, or are willing to relocate there.

 - Have at least four years of experience as a Software Engineer. We are hiring at different levels of seniority, so senior profiles are very welcome.

 - Are proficient in a programming language such as Python, Java, C# or an equivalent language.

 - Are comfortable with modern web technologies and interested in working on full-stack applications.

 - Have experience designing robust, maintainable and scalable systems.

 - Are interested in product-related challenges and enjoy understanding user needs.

 - Are autonomous, pragmatic and able to make decisions.

 - Enjoy working as part of a team and collaborating with non-technical stakeholders.

 - Are comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly.

 - Are eager to help build an ambitious local technology organisation.

Experience in insurance, healthcare, fintech, payment systems, operations or regulated environments would be an advantage. However, it is not essential.

Above all, we are looking for curious, responsible people who are able to learn and grow quickly. If you do not meet every requirement but this mission genuinely excites you, we would still love to hear from you.




🎁 BENEFITS

 - Employment contract: Permanent contract, with a three-month probationary period that may be renewed once.

 - Workplace: On-site, from our offices in Dakar, working closely with a passionate local team.

 - Health insurance: Comprehensive health insurance through Alan for you and your family.

 - Learning and development: A flexible people policy, along with budgets for books and conferences.

 - Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of interactions.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

We are also the stewards of our members' most sensitive data, and building privacy in by design is core engineering work for us, not an afterthought.

Want to know more? Read this article https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d on our Engineering career path.




🛠️ THE STACK

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.




🤖 THE DATA FOUNDATIONS CREW - WITHIN THE TECH FOUNDATIONS AREA




🎯 MISSION

 - Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

 - Data Foundations - is one of its crews. Its mission: be the enabling and platform team for data lifecycle and privacy engineering across Alan: retention, deletion, anonymization, and pseudonymization, by design. It builds and runs the GDPR Orchestrator (the platform's current embodiment) and equips each area to own its own data rules on top of it. The team also handles data shared with third parties and partners, with Legal and Security on requirements, including authority-facing work (e.g. CNIL).


🔭 SCOPE

 1. Own and evolve the privacy platform (build & run): its core engine, its safety mechanisms (preview/dry-run, audit trail), and its operational health (deploys, on-call, observability). You design the contract areas build on and keep it reliable as adoption grows.

 2. Build the paved road (enable, teach to fish): docs, templates, and self-serve tooling so any of our 15+ areas can plug into the platform and manage its own data rules and dependencies. You coach areas through pairing and syncs; you build the capability rather than doing the work for them.

 3. Coordinate across areas (the cross-area bridge): align legal, security, data, and the data-producing areas on requirements, surface cross-area data dependencies, and resolve design trade-offs between them. You own the coordination; each area stays accountable for its own data and rules.

 4. Push the foundations forward: drive open platform design questions to a conclusion and grow the platform's capabilities as Alan's data, products, and footprint expand.
    
    


👀 FOCUS FOR 2026

 - Own the platform: become the long-term owner of the GDPR Orchestrator and shape the roadmap for how Alan manages data lifecycle at scale.

 - Raise the bar on the platform: invest in its safety, observability, and developer experience so areas build on it with confidence.

 - Lay the paved road: ship the docs, templates, and tooling that let areas self-serve, then move ownership of data rules to the areas that produce the data.

 - Scale the surface: grow the platform's reach across data stores and third-party systems as Alan expands into new countries.
   
   


⭐ IS IT YOU WE'RE LOOKING FOR?




EXPERIENCE WE VALUE

 - Senior-level experience (typically 8+ years) in backend or platform software engineering, or equivalent, with deep production ownership (API and contract design, data modeling, running what you ship).

 - You've built and operated platforms, libraries, or services that other engineers depend on, and you care about the contract you expose to them.

 - You're comfortable operating across many teams and influencing without authoritarianism: getting legal, security, data, and product crews who don't report to you aligned on a plan, and driving it to completion.

 - You bring pragmatism under constraint: you ship sound, safe solutions and improve them over time, rather than waiting for perfect.

 - Strong plus: prior privacy, GDPR, or data-governance exposure, and experience working in an enabling or platform-team operating model.

 - Explicitly not required: deep legal expertise. Legal and security partner with this role; they don't get replaced by it.
   
   


MINDSET WE VALUE

 - You treat platform engineering as product work: engineers and members are your customers, and doing the right thing with their data should feel effortless.

 - You're hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

 - You design and communicate: you're as comfortable writing a framing doc, drawing a dependency map, and aligning several areas on a design decision as you are writing the code.

 - You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast areas run their own data rules without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

 - You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and safe-by-default abstractions that keep data handling correct and safe by design at scale.

 - You're fluent in English (French is not required).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire above the E level range https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

 - Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

title: Office Manager
description:
⭐ LA SANTÉ N’ATTEND PAS ⭐

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu’il faille six mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu’on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d’affaires multiplié par sept en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de chiffre d’affaires et plus d’un million de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de chiffre d’affaires d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.

Les personnes qui rejoignent Alan sont souvent surprises et ravies par notre méthode de travail innovante. Nous avons défini un ensemble de valeurs culturelles https://alan.com/about/company-culture qui guident notre façon de travailler.



💡 LA MISSION

Alan se développe rapidement en Afrique et nous recherchons une personne pour prendre en charge l’expérience Workplace au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire.

Vous contribuerez à faire des bureaux des environnements agréables, efficaces et bien organisés, tout en créant des moments qui renforcent le lien entre les Alaners.

 - Gérer les opérations quotidiennes des bureaux de Dakar et d’Abidjan : espaces, fournitures, équipements, accès, courrier et services.

 - Coordonner les fournisseurs, les achats, les factures et les sujets de maintenance.

 - Organiser les événements locaux, les moments d’équipe, les offsites et les rituels de communauté.

 - Accompagner les Alaners en déplacement entre les différents hubs, notamment sur les sujets de transport et de logistique.

 - Coordonner les besoins Workplace liés à l’onboarding et à l’offboarding : postes de travail, badges, équipements et accès.

 - Contribuer à des projets globaux Workplace et adapter les processus au contexte local.

 - Structurer la documentation, améliorer les processus et identifier les tâches pouvant être simplifiées ou automatisées.

 - Travailler avec les équipes locales et globales, notamment IT, People, Finance et Workplace.


LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

 - Vous êtes autorisé(e) à travailler au Sénégal et êtes basé(e) à Dakar, ou prêt(e) à vous y installer.

 - Vous avez entre 2 et 4 ans d’expérience en Office Management, Workplace, Facilities ou dans un rôle opérationnel similaire.

 - Vous êtes autonome, pragmatique et à l’aise dans un environnement en construction.

 - Vous savez gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle, des prestataires et des interlocuteurs variés.

 - Vous combinez sens du service, attention aux détails et capacité à prendre des initiatives.

 - Vous appréciez autant l’organisation concrète du quotidien que la création d’expériences et de moments collectifs.

 - Vous êtes à l’aise en français et en anglais.

 - Vous êtes prêt(e) à vous déplacer ponctuellement entre Dakar et Abidjan.


🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI, avec une période d’essai de trois mois renouvelable une fois.

 - Poste sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour vous permettre de donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des déjeuners pris en charge au bureau.

 - Des opportunités d’apprentissage et de formation, ainsi qu’une politique RH flexible et des budgets dédiés aux livres et aux conférences.


🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES

Si cette opportunité vous intéresse mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler ! Rappelez-vous qu’il s’agit d’un guide, et non d’une liste exhaustive. Nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

title: Care Expert - Spain 🇪🇸
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐️ YOUR MISSION ⭐️

 


👩‍💻HELPING OUR MEMBERS

As a Care Expert, your primary mission is to transform member requests into delightful experiences. You'll be their trusted guide, providing:

✨ Meaningful solutions that make a real difference

⚡️ Swift, timely responses when they need you most

🎯 Crystal-clear, accurate information

🤝 Transparent and helpful guidance every step of the way

 

You'll dive into the fascinating world of healthcare, mastering both:

 - The intricacies of the Spanish healthcare system

 - The unique needs of our B2B partners who've chosen Alan as their corporate health insurance provider

Your role sits at the heart of what makes Alan special – turning complex healthcare questions into simple, human experiences.

 


👷IMPROVING ALAN

🎯 Your time at Alan: A perfect balance

 - 80% dedicated to providing exceptional member support

 - 20% driving innovative Care projects tailored to your unique expertise



🚀 Project leadership opportunities

As a Care Expert, you'll have the chance to:

✨ Drive Process Excellence

 - Identify and implement key improvements

 - Transform data insights into actionable solutions

 - Lead end-to-end implementation

👥 Team impact

 - Guide and inspire fellow Alaners

 - Build high-performing project teams

 - Shape the future of Care at Alan

🌟 Example of projects you might lead:

 - Design member empowerment initiatives that boost autonomy

 - Collaborate on cross-community product innovations

 - Help us grow by attracting top Care talent
   
    

Your projects will be shaped by your passions and expertise, making each role truly unique!

 


⭐ JOIN THE CARE TEAM! ⭐️

You will be a good fit for the role if you:

 - Have 2+ years of experience in a customer-support role

 - Master Spanish and English at a full working proficiency level (written and spoken)

 - Have a passion for caring for members, and solving their problems

 - Love written communication

 - Navigate technology with confidence and embrace digital tools and AI

 - Have a very empathetic mindset

 - Are motivated and entrepreneurial

 - Thrive in collaborative environments where you can both learn and share knowledge

 - Bonus points if you know how the Spanish healthcare system works — we will teach you if you don’t. 😉  
   
    


🌍 HOW WE WORK

 - Location: You must be legally eligible to work from Spain.

 - Hybrid work: We offer remote work flexibility but we value in-person collaboration a lot.
   
    


🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.

 


YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

title: Senior Revenue Ops
description:

It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




⭐️ THE SENIOR REVENUE OPERATIONS JOB

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

 - High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

 - Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

 - Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

 - Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 


⭐ IS IT YOU WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

 - Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

 - Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

 - Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

 - Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

 - Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

 - Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

 - Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

 - Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

 - Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

 - Have at least an advanced level in English.

 - Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.



For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity. 




EVERYTHING ELSE IS A PLUS. WE CARE ABOUT HAVING A DIVERSITY OF EXPERIENCES, PROFILES AND BACKGROUNDS IN OUR TEAM.



🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

 - Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Generous transit benefit

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.


IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. 

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.

🧩 CONTEXT OF THE ROLE

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

 - Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

 - Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

 - Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).




🎯 YOUR MISSION

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

 - Business Strategy
   
   - Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan
   
   - Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)
   
   - Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

 - Sales & Account Manager Planning
   
   - Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy
   
   - Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

 - Performance monitoring & Steering
   
   - Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions
   
   - Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis
   
   - Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)
     
     


🧐 SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.



At least 3 years of experience within either:

 - Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

 - Management consulting, investment banking or private equity
   
   

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

 - Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

 - Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

 - Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

 - Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company
   
   

Business sense:

 - At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

 - Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones
   
   

Communication and presence:

 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

 - Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

 - Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

 - Great written and oral structure and communication

 - Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

 - Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area
   
   

Nice to have

 - Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

 - Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

 - Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

 - Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

 - Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

 - Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

 - Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

 - Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company
   
   

Business sense:

 - At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

 - Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

 - Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


🛡️ THE ROLE

Most GRC roles are about keeping auditors happy. This one is about earning our members' trust: every day, they share their diagnoses, their claims and their care with us.

You'll own security governance and risk at Alan end to end. That means one clear framework across our certifications and regulations, which the whole company uses to decide what matters most. You set the direction, make the calls on risk, and help every team own its part.

We just earned our HDS certification, and there's much more to build as we grow from 1M to many millions of members, across more countries and regulators. That includes how we govern AI, which Alan uses across its products and operations.

This is a hands-on senior role. You do the work yourself, mentor the junior GRC engineer we're hiring alongside you, and grow the team over time.

 


🚀 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Make our security framework a tool for the whole company. You own the full certification cycle (ISO 27001, HDS and those to come), and turn it into something teams use every day to prioritise, not a binder for auditors.

 - Bring the security view on regulation. Legal and Risk own the regulatory relationships. You bring the security answer: what the rules mean for how we protect data, and which controls make it work in practice.

 - Run risk as an ongoing programme. You map and prioritise security risks, including AI risks, turn them into clear treatment plans, and feed them into company-wide risk decisions with the Risk team.

 - Help every team own its risks. You define the controls framework and the standards, while the teams who build and run our systems own the controls. You brief the board and audit committee, and you know which findings need an urgent call and which can wait for the quarterly report.

 - Own incident governance. You triage and escalate incidents, own business continuity and disaster recovery, and shape the security side of our regulatory incident reports.

 - Be a credible partner to engineering. You work with engineering teams early on new designs and spot control gaps (access, encryption, logging) before they ship. You don't need to be an architect, but you can hold the conversation.
   
    


🏗️ WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

 - One governance model: clear ownership of risks and controls across teams, so security decisions don't bottleneck on one person.

 - A living risk map: prioritised risks that actually drive company and engineering decisions.

 - One compliance backbone: a single control system across our countries and regulators, built to scale.

 - An automated evidence engine: evidence collected straight from engineering systems, so audits run continuously instead of as a quarterly rush.

You'll work closely with Legal, the Data Protection Officer, Internal Audit and Risk, and day to day with engineering and operations teams.

 


⭐ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Your team

You'll join Alan's Corporate team, which brings together our control functions: Risk, Corporate Governance & Internal Control, Legal, Compliance and Security. They share one mission: building what lets Alan operate at scale, safely and responsibly. Within that group, you carry the security governance and risk dimension, working hand in hand with the security engineers who run our infrastructure and platform security, and with a junior GRC engineer we're hiring alongside you. You'll be hands-on every day, building and owning the work yourself. Along the way, you'll mentor the junior engineer and help shape how GRC grows at Alan.

What you bring

 - You want to build and own things yourself, and you enjoy helping someone else grow while you do it.

 - 6+ years in security, with real GRC ownership.

 - You've run a GRC roadmap in a certified or strongly regulated environment (ISO 27001, HDS, SOC 2, or regulated sectors like health, insurance or finance). You're comfortable working with certification auditors, and you can explain what a framework requires and why it makes sense for business teams.

 - You take a stand on risks, and you'd rather close one real risk than write ten policies.

 - You're fluent in French and English.
   
    

A big plus

 - You've driven a certification or audit cycle end to end yourself.

 - You've automated compliance work, or you're eager to, and you have a view on where AI can help.

 - You've presented risk to senior leaders or a board.

 - You've mentored or onboarded someone before.

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility.

In West Africa, people wait for symptoms to get worse, wait months for an appointment, and depend on a health system stuck in paper and manual processes. We exist to end that wait.

Founded in 2022 in Senegal, Tanel is the first digital health insurer in francophone West Africa, operating in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire. With 30,000+ members, a network of 1,200+ health facilities and 400+ pharmacies, and revenue multiplied by 7 in 2025, Tanel has proven real product-market fit.

In 2026, Alan, Europe's prevention-first health insurer (€950M+ revenue, 1M+ members in France, Belgium, Spain and Canada), acquired Tanel to accelerate its expansion in Africa. Together, we are building the reference health insurer in francophone West Africa, aiming for $200M in revenue by 2030.


🚀 WHY JOIN NOW?

Care is our members' first point of contact, and today it runs on the energy of a small, committed team: about 5 people across Dakar and Abidjan, answering members, HR admins and providers on WhatsApp, phone, email and the app.

What got us here will not get us to the next stage:

 - Scale: our member base is set to grow several times over in the next 3 years.

 - Expansion: after Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, we plan to open new countries in the coming years.

 - Integration: we are moving Care Africa onto Alan's ways of working (KPIs, rituals, playbooks) and, in 2027, onto Alan's tools and platform.

 - Performance: we need to structure our KPIs: what we measure, why, and how we act on it, from response times to member satisfaction.

This is a rare chance to shape a Care organization from the ground up, with the backing of a Care Ops team that has already done it in several countries (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada).


⭐ THE ROLE

As Care Ops for Alan Africa, you are the most senior Care person on the ground. You do not manage the team directly: our crew lead does. You own the transformation: how the team is organized, how it grows, how it performs, and how it converges with the rest of Alan. You are part of Alan's global Care Ops team, and you bring local reality into global decisions as much as you bring global practices to Africa.

Your missions include:

1/ Design and roll out the target operating model

 - Turn Alan's Care model into a version that works for Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire: how agents split their time between members and improvement work, opening hours, weekends, service levels we commit to.

 - Define the team structure for the next 3 years: roles, tiers, one team or one per country.

 - Set up outsourcing where it makes sense, and manage the performance of our external partners.

 - Build the hiring plan with the crew lead and take part in recruitment, including final-round validation.

2/ Lead the integration with Alan

 - Bring Alan's KPIs, rituals and playbooks to the local team, and make sure they stick through training and follow-up.

 - Help the crew lead grow the team and coach agents into Care Experts who own improvement projects.

3/ Own operational performance, quality and tools

 - Structure our KPIs and reporting: what we measure, why, and how we review it every week, including member satisfaction on WhatsApp and phone.

 - Diagnose root causes behind delays, backlogs and member pain points, and turn them into concrete actions.

 - Make sure our tools (ticketing, WhatsApp, phone) are set up and fully operational, and lead the transition to Alan's stack with Product, so local needs are built in.

 - Provide the inputs (volumes, hours, productivity) that feed our staffing model and budget, and challenge the outputs.

4/ Be the bridge between local and global

 - Represent Care Africa in Alan's Care community: share what works, raise what doesn't, contribute to global projects.

 - Contribute to Care's strategic plan, for Africa and at global level.


⭐ YOU WILL EXCEL IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of experience in customer service or customer experience operations, including structuring, scaling or turning around a team.

 - Have led change in teams or functions you did not manage, and know how to earn buy-in rather than impose a playbook.

 - Are data-fluent: you set and track the right KPIs, read and challenge an analysis, and use numbers to make decisions. You do not need to build forecasting models.

 - Are fluent in French and work comfortably in English, written and spoken.

 - Know the West African context and adapt your approach to the people and the market you work with.

 - Are structured, autonomous and at ease with ambiguity: much is still to be defined, and you will help define it.

 - Care deeply about access to healthcare and want to have a real impact on members' lives.

Strong pluses: experience in health, insurance or assistance; managing outsourcing partners; leading a CRM or tooling migration; running WhatsApp or phone-heavy support; speaking Wolof.


🎁 WHAT WE OFFER

 - Permanent contract, full time, based in our Dakar office, with regular trips to Abidjan.

 - A central role in a fast-growing African healthtech, backed by Alan's global Care team.

 - Comprehensive health insurance through Alan for you and your family.

 - All the tools you need to do your best work.

 - Learning and training opportunities: a flexible policy, budgets for books and conferences.

If this role excites you but you don't tick every box, we would love to hear from you. Everyone, including people from underrepresented groups, should feel free to apply: either we succeed, or we learn.

title: Product Builder - Mo (AI health companion)

🤖 WHO WE ARE

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

 


🚀 WHY WE NEED YOU

Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity.

You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be:

 - 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo.

 - 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries.

 - 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features).

 - ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it.


 


🎯 IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

 - You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better.

 - You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people.

 - You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap.

 - You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team.

 - You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

 - Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product

 - Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails)

 - Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes

 - Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output

 - Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

 - Fluent in English

 - Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. (How we made our offer builder global https://medium.com/alan/how-we-refactored-one-of-our-most-used-data-models-33cadaf31313)

 - 🛡️ Life & Disability as a first-class product: We’re bringing this historically smaller product at Alan to the same level of maturity as Health, with first class member XP, Ops and enabling access to a much wider population.

 - 🛡️ Technical direction and operational excellence. Architecture calls, quality standards and shaping the organization and incident response as we scale to more countries. And you stay hands-on: at Alan, engineering leaders are expected to build.

 - Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth, engineers become better while building better products

 - Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

 - Your users sit next to you: Hundred of Alaners use what your team ships every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is very short, which allows you to iterate and move quickly.

 - Complex domain, simple software: Regulated domain, many countries, many segments… The job is to model a messy real world into a stack that stays simple and easy to extend.

 - Direct business impact. We own pricing, contract lifecycle and Sales tooling. We have a direct impact on Alan’s margin and growth.

 - 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

TECHNICAL FOUNDATIONS

 - Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

 - First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

 - You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

 - Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

 - Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

🤖 OPS AI PLATFORM TEAM 🔀

We're building something that doesn't exist yet.

Imagine a platform where AI agents autonomously handle operational work - connected to every internal and external tool, trained by operators themselves, running safely at scale. No engineers needed. No bottlenecks. Just agents that work.

That's what we're building. The Ops AI Platform will let our Ops team create, evolve, and monitor their own AI agents to automate thousands of tedious tasks. We aim to crack problems no one has solved at this scale.

The project just launched. You'd join at ground zero - shaping the architecture, the product, the entire foundation.

If building the future of work from scratch excites you, this is it.

 


⭐ OUR NORTH STAR

We’re building ops agents that work reliably and safely, without putting the engineering team on the critical path.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering and ML engineering. Our mission is to create the platform that enables building accurate and reliable AI agents, delivering an outstanding experience to our internal Ops team for the creation, iteration and monitoring of their agents, without requiring hard technical skills. Things we’re working on:

 - 💬 Integrate agents at the heart of internal tools - UIs where Ops monitor and take action on concrete business situations. We want AI agents to become first-class citizens in this ecosystem, with context-aware chat modals, allowing users to review agents' reasoning, actions, and provide follow-up instructions - with instant impact on business data.

 - 👥 Empower non-technical users to become autonomous in the creation and maintenance of agents to automate operational tasks at scale: prompting, tools configuration, testing, datasets, replayability, evaluations

 - 🔧 Build a complete set of tools made available to AI agents, connecting to internal and external capabilities: internal business data, external servers, external web dashboards without API, etc.

 - 💯 Safety and accuracy at the core: robust testing, stateful evaluation, progressive rollout, human-in-the-loop to validate sensitive actions, fine-grained permissions and limits

In 6 to 12 months, we plan to increase our scope by owning the AI platform that will power all agentic use cases at Alan - creating economies of scale thanks to common infrastructure and tooling.

If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of work, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey.

 


🎯 IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in operations.

 - You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, tool calling, human-in-the-loop, internal tools UX, multi-agent architectures, and see your work deployed in production, used by our ops team

 - You’ll implement new capabilities for AI agents, as well as tooling to make ops autonomous on the creation, evolution, monitoring and evaluation of their agents

 - You’ll work on making our system scale, going from a few dozen to tens of thousands of tasks automated daily

 - You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality

 - You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring).

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

 - Strong background in full-stack software engineering, systems architecture, with a spike in back-end engineering.

 - Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus

 - Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful

 - Self-directed and pragmatic

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

 - Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

MISSION

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.




SCOPE


⚙️ PLATFORM & AUTOMATION

 - Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

 - Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

 - Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices


🔑 IDENTITY & ACCESS

 - Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

 - Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

 - Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

 - Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

 - Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack


🔒 ENDPOINT & SAAS SECURITY

 - Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

 - Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

 - Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope


🩺 HEALTH PROFESSIONALS IT

 - The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

 - Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process


🌍 INTERNATIONALISATION

 - Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

 - Bring acquired entities onto that same platform


MILESTONES

First 3 months

 - Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

 - Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

 - Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

 - Own a workstream end-to-end

 - Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

 - Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

 - Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

 - Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

 - Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

 - Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

 - Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

 - Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

 - Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

 - Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

 - 5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

 - Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

 - You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

 - Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

 - Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

 - Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

 - Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

 - Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

 - Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

 - Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

 - Kandji or another MDM at scale

 - Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

 - Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

 - Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

 - Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

 - Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

title: Security Engineer Junior - GRC
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




🛡️ THE ROLE

Most GRC roles are about keeping auditors happy. This one is about earning our members' trust: every day, they share their diagnoses, their claims and their care with us.

You'll join Alan's security team to help run our compliance and risk work across ISO 27001, HDS and DORA, across a growing number of countries and regulators. We just earned our HDS certification, and there's much more to build, including how we govern AI across our products: assessing AI risks, setting the controls, and keeping up with the AI Act.

You'll learn alongside experienced security engineers, with a dedicated coach from day one. You'll take on real ownership early, and your scope grows as we scale from 1M to many millions of members. And you'll learn how we work at Alan: teams own their risks and controls, we automate wherever we can, and we focus on real outcomes, not paperwork.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Keep our certifications on track. You run the day-to-day of the ISO 27001 and HDS audit cycles: collecting evidence, preparing internal audits, and following up on corrective actions until they're closed.

 - Turn regulations into practical actions. With Legal and the DPO, you help translate requirements like DORA, HDS, and GDPR into clear tasks for the teams, and track that they get done.

 - Learn the health sector rules. You build your knowledge of health-specific frameworks (ANS, HDS) and help apply them to how we handle health data.

 - Contribute to risk management. You help build and update our risk mapping, including AI risks, and follow up on the treatment plans with the teams who own them.

 - Support the teams who own the controls. You keep the controls framework up to date, answer teams' questions, and help explain security clearly to every stakeholder, from engineers to managers.

 - Support incident governance. You help classify and document incidents, keep Business continuity and Disaster recovery plans up to date, and prepare inputs for DORA incident reports.

 - Automate what slows us down. You spot repetitive compliance tasks and automate them with scripts, tools or AI.




🏗️ WHAT YOU'LL HELP BUILD

 - One compliance backbone: A single control system for several regulators in several countries, so Alan can scale without rebuilding compliance each time.

 - An automated evidence engine: evidence collected straight from engineering systems with scripts and AI, so audits run continuously instead of as a quarterly rush.

You'll work closely with Legal, the DPO, Internal Audit and Risk, and day to day with engineering and operations teams.




⭐ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You want to do the work yourself and grow with it: a permanent, hands-on role where you build things for the long run.

 - 2+ years in security, GRC or compliance (an audit background is fine if you want to move into building).

 - You've played a key part in a certification or audit cycle (ISO 27001, HDS, SOC 2 or similar).

 - You're curious about how things work technically, and you've automated at least one manual task (a script, a tool, an AI workflow).

 - You're fluent in French and English, and comfortable presenting in both.

 - You learn fast, ask for feedback, and go into the details when it matters.
   
   


🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

 


🤖 THE HOPPER CREW




🎯 Mission:

 - Hopper is Alan's internal agentic AI platform and every Alaner's AI companion: one unified productivity tool for coding, data, automation, research, and everyday work.

 - It is a platform with a product on top. The product is the first and most demanding user of reusable components for agent orchestration, isolated execution, skills, connectors, permissions, audit, and evaluations.

It started as a coding agent. Watch how we built its first version and enabled anyone at Alan to ship code https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hAu7Ngfd0ys. Coding remains its most mature use case and the foundation we are expanding from.

🔭 Scope:

 1. Product experience - durable AI sessions available from the web, Slack, Linear, and GitHub for coding, data analysis, automation, and general work

 2. Agent runtime and orchestration - control plane, harness, model routing, long-running execution, recovery, and isolated sandboxes

 3. Secure connectors - an MCP Gateway that manages identity, credentials, permissions, confirmations, sensitivity, and audit

 4. Skills, automations, and artifacts - reusable workflows, scheduled or event-driven work, dashboards, and hosted tools

 5. Trust and review - evaluations and product experiences that expose tests, screenshots, previews, queries, sources, and tool actions

👀 Focus for 2026:

Coding proved that Alaners want to delegate meaningful work to agents. Our 2026 focus is to make it the AI companion every Alaner can rely on: faster and more durable sessions, safe access to company tools and data, HDS-compatible infrastructure for sensitive workloads, stronger evaluations, and results people can inspect before acting on them.

 

👀 Focus for 2026:

In 2026, we're moving from "AI tools you monitor" to "AI agents you trust." That means scaling Hopper — Alan's own background coding agent — alongside the infrastructure that makes it reliable: managed agent pools, sandboxed environments, autonomous testing, and CI auto-fix.  - Ability to own work end to end, from a React interaction or API contract to reliability in production

 - Experience with LLM APIs, agent harnesses, MCP, or AI-assisted coding tools is a strong plus


MINDSET WE VALUE

 - You think in terms of both product and platform experience: Alaners across engineering, product, data, sales, and operations are your customers

 - You care about whether people can understand and verify what an AI system did

 - You make concrete tradeoffs between speed, reliability, cost, security, and user experience

 - You simplify complexity with clear abstractions and maintainable code

 - You are collaborative, humble, and motivated by enabling others

 - You are excited about AI changing who can build, investigate, and automate work
