title: Regional Marketing Associate – Midwest Region
description:
Regional Marketing Associate – Midwest Region

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Senior Marketing Manager

Job Type: Full-Time | Exempt

Salary range: $60,000 to $70,000

Work Location: Hybrid / Field-Based – Must reside in the Minneapolis / St. Paul region

Position Summary

Lakefield Veterinary Group is seeking a Regional Marketing Associate – Midwest Region to serve as an on-the-ground marketing and growth partner for a portfolio of approximately 12 veterinary hospitals.

This is a hands-on role for a marketer who enjoys turning strategy into action. You’ll work directly with hospital teams, Operations, Medical Leadership, and our Enterprise Marketing Team to implement marketing programs, identify local growth opportunities, strengthen community engagement, and help hospitals attract and retain clients.

Rather than supporting every hospital in the Midwest at the same level, you’ll focus on a portfolio of priority locations where dedicated marketing support can have the greatest impact. Hospital assignments may shift quarterly based on business performance, growth opportunities, and Marketing and Operations priorities.

This is a great opportunity for a marketer who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships, solving problems, and executing marketing—not just planning it.

What You'll Do

Own Marketing Support for a Regional Portfolio

• Serve as the primary field marketing partner for approximately 12 priority hospitals.

• Build strong relationships with hospital and Operations leaders and understand each location's business needs, local market, and growth opportunities.

• Help translate annual and quarterly Marketing priorities into actionable local plans.

• Review performance and proactively identify hospitals or opportunities requiring additional marketing support.

Execute Marketing Programs & Campaigns

• Implement enterprise, regional, and local marketing campaigns across assigned hospitals.

• Provide hands-on support for client service, client acquisition, client retention, online booking, forward booking, reputation, referral, and other growth initiatives.

• Personally execute local marketing activities while partnering with specialized Marketing team members for additional channel support.

• Ensure programs and campaigns are implemented accurately, on time, and with strong hospital engagement.

Build Local Awareness & Community Connections

• Identify and develop local partnerships, sponsorships, events, and community outreach opportunities.

• Help hospitals build stronger relationships within their communities and increase local awareness.

• Coordinate event participation, outreach materials, promotions, and local activation.

• Support local content opportunities, including social media, Google Business Profile, photos, videos, new services, and new DVM announcements.

Strengthen Client Experience & Reputation

• Review client feedback, reputation trends, and available sentiment data.

• Identify opportunities to improve client experience, satisfaction, retention, and reputation.

• Partner with hospital and Operations leadership to implement appropriate marketing and communication solutions.

Measure, Learn & Improve

• Monitor key business and marketing performance indicators across assigned hospitals.

• Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities and recommend actions to improve performance.

• Share market insights, competitive activity, successful programs, and field learnings with the broader Marketing Team.

• Help identify successful local strategies that can be replicated across other hospitals.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 2–4 years of experience in field marketing, regional marketing, local marketing, or a related role.

• Experience supporting multiple locations or markets preferred.

• Strong project management, organization, and follow-through.

• Comfortable using data and KPIs to identify opportunities and guide marketing decisions.

• Strong relationship-building and communication skills.

• A hands-on, solution-oriented mindset and willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.

• Comfortable working directly with frontline teams, clients, and community partners.

• Experience with community marketing, events, partnerships, social media, or local marketing preferred.

• Veterinary, healthcare, retail, or multi-location service experience is a plus.

• Familiarity with Canva, Monday.com, CRM/email platforms, social media, and marketing analytics tools is helpful.

• Valid driver's license and ability to travel regularly throughout assigned Midwest markets.

How You'll Work

This is a hybrid field and remote position requiring regular in-person presence at assigned hospitals and travel throughout the Midwest region.

Your hospital portfolio will generally include approximately 12 priority locations at a time. Assignments may change quarterly based on business needs and where dedicated Marketing support can create the greatest impact.

What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role when hospitals see you as a trusted, proactive Marketing partner—not simply someone who provides resources. You'll help turn Marketing strategy into action, identify opportunities before you're asked, ensure initiatives get across the finish line, and use performance insights to continuously improve results.

Most importantly, you'll help our hospitals become more visible in their communities, strengthen the client experience, and drive sustainable growth.

Benefits:

• 401(k) + matching

• Health, Dental, and Vision insurance

• Flexible spending account or Health savings account

• Life insurance

• Paid time off

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Employee veterinary care discount

• Flexible Hybrid work schedule

• Professional development assistance

• Veterinary medical benefits for pets at hospitals in the Lakefield family.

ABOUT LAKEFIELD VETERINARY GROUP 

We believe exceptional veterinary care starts with exceptional people.  

We partner with hospitals across the country to preserve what makes each practice special - its people, culture, and connection to community - while providing the operational support and resources that allow teams to thrive.  

As we grow, we are committed to creating an environment where team members feel respected, supported, and empowered to deliver outstanding care. 

Our Values 

Our culture is built on five core values that guide how we work and serve: 

• Respect 

• Learning 

• Do the Right Thing 

• Wow Service 

• Fun 

If these resonate with you, you’ll fit right in.

title: Veterinary Hospital Administrator
location: Puget Sound Veterinary Specialty + Emergency - Gig Harbor, Washington
description:
Hospital Administrator – Puget Sound Veterinary Specialty & Emergency

About PSVSE

Located in beautiful Gig Harbor, Washington, Puget Sound Veterinary Specialty & Emergency (PSVSE) provides exceptional emergency and specialty veterinary care to pets and families throughout the Pacific Northwest. Our team is committed to collaborative, gold-standard medicine while supporting our patients, clients, referring veterinarians, and one another.

Our culture is built around Compassion, Inclusion, Accountability, Innovation, and Gold Standard Patient Care. We believe in asking questions, sharing knowledge, and supporting one another as we continue to grow and provide the highest quality care to every patient we serve.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Hospital Administrator to help lead the continued growth and success of PSVSE.

The HA is a key member of our leadership team, partnering closely with the Medical Director to oversee hospital operations, team development, financial performance, and the overall client and team experience.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys developing people, building strong relationships, solving problems, and creating an environment where both people and patient care can thrive.

What You’ll Do

• Partner with the Medical Director and leadership team to oversee daily hospital operations and achieve hospital goals.

• Foster a culture built on compassion, inclusion, accountability, innovation, and collaboration.

• Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop hospital team members.

• Support DVMs with administrative, HR, performance, and operational needs.

• Monitor financial performance, labor costs, revenue, and other key hospital metrics.

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, efficiency, and the experience of our clients and team.

• Oversee scheduling, facilities, equipment, compliance, and other operational needs.

• Handle employee and client concerns with empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment.

• Build strong relationships with referring veterinarians and represent PSVSE within the local veterinary community.

• Partner with hospital leadership on strategic planning, business development, and continued growth.

What We’re Looking For

• 3- 5 years previous leadership and management experience in veterinary medicine or healthcare required.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in Management, Communication, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

• Experience managing DVMs, physicians, or other professional staff strongly preferred.

• Strong understanding of hospital operations and financial performance.

• Excellent communication, relationship-building, and conflict-resolution skills.

• A people-focused leader who can balance compassion with accountability.

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced specialty and emergency environment.

• A commitment to gold-standard patient care, continuous learning, and supporting the people around you.

Why PSVSE?

At PSVSE, you’ll have the opportunity to lead a talented veterinary team, make a meaningful impact on hospital operations, and help shape the future of a growing specialty and emergency hospital.

We believe every interaction with a patient, client, or team member is an opportunity to educate, uplift, and provide care with integrity and excellence. If you’re a leader who wants to help create that kind of environment every day, we’d love to hear from you.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Lakefield Veterinary Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members and applicants.

title: Ingénieur Procédés de Fabrication PCBA – Nucléaire
Commissioning Superintendent Engineer – CEYHAN Project – Turkey
description:
Location: Ceyhan, Turkey
Project: Major Petrochemical Project
Duration: Minimum 12 months
Start Date: Early 2027
Language: Professional/Fluent English mandatory
About MOBEN & ROOSTER
MOBEN & ROOSTER is a French company specializing in engineering consultancy and software solutions for complex industrial projects.
We support major players in the energy and process industries on projects in France and internationally, with particular expertise in the critical phases of construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
As part of our collaboration with SPIE GSE, we are currently looking for a Commissioning Superintendent Engineer to join the CEYHAN Project in Turkey, a major project within the petrochemical industry.
Your Role
Reporting to the project Commissioning Management team, you will play a key role in the preparation, coordination and field supervision of commissioning activities.
Your main responsibilities will include:
• Supervising and coordinating pre-commissioning and commissioning activities within your assigned scope;

• Organizing commissioning teams and coordinating day-to-day activities across the different disciplines;

• Ensuring that activities are performed in accordance with the project’s commissioning procedures, priorities and sequences;

• Coordinating interfaces between Construction, Commissioning, Engineering and Operations teams;

• Ensuring systems and subsystems are ready prior to their handover to the commissioning teams;

• Participating in system completion, turnover and handover activities;

• Supervising functional testing and the various operations required for successful commissioning;

• Managing punch lists, identifying critical issues and coordinating their resolution;

• Ensuring full compliance with HSE and Quality requirements throughout commissioning activities;

• Monitoring daily progress and anticipating requirements in terms of manpower, equipment and resources;

• Participating in coordination meetings and providing accurate progress reporting to the Commissioning Manager;

• Supporting start-up preparation and assisting the teams during plant start-up.

Your Profile
You are an experienced Engineer or Senior Technician with a strong background in commissioning on major industrial projects, including significant experience in field supervision and coordination positions.
Previous experience within the petrochemical industry is mandatory.
Experience with Polypropylene (PP) and/or Polyethylene (PE) units would be a significant advantage.
You have a strong understanding of pre-commissioning, commissioning, system completion, handover and start-up preparation activities.

title: Responsable Technique et Sécurité
description:
Le nouveau campus de La Plateforme (Grande École du Numérique) ouvrira fin 2026 à Marseille dans le quartier Euroméditerranée. Il s’agit d’un ensemble immobilier de 19 000 m² de surface utile répartis sur 6 bâtiments (2 neufs, 4 rénovés), accueillant jusqu’à 2 500 étudiants, ainsi que des commerces, un cinéma, un auditorium, une zone de restauration et un City Stade.
Le site fonctionne 7j/7, de 8h à 23h selon les espaces, et comprend des installations techniques complexes : réseau urbain MASSILEO pour le CVC, 7 ascenseurs + monte-charge + élévateurs PMR, GTB multi-bâtiments, SSI de catégorie 2b à 4, panneaux photovoltaïques, stores motorisés, contrôle d’accès étendu, vidéosurveillance.
Le Responsable Technique et Sécurité est le pilier opérationnel du service technique. Il pilote l’ensemble des contrats de maintenance et de services, encadre l’adjoint technique et le responsable logistique, et assure le bon fonctionnement du site au quotidien.

Missions principales
1. Exploitation technique des bâtiments
• Superviser l’ensemble des installations techniques communes : CVC, électricité courants forts et faibles, plomberie, appareils élévateurs

• Assurer la continuité de service et limiter les interruptions

• Mettre en place et suivre les plans de maintenance préventive et corrective

• Être l’interlocuteur technique de référence auprès des preneurs

• Optimiser la performance énergétique des bâtiments

2. Pilotage des contrats de maintenance et de services
• Piloter opérationnellement les prestataires titulaires des contrats suivants : multitechnique, nettoyage et gestion des déchets, sécurité incendie / sûreté, liaisons mécaniques, divers (contrôle réglementaire, espaces verts, logistique, concessionnaires)

3. Travaux et petites interventions
• Planifier et superviser les travaux de mise en conformité, rénovation ou amélioration

• Gérer la provision pour petits travaux hors contrat

• Coordonner les sous-traitants et prestataires ponctuels

4. Sécurité et conformité réglementaire
• Garantir la sécurité des biens et des personnes sur l’ensemble du site (ERP multi-types : R, L, M, PS)

• Superviser le dispositif de sécurité incendie (SSI cat. 2b à 4 ; 3 agents SSIAP dont 2 en 24h/24)

• Superviser le dispositif de sûreté

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire : normes HSE, commissions de sécurité, registre de sécurité

• Organiser et suivre les contrôles réglementaires annuels

• Mettre en œuvre et actualiser les plans de prévention et d’évacuation

5. Performance énergétique et environnement
• Suivre les consommations mensuelles

• Analyser les écarts et proposer des actions correctives

• Accompagner les mises à jour des outils de gestion technique

• Contribuer aux démarches de certification ou labellisation environnementale si applicable

6. Management et coordination
• Encadrer l’adjoint technique/travaux ou responsable logistique (poste à confirmer)

• Collaborer avec la direction, les services administratifs de l’école et les responsables techniques des preneurs

• Gérer le budget technique maintenance et travaux

7. Suivi et reporting
• Définir et suivre les indicateurs de performance (taux de panne, disponibilité, coûts)

• Mettre en place des tableaux de bord exploitation

• Assurer un reporting régulier à la direction

• Animer les réunions trimestrielles d’exploitation-maintenance avec les prestataires

Profil recherché
• Formation

BTS Maintenance des systèmes / Génie climatique / Électrotechnique, ou Licence Pro Gestion technique du bâtiment / Facilities Management, ou équivalent par expérience.
• Expérience

- 5 ans minimum en gestion technique de site ou facility management
- Expérience sur des établissements multi-activités ou ERP de taille significative fortement appréciée
- Expérience dans le pilotage de contrats multitechniques et multi-services
• Compétences techniques

- Solides connaissances en CVC, électricité (CFO/CFA), plomberie, clos couvert
- Maîtrise des réglementations ERP et des obligations de sécurité incendie
- Connaissance des systèmes GTB/GMAO
- Sensibilité à la performance énergétique et au suivi des consommations
• Habilitations requises / souhaitées

- Habilitation électrique (B0/H0V minimum, BS/BE souhaité)
- SSIAP 2 ou 3 (ou SSIAP 1 avec expérience en management d’équipe sécurité)
- SST – Sauveteur Secouriste du Travail
• Qualités personnelles

- Rigueur, autonomie et sens des responsabilités
- Réactivité face aux situations d’urgence
- Aptitude au management et à la coordination multi-intervenants
- Bon relationnel avec des interlocuteurs variés (direction, preneurs, prestataires, commissions de sécurité)
- Disponibilité pour des astreintes ponctuelles

title: Formation & Emploi - Technicien(ne) spécialisé(e) en infrastructures complexes
description:
Technicien·ne Spécialisé.e en Infrastructures Complexes (CVC) — Formation rémunérée + Alternance + perspective CDI
Localisation : Paris (Tremblay-en-France, AFORP) ou Marseille (La Plateforme / NRSud)
Type de contrat : POEI rémunérée (3 mois) + alternance (7 mois) — perspective CDI
Démarrage : rentrée septembre 2026
Durée totale : 10 mois (3 mois en centre + 7 mois en alternance entreprise)
Profil : titulaires d'un Bac Pro MELEC, toutes promotions confondues
Tu as ton Bac Pro MELEC ? On te forme et on te place sur les sites les plus exigeants de France.
Les datacenters et les sites industriels critiques recrutent en masse des techniciens spécialisés, celles et ceux qui maintiennent, dépannent et mettent en service les infrastructures qui font tourner Internet, l'industrie et l'énergie. C'est un métier qui ne connaît pas le chômage, qui paye bien, et qui ouvre des perspectives partout en France et à l'international.
Le hic : un Bac Pro seul ne suffit pas. Il manque les habilitations, la spécialisation CVC (Chauffage – Ventilation – Climatisation), la maîtrise des systèmes de supervision GTB/BMS, et l'expérience terrain.
On te propose un parcours de 10 mois pour combler tout ça — et décrocher un emploi durable.
Comment ça se passe
Phase 1 — De septembre à décembre 2026 : 3 mois de formation rémunérée (POEI, 399 heures)
Tu rejoins le centre à temps plein. La formation est prise en charge et rémunérée dans le cadre d'une Préparation Opérationnelle à l'Emploi (POEI). Au programme :
• Habilitations électriques BR, B1, H1 (passage à la fin de la séquence)

• Habilitations fluidiques (manipulation des fluides frigorigènes, brasure, recherche de fuite)

• Spécialisation Infrastructures Complexes : électricité courants forts, thermodynamique et froid, tuyauterie / fluides, mécanique, courants faibles, GTB/BMS (Schneider Ecostruxure), sûreté, maintenance, anglais technique

Phase 2 — De janvier à juillet 2027 : 7 mois en alternance rémunérée
Tu signes un contrat d'apprentissage ou de professionnalisation avec une entreprise partenaire, sur l'un des deux métiers ci-dessous (selon profil et opportunités) :
Option A — Installation et travaux CVC Monter, raccorder, tester et mettre en service les équipements thermoclimatiques sur des sites neufs ou en rénovation. Tu interviens en équipe, en lien avec les bureaux d'études et les sous-traitants.
Option B — Exploitation et maintenance CVC Assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien des installations en service. Tournée de ronde, surveillance via GTB/BMS, maintenance préventive, diagnostic et intervention sur incident, reporting.
Rythme : 1 semaine en centre de formation / 3 semaines en entreprise. Rémunération sur toute la période.
Phase 3 — À l'issue : CDI envisageable
Plusieurs entreprises partenaires sont en demande active de techniciens formés sur ces métiers. Un CDI peut t'être proposé à la fin de l'alternance sur le même poste, dans la continuité directe.
À l'issue de la formation, tu sauras
• Lire et interpréter un schéma électrique, un plan P&ID, un synoptique GTB

• Identifier et nommer (en français et en anglais technique) tous les équipements d'un site critique : TGBT, UPS, groupes électrogènes, chillers, CRAC, CTA, dry coolers, baies serveurs…

• Manipuler les fluides frigorigènes en sécurité (charge, récupération, recherche de fuite)

• Diagnostiquer une panne, déclencher la bonne procédure et rédiger un rapport d'intervention

• Naviguer sur une supervision GTB/BMS, qualifier une alarme, intervenir en premier niveau

• Respecter les consignes de sécurité et de sûreté propres aux environnements critiques

Profil recherché
• Bac Pro MELEC validé — peu importe quand (2, 5 ou 10 ans, toutes les promotions sont les bienvenues)

• Bases solides en électricité (niveau Bac Pro MELEC) - testées lors d'une journée ou recommandées par un professeur

• Esprit orienté solutions, raisonnement logique

• Envie de travailler les mains dans le concret, sur des sites qui font tourner l'économie réelle

• Mobilité IDF (Tremblay-en-France) ou Sud (Marseille) selon le centre que tu choisis

• L'anglais technique de base : on te l'apprend pendant la formation

Ce qu'on t'offre
• Une formation 100 % rémunérée dans le cadre d'une POEI

• Un contrat d'alternance rémunéré sur 7 mois dans une entreprise leader des infrastructures critiques

• Toutes les habilitations nécessaires pour exercer immédiatement (électriques, fluidiques, hauteur, SST)

• Une perspective d'emploi durable : CDI envisageable à l'issue de l'alternance

• Un encadrement pédagogique assuré par les centres partenaires (AFORP en Île-de-France, La Plateforme et NRSud à Marseille)

• Une certification reconnue de Technicien de Maintenance CVC (niveau 4 - Bac) validée par un jury professionnel réunissant centres de formation et entreprises partenaires

Comment postuler
Postule directement via le bouton ci-dessous. Dans ta candidature, précise :
• Ton année de Bac Pro et la spécialité (MELEC)

• Le centre de formation que tu préfères (Île-de-France ou Marseille)

• Le débouché qui t'attire le plus (installation/travaux ou exploitation/maintenance) — ou les deux si tu hésites encore, on en parle ensemble

• En quelques lignes, ce qui t'attire dans le métier

On revient vers toi sous quelques jours pour un premier échange.
Programme conçu en partenariat avec La Plateforme, AFORP, NRSud et plusieurs entreprises leaders du secteur des infrastructures critiques. Plus d'infos sur le programme : laplateforme.io/technicien-infrastructures-complexes

title: Animateur.rice auprès du jeune public - CYBERPARK
description:
Votre contexte de travail
La Plateforme
La Plateforme est la Grande école du numérique pour tous basée à Marseille avec plusieurs antennes en France. Cofondée avec le Club Top 20 réunissant les grandes entreprises de la Métropole Aix Marseille, l’école propose une offre de formations diversifiées et certifiantes dans le domaine de l’informatique et des technologies. La Plateforme_ est reconnue Établissement d’Enseignement Supérieur Technique Privé. La volonté de la Plateforme Créative est d’accueillir dans l’école à Marseille tous les publics, sans pré-requis de diplôme et sans conditions de ressources.
Le pôle jeunesse de la Plateforme conçoit et organise des ateliers pour les 12-18 ans pour favoriser des pratiques numériques créatives, saines et équilibrées, faire découvrir des métiers et susciter des vocations. Une attention particulière est portée sur les publics féminins et les jeunes issus des quartiers prioritaires. Le programme Cyberpark fait partie des activités du pôle Jeunesse et a été conçu avec le fonds de dotation Advens For People and Planet.
Le Fonds de dotation Advens for People and Planet créé en 2021 est le partenaire d’impact de l’entreprise Advens, experte en cybersécurité. Le fonds développe des initiatives visant à transformer la société et à renforcer le pouvoir d’agir individuel et collectif. C’est cette vision qui guide nos initiatives, régies en 3 grands piliers dont celui de l’éducation et de l'inclusion. Nous co-créons, finançons et déployons des projets à impact.
Nous sommes fermement convaincus que l’espace numérique commun de confiance est à construire ensemble et qu’il est vecteur d’apprentissage et d’insertion professionnelle durable.

Le programme Cyberpark
Le programme Cyberpark est un programme ludique pour les adolescent.e.s de 14 à 18 ans qui se déroule sur les temps extrascolaires principalement, et notamment pendant les vacances scolaires.
Dans un format de 2 jours, les adolescent.e.s participent à différents ateliers et jeux - dont un escape game - qui les sensibilisent aux usages sains et responsables du numérique et leur font découvrir la cybersécurité et les métiers liés.
Lancé en 2024 à Marseille, Cyberpark se déploie depuis juillet 2025 dans plusieurs villes de France, dont Lille.

Dans le cadre de ce déploiement, nous recherchons des animateur.rices sur Marseille, Lille et Ile-de-France.
Ces animateur.rice.s seront formé.e.s par nos équipes pour acquérir la méthode d'animation Cyberpark, et prendront ensuite leur poste de vacataire au sein d'un binôme d'animateur.rice.s. Ils seront managés par l'équipe pilote de Cyberpark.

Profil recherché

L'animateur.rice Cyberpark devra être doté.e :
- D’un talent pour l’animation (BAFA ou expérience significative obligatoire) : ll/elle sait accueillir et animer en toute sécurité un groupe d’adolescent.e.s, il /elle crée la dynamique de groupe, il/elle sait faire preuve de médiation et d’écoute, il/elle propose et participe à des jeux dans les temps de pause des ateliers et de repas.
- D’une appétence forte pour le numérique : il/elle devra animer les contenus des ateliers de Cyberpark. En plus de la formation qui sera délivrée par la Plateforme, il/elle montrera une réelle appétence pour le numérique de façon générale, et pour les problématiques de prévention numérique et de cybersécurité en particulier.
• 

- D’une envie de transmettre et de s’engager : Cyberpark et plus largement notre école se donnent pour mission d’accompagner la jeunesse dans leur acculturation numérique, mais aussi de leur donner des outils pour développer leur confiance, notamment pour leur orientation. Cyberpark vise 50% de public en quartier prioritaire et 50% de jeunes filles. Notre animateur.rice a donc l’envie de s’engager dans un projet éducatif à impact.

Autres compétences

• Appétence pour le travail en équipe et pour l’apprentissage

• Adaptabilité

• Polyvalence

• Sens pédagogique & bienveillance

• Aisance relationnelle

• Patience et disponibilité

Contrat
Contrat vacataire ou Freelance
Missions ponctuelles par créneau de 2 jours consécutifs.
Période de forte activité à prévoir pendant les vacances scolaires.

CDD possible en fonction des disponibilités.

Une période de formation rémunérée et obligatoire est prévue . 
Tous les déplacements seront couverts par l'entreprise.

Rémunération : Entre 12€ et 15€ BRUT de l'heure selon expérience

La Plateforme est la Grande école du numérique pour tous basée à Marseille avec plusieurs antennes en France. Cofondée avec le Club Top 20 réunissant les grandes entreprises de la Métropole Aix Marseille, l’école propose une offre de formations diversifiées et certifiantes dans le domaine de l’informatique et des technologies. La Plateforme_ est reconnue Établissement d’Enseignement Supérieur Technique Privé. La volonté de la Plateforme Créative est d’accueillir dans l’école à Marseille tous les publics, sans pré-requis de diplôme et sans conditions de ressources.
Le pôle jeunesse de la Plateforme conçoit et organise des ateliers pour les 12-18 ans pour favoriser des pratiques numériques créatives, saines et équilibrées, faire découvrir des métiers et susciter des vocations. Une attention particulière est portée sur les publics féminins et les jeunes issus des quartiers prioritaires. Le programme Cyberpark fait partie des activités du pôle Jeunesse et a été conçu avec le fonds de dotation Advens For People and Planet.
Le Fonds de dotation Advens for People and Planet créé en 2021 est le partenaire d’impact de l’entreprise Advens, experte en cybersécurité. Le fonds développe des initiatives visant à transformer la société et à renforcer le pouvoir d’agir individuel et collectif. C’est cette vision qui guide nos initiatives, régies en 3 grands piliers dont celui de l’éducation et de l'inclusion. Nous co-créons, finançons et déployons des projets à impact.
Nous sommes fermement convaincus que l’espace numérique commun de confiance est à construire ensemble et qu’il est vecteur d’apprentissage et d’insertion professionnelle durable.
Le programme Cyberpark
Cyberpark est un programme ludique et immersif destiné aux adolescent·es de 14 à 18 ans, qui se déroule principalement sur les temps extrascolaires et pendant les vacances scolaires. En deux jours, les jeunes participent à des ateliers et jeux variés — dont un escape game — qui les sensibilisent aux usages sains et responsables du numérique et leur font découvrir les métiers de la cybersécurité.
Lancé en 2024 à Marseille, Cyberpark se déploie depuis 2025 dans plusieurs villes de France, dont Lille. Depuis son lancement, plus de 1 200 jeunes ont bénéficié du programme, dont 60 % issus de QPV et 35 % de jeunes filles.

Dans le cadre du programme de l'été à Lille, nous recherchons des bénévoles pour venir en appui de l'équipe d'animation en place.
Vos missions
En tant que bénévole animateur·rice Cyberpark, vous rejoignez l'équipe d'animation sur le terrain à Lille et prenez en charge les missions suivantes :
• Accueillir et animer en toute sécurité un groupe d'adolescent·es

• Créer et maintenir la dynamique de groupe, en pratiquant écoute active et médiation

• Animer les modules pédagogiques Cyberpark (jeux coopératifs, escape game, ateliers techniques OSINT et fact-checking, jeux de cartes)

• Faciliter la découverte des métiers de la cybersécurité auprès des jeunes

• Participer aux temps collectifs et aux échanges avec les professionnels présents lors des sessions

Ce que vous développerez
En vous mobilisant pour une cause de société auprès de la jeunesse, cette expérience vous permet aussi de renforcer des compétences immédiatement valorisables pour votre parcours professionnel :
• Animation & facilitation : gérer la dynamique de groupe, varier les formats, maintenir l'énergie auprès d'un public adolescent

• Pédagogie inclusive : adapter votre posture à chaque profil, encourager la participation de tous quelle que soit leur aisance numérique

• Vulgarisation numérique : maîtriser les fondamentaux de la cybersécurité et les transmettre de façon claire et engageante

• Communication orale : prendre la parole en public avec assurance, créer un climat de confiance et de bienveillance

• Intelligence collective : faciliter la coopération entre pairs et les conditions d'apprentissage collaboratif

• Réflexivité professionnelle : analyser votre pratique d'animation et progresser vers une pleine autonomie

Ce que nous vous apportons
• Une formation initiale certifiée Qualiopi d'environ 30h, obligatoire en début de parcours, avec attestation individuelle délivrée à l'issue

• Tous les supports d'animation fournis (fiches animateur·rice, jeux, quiz, vidéos, scénarios) — vous êtes outillé·e dès le premier jour

• Un suivi et une supervision régulière par l'équipe de coordination de La Plateforme

• Un accès à un réseau professionnel de premier plan en cybersécurité (Advens, Mailinblack, CSIRT Hauts-de-France, ANSSI…)

• Un rapport d'impact disponible pour valoriser votre expérience (portfolio, CV)

Profil recherché
Vous êtes peut-être fait·e pour cette mission si vous avez :
• Une appétence pour l'animation (BAFA ou expérience significative appréciée)

• Un intérêt pour le numérique, la prévention et la transmission

• L'envie de s'engager concrètement dans un projet à impact social auprès du jeune public

Et si vous faites preuve de :
• Sens pédagogique et bienveillance

• Aisance relationnelle et esprit d'équipe

• Adaptabilité, patience et polyvalence

Modalités pratiques
• Format : bénévolat, dès cet été - Stage possible (pas de validation BAFA)

• Volume indicatif : entre 2 et 20 jours par mois d'animation terrain selon disponibilités

• Lieu : Lille Métropole (collèges, lycées, centres sociaux partenaires, Euratechnologies...)

• Formation initiale : environ 30h sur des jours dédiés en amont des sessions

A desire to grow within the AE role for 2-3 years minimum. This is a long-term role with plenty of room for individual development (and significant earning potential!)

Spanish speaking is a plus

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Revenue Operations (RevOps) sits at the center of how Aircall plans, prioritizes, and executes across our go-to-market organization. As we scale toward our next stage of growth and pivot from a cloud telephony business to an AI communications platform, the way we acquire customers — and the way our field teams sell — has to evolve just as fast. We're looking for a Director, Revenue Operations to own Acquisition & AI Ops: the engine behind how we generate pipeline, convert net new sales, and operationalize AI across every field-facing seller.

This is a people leadership role. You'll lead Sales Ops, Partner Ops, and a new AI Ops function, owning the Qualified Pipeline (QP) and Net New Sales (NNS) processes end to end — and going further by embedding AI into the daily workflows of our SDRs, BDRs, AEs, and PAMs. You won't just report on the funnel; you'll redesign how it runs in an AI-first world. You'll partner closely with our Customer Ops leader and our Revenue Planning & Insights leader to deliver one consistent GTM operating model. If you're energized by turning AI from a buzzword into a measurable productivity advantage for hundreds of sellers, this role is for you.

AS A DIRECTOR, REVENUE OPERATIONS, YOU WILL:

• 
Own Acquisition Ops end to end. Lead the Qualified Pipeline (QP) and Net New Sales (NNS) processes across the acquisition motion — from marketing and XDR (SDR/BDR) handoffs through PAM, AE, and SE — ensuring consistent stages, clean data, accurate forecasting, and predictable conversion.

• 
Operationalize AI across the field. Build and run a new AI Ops capability that embeds AI into the daily workflows of SDRs, BDRs, AEs, PAMs, etc. — from prospecting and call intelligence to next-best-action, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene. Define the playbooks, tooling, adoption, and metrics that turn AI into measurable seller productivity.

• 
Lead Sales Ops and Partner Ops. Manage and develop the Sales Ops and Partner Ops teams, setting the standard for rigor, responsiveness, and business partnership across the acquisition org and our partner ecosystem.

• 
Drive one GTM operating model. Partner with the CRO, GMs, and your Customer Ops and Revenue Planning & Insights peers to deliver consistent stages, data, and forecasting across the full revenue lifecycle (Marketing <> XDR <> PAM → AE/SE → AM/CE/FDE), and to design the weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating cadences that keep the business on track.

• 
Partner across the RevOps function. Work hand in hand with Customer Ops (AM Ops, CE Ops, FDE Ops, SE Ops, Support Ops) on land-and-expand and retention motions, and with Revenue Planning & Insights (planning, analytics, PMO, commissions) on targets, capacity, territory and quota design, comp plans, and reporting — so acquisition and customer motions operate as one system.

• 
Build the systems and single source of truth. Partner with Data and GTM Systems to ensure the tooling, data architecture, and dashboards behind acquisition and AI Ops are clean, scalable, and trusted by leadership and the field alike.

• 
Shift the perception of RevOps. Move RevOps from a function that controls the business to one that demonstrably helps it grow — earning the right to lead through reliability, insight, and impact.

A LITTLE MORE ABOUT YOU:

• 
7+ years in revenue operations, sales/GTM operations, or a related function, including significant experience leading and scaling teams — ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

• 
Deep expertise in the acquisition motion: pipeline generation (PG), qualified pipeline (QP), and net new sales (NNS) processes, sales forecasting, territory and quota design, and conversion optimization across SDR/BDR, AE, and partner-led motions.

• 
A track record of operationalizing AI or new tooling for field sellers — not just evaluating tools, but driving adoption, building workflows, and proving productivity impact at scale.

• 
Strong systems and data fluency; comfortable partnering with Data and Systems teams on architecture, reporting, and a trustworthy single source of truth (Salesforce and the broader GTM stack).

• 
Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management; you can align a CRO, GMs, Finance, and operations peers around one operating model and hold the line on consistency.

• 
A builder's bias: you turn ambiguity into repeatable process and structure, and you genuinely enjoy making large GTM teams run better.

• 
Clear written and verbal communication; fluency in English.

• 
Nice to have: experience standing up an AI Ops or sales productivity function, and familiarity with land-and-expand, NRR, and commissions/incentive design.

We are looking for a seasoned Engineering Manager to lead Aircall's Security Engineering organisation. This is a high-impact leadership role spanning four pillars: Product Security, Infrastructure Security, Detection & Response, and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC). You will grow an established team of security engineers, set the technical direction, and partner closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, IT and Finance to embed security deeply across the company. You’ll scale the team through high impact AI engineering across all 4 pillars.

You will be both a skilled people manager and a credible technical leader — someone who can roll up their sleeves when needed but who ultimately scales their impact through their team. You bring empathy, clear communication, and a bias for pragmatic security outcomes over security theatre.

Scope of Responsibility
Product Security

• Own the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) from threat modelling through to production deployment.
Secure Agentic development practices by automating threat modeling, code reviews, internal pentesting and vulnerability remediation by building in-house security AI agents.

• Partner with engineering to embed security reviews, static analysis (SAST), dependency scanning (SCA), and secrets detection into CI/CD pipelines.

• Lead the Aircall Bug Bounty and Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP), triaging and remediating reports with engineering teams.

• Drive regular penetration testing cycles for web, mobile, and API surfaces; oversee remediation tracking.

• Champion a developer-centric security culture through security champions, training, and tooling that makes the secure path the easy path.

Infrastructure Security

• Define and maintain the security architecture of Aircall's cloud infrastructure (AWS), with a strong emphasis on zero-trust, least privilege, and defence in depth.

• Own, maintain and expand security observability through CSPM, CNAPP and CWPP tools like Wiz.

• Enable agentic auto-remediations for security vulnerabilities.

• Own network segmentation, secrets management, certificate lifecycle, identity & access management (IAM), and workload isolation, and secure hosting of internal AI applications

• Lead infrastructure hardening programs: CIS benchmarks, container security, Kubernetes policy enforcement (OPA), and immutable infrastructure practices.

• Manage the security posture of third-party SaaS tools and vendor risk assessments.

• Collaborate with Infrastructure engineering and Product Engineering on shared security responsibilities and runbooks.

Detection & Response

• Build and mature Aircall's threat detection capability — SIEM tuning, alert triage playbooks, and investigation workflows.
Own incident response: develop and test the IR plan, lead tabletop exercises, and act as incident commander for significant security events.

• Drive threat intelligence and threat hunting programs to stay ahead of adversaries targeting the cloud communications sector.

• Establish and track key security metrics: MTTD, MTTR, alert-to-incident conversion rates, and coverage gaps.

• Ensure 24×7 detection coverage through tooling, automation, and on-call rotations, balancing reliability and engineer wellbeing.

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC / Information Security)

• Own and continuously improve Aircall's information security management program, aligned to SOC 2 Type II, and applicable data-protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA).

• Lead audit preparation and evidence collection for external certifications and customer security questionnaires.

• Maintain the corporate risk register for information security, presenting findings and remediation plans to senior leadership and the board as required.

• Define and enforce security policies, standards, and exception processes across the organisation.

• Act as the primary security liaison for enterprise customers, prospects, and partners conducting security due diligence.

People Leadership

• Lead, mentor, and grow a multi-disciplinary security team of 6–10 engineers across the four pillars.

• Run structured 1:1s, career-development conversations, and quarterly goal-setting aligned to company OKRs.

• Hire and onboard exceptional security talent; contribute to employer-branding initiatives in the security community.

• Create an environment where engineers feel psychologically safe to raise concerns, experiment, and learn from failures.

• Balance hands-on technical involvement with delegation — staying close enough to the work to be credible, but trusting the team to execute.

• Partner cross-functionally with Engineering leadership, Legal, People Ops, and Finance to align security initiatives with business priorities.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of professional experience in security engineering.

• 3+ years in an engineering management or technical lead role with direct reports.

• Proven track record of building and scaling security teams in a cloud-native, SaaS environment.

• Deep technical fluency across at least two of the four pillars (Product Security, Infrastructure Security, D&R, GRC).

• Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS strongly preferred, GCP or Azure a plus) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent).

• Experience owning or contributing to SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, or equivalent compliance programmes.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate security risk clearly to non-technical executives and board members.

• Experience running security incident response — from detection through containment, eradication, and post-mortem.

Preferred / Nice to Have

• Background in a high-growth B2B SaaS or cloud-communications company.

• Familiarity with VoIP, real-time communications, or telephony security considerations.

• Experience embedding Agentic AI practices into security engineering workflows and securing internal AI tooling and implementation.

• Relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, AWS Security Specialty, GIAC (GWAPT, GCIA, GCIH), or equivalent.

• Experience running a Bug Bounty programme (HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or similar).

• Contributions to the open-source security community, conference speaking, or published research.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics and the relationship between deployment frequency and security posture.

• 2–8 years or more in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or integration-focused project management.

• Strong command of APIs, webhooks, and data structures (JSON, REST, GraphQL) — able to design and troubleshoot integrations confidently. Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers.

• Hands-on experience with low-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce).

• Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects, working with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating between technical and business audiences.

• A growth mindset — constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability.

• Experience in telephony, voice, or contact center systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT).

• Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake).

• Exposure to scripting (JavaScript/Python) for light customization and debugging.

What Success Looks Like: 

• Consistent delivery of high-quality, scalable AI Agent deployments with clear business outcomes.

• Shortened time-to-first-value and increased automation adoption across SMB customers.

• Reusable frameworks, models, and templates actively used by peers and partners.

• Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product to enhance platform capabilities.

This is a role for builders, connectors, and enablers. This is an enablement role first — and an AI role because of it.

You'll be joining Aircall's GTM Enablement team at a moment when the function is being rebuilt for an AI-native world. Day to day, you'll be doing what great enablement practitioners do: producing content that changes field behaviour, expanding and managing the Aircall Learning Lab, owning the Highspot-to-Confluence content ecosystem, and making sure our GTM teams have sharp, current product knowledge at their fingertips.

The AI piece is real — and genuinely unusual — but it serves the enablement mission. We're piloting a structured AI Operating Model to make the function faster, more consistent, and more scalable. Your job is to help prove it works by doing excellent enablement work with it.

This internship is based in our Aircall Paris office. Duration will be 6 months.

~60%  Enablement Delivery

Content creation, Highspot & Confluence management, Aircall Learning Lab, customer adoption programmes, and GTM product knowledge management. This is the foundation

~40%  AI OS Pilot

Operate and extend a production AI Operating Model built on Claude Code — because it makes the enablement work better, faster, and more consistent.

Key Enablement Responsibilities (~60%) : 

• 
Content Design & Creation

This is where you'll spend most of your time. You'll produce assets that  AEs, AMs, SEs/CEs, SDRs, Customers, and Partners actually open and use — not documentation that collects dust in a folder.

• 
Design and produce enablement content across formats: playbooks, one-pagers, quick-reference guides, training decks, demo scripts, and certification materials

• 
Write for diverse GTM audiences adapting tone, depth, and format to each persona

• 
Develop visual assets and content layouts that follow Aircall brand guidelines and information design principles

• 
Create micro-learning content: short-form guides, checklists, and job aids that reps can use in the flow of work

Highspot & Confluence Content Management

Aircall's content ecosystem is mid-migration from Highspot to Confluence. You'll own meaningful parts of that transition — not just moving files, but improving them and giving the field a better experience on the other side.

• 
Audit existing Highspot content: assess quality, accuracy, and usage data to decide what gets migrated, updated, archived, or retired

• 
Restructure and improve content as it moves into Confluence — tighter copy, cleaner information hierarchy, better discoverability

• 
Build and maintain Confluence spaces and pages that GTM teams actually navigate (not a graveyard of outdated docs)

• 
Track content performance post-migration and flag gaps or stale material proactively

• 
Establish and maintain tagging and taxonomy conventions that make search and surfacing reliable

Aircall Learning Lab — Expansion & Adoption

The Aircall Learning Lab is the Customer and Partner Academy — the place where customers get onboarded, upskilled, and certified on Aircall products. You'll help grow it and drive engagement with it.

• 
Design and build new learning paths and course content for customers and partners, focused on Aircall core product, AI features, and integrations

• 
Develop certification programmes that give customers and partners a meaningful credential and an incentive to engage

• 
Create session outlines, facilitator guides, and resource packs for live and async learning formats

• 
Track learner engagement, completion rates, and certification uptake — and use that data to improve content and structure

• 
Collaborate with CS and Partner teams to understand where customers get stuck and build content that addresses those gaps

• 
Support scaled engagement campaigns that drive customers into learning paths at key moments in the lifecycle (onboarding, feature launch, QBR prep)

Driving Customer Adoption Through Scaled Engagement

Enablement doesn't stop at the internal field team. You'll help design the content and programmes that get customers using Aircall more deeply — especially around AI features and new releases.

• 
Produce customer-facing enablement content tied to product releases: feature guides, use-case walkthroughs, adoption playbooks

• 
Work with CS and PMM to turn launch communications into structured learning moments — not just release notes

• 
Help design and populate customer-facing resources that CS teams can use to drive adoption conversations at scale

• 
Support road show and customer event preparation with content that lands the product story clearly and concisely

GTM Product Knowledge Management

A GTM org is only as effective as its product knowledge is current. You'll be a key part of keeping the internal knowledge base accurate, accessible, and actually used.

• 
Maintain and improve the GTM Knowledge Base structure, navigation, and search experience in Confluence

• 
Partner with Product and PMM to translate new releases into crisp, field-ready content — FAQs, battlecards, one-pagers, talk tracks

• 
Own a content lifecycle process: identify stale content, flag gaps, coordinate updates with SMEs, and publish on time

• 
Support the GTM KB redesign initiative, contributing to information architecture and design system implementation

• 
Serve as the connective tissue between Product launches and field readiness — so no AE is caught off guard by a feature they've never heard of

AI Operating Model Pilot (~40%)

This is the part that makes the role unique — but being a unicorn only makes sense on top of excellent enablement fundamentals.

You'll be embedded in a live experiment: a production AI OS built on Claude Code that gives the enablement function persistent operational memory, deterministic workflows, and a tool ecosystem (Slack, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Jira). The experiment only matters if the enablement output improves. That's the test.

• 
Get onboarded onto the existing AI OS instance and shadow core workflows (/scope, /think, /roadmap, /eow)

• 
Document what works, what's confusing, and what breaks — from a genuinely fresh perspective

• 
Start using Claude Code to accelerate your own enablement tasks: content drafting, KB audits, learning path outlines

Months 2–4: Operate and Extend

• 
Build your own skills for recurring enablement tasks (e.g. "generate a one-pager from a product brief," "audit a KB article against the style guide," "draft a learning path outline from CS call notes")

• 
Write context documents that feed the system's operational memory

• 
Test skill portability — can a workflow you build be used by a teammate with minimal modification?

• 
Begin documenting what a team-wide AI OS looks like vs. a single-operator one

Months 4–6: Design for Scale

• 
Tackle the hard multi-user problems: skill governance, shared vs. personal context, onboarding playbooks, permission models

• 
Define the measurement framework: how do you prove this produces better enablement outcomes, not just faster ones?

• 
Produce the primary deliverable: GTM Enablement AI OS Team Deployment Guide, tested with at least one other team member

• 
Draft the cross-departmental scaling proposal if successful (what changes going from 6 people to 60?)

Qualifications :

Required

• 
Strong writing and content design instincts. You take complex information and make it clear, scannable, and useful for a busy field audience. Documentation, tutorials, course content, structured blogs — all counts.

• 
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Web Development, Digital Communications, or a related field blending technical and communication skills.

• 
Comfortable in a terminal. You don't need to be a senior dev, but you shouldn't be afraid of the command line.

• 
Basic familiarity with git and version control. Branching, committing, PRs — you'll work with markdown files in repos.

• 
Strong written English. The team operates in English; French is a plus for Paris office life.

• 
Genuine curiosity about AI as a productivity tool, not just a novelty — you should have opinions about how LLMs should and shouldn't be used.

Structured thinking. You can break an ambiguous problem into steps and document your reasoning.

Experience creating instructional or educational content — training materials, e-learning modules, how-to guides, technical documentation

Eye for information design — you notice when a document is hard to scan, when a slide buries the point, when a help article doesn't answer the question

Google Apps Script, Confluence administration, or Jira configuration experience

YAML familiarity and prompt engineering concepts

Video editing or multimedia content creation experience

By Month 3

✓  2+ enablement assets shipped and actively used by the field

✓  Highspot content audit complete — migration plan in motion

✓  At least one new Learning Lab module live and tracking engagement

✓  Go-to person for at least one content domain

✓  Independently using the AI OS for your enablement work

✓  3+ original skills built and usable by teammates

✓Highspot-to-Confluence migration complete — content restructured, not just moved

By Month 6

✓  Learning Lab expanded with 

measurable uptick in customer engagement and certifications

✓  GTM KB is current, well-structured, and actively used by field teams

✓  Customer adoption content in place for at least 2 major product areas

✓  AI OS Team Deployment Guide exists and has been tested

✓  Before/after impact documented on 2+ enablement workflows

What You'll Learn

• 
Enablement craft. How to design content and programmes that actually change field and customer behaviour — not just materials that tick a box.

• 
Content ecosystem management. How to run a Highspot-to-Confluence migration without losing institutional knowledge or momentum.

Learning programme design. How to build, launch, and iterate on a Customer and Partner Academy that drives measurable product adoption.

Knowledge management at scale. Information architecture, content lifecycle, multi-audience content strategy.

AI agent system design. How to deploy and govern AI workflows for real business use cases — knowledge that barely exists in the market right now.

Cross-functional collaboration. Working across Sales, CS, Product, PMM, and Engineering teams

• Create and maintain internal troubleshooting documentation

• Strong understanding of VoIP and telephony concepts, including SIP signaling and call routing

• Experience troubleshooting real-time communications issues such as poor audio quality, dropped calls, or call routing failures

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

description:

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

Commissions are one of the most consequential things Revenue Operations owns. Every month and every quarter, the entire go-to-market organization is paid based on numbers we run — and the person who gets them right, on time, and clearly explained earns the trust of the whole field.

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to own that process end to end. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with real ownership from day one. You'll run the full commissions payout cycle — monthly and quarterly — administer our commissions platform, safeguard the data behind every payout, and be the go-to for anyone with a question about how they were paid. And because you'll own the whole process, you'll have the room to improve it: you'll look for ways to make it faster and cleaner, and you'll use AI to take the repetitive work off your plate, so your time goes to the parts that need real judgment. If you like the idea of taking something important and making it run well, this role is for you.

This role will be located out of our Seattle / Bellevue office, working closely with the team in New York and stakeholders in other international locations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the commissions payout cycle. Run calculation, validation, approvals, and on-time payout for both the monthly and quarterly cycles, end to end, in partnership with Finance and Payroll.

• Master CaptivateIQ. Be the owner and administrator of our ICM platform — configuring and maintaining plans, rules, rates, and data feeds, and keeping it the single source of truth for everything commissions-related.

• Safeguard data integrity. Reconcile inputs across Salesforce, Looker, BambooHR, and CaptivateIQ so every payout is accurate, traceable, and audit-ready. When the numbers don't tie out, you find out why.

• Be the go-to for the field. Handle commission inquiries, disputes, and adjustments with clarity and speed, and help reps and managers understand exactly how they're paid.

• Continuously improve the process. Treat "the way it's always been done" as a starting point, not an answer. Constantly look for ways to make the cycle faster, cleaner, and less manual.

• Put AI to work. Use AI to automate the lower-value, repetitive parts of the job — data prep, reconciliation, routine inquiry handling — so the time you spend is on analysis and judgment, not copy-paste.

• Support comp plan rollout. Partner with RevOps and Finance on plan design, modeling, and clean implementation each planning cycle.

• Report on commissions. Give leadership clear, trustworthy visibility into commission spend and attainment.

Required Qualifications:

• 
3+ years in sales compensation / commissions administration, sales/GTM operations, RevOps, or FP&A — ideally in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.

• 
Hands-on mastery of CaptivateIQ (or a comparable ICM tool, such as Qobra), including plan configuration and day-to-day administration.

• 
Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills; comfortable working with large data sets, CRM and BI tool data (Salesforce & Looker).

• 
Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, with a track record of hitting payout deadlines without exception.

• 
A genuine process-improvement instinct — you're never quite satisfied with the current state and you enjoy making things run better.

• 
Real fluency with AI tools and a habit of reaching for them to automate repetitive work.

• 
Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to handle sensitive compensation conversations discreetly.

• 
Fluency in English. Other languages are a plus.

• 
Nice to have: familiarity with RevOps/GTM metrics, comp plan design, and partnering with FP&A.

Within Aircall, we are launching a specialized New Product Unit to build the future of autonomous sales. We are improving the AI Orchestration Layer—a system that records and understands every customer interaction (calls, video, email, WhatsApp) to autonomously execute sales workflows: CRM updates, follow-ups, task creation, and coaching insights.  Our long-term vision is to evolve this into a self-improving, agentic Sales OS—where specialized AI agents collaborate, coordinate, and continuously optimize the revenue process.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to join Aircall. This is a unique role where you will act as our founding designer. It is a fast, lean, and obsessively accountable. You will be the design voice of the product: the person who owns the experience end-to-end, sets the quality bar, and makes the calls that shape how thousands of sales people interact with AI every day.

This is not a role where you wait for tickets. You will improve what exists, fix the legacy we've accumulated while moving fast, and design what's coming next — the future of AI in voice and communication. You'll do all three at once, and you'll decide which trade-offs are worth making to ship.

This role is for someone senior and self-directed — someone who already knows what good UI and good UX look like, and doesn't need a playbook to get there. You understand design systems, interaction patterns, and the difference between polish that matters and polish that doesn't. You move fast without losing craft, and you know perfection is the enemy of progress in a startup.

You'll partner extremely closely with our Leadership team — but you're expected to challenge, not just execute. You'll bring opinions, defend them, and change your mind when the user proves you wrong. And you'll stay close to the client: discovering problems on calls, in data, and in the product itself, sometimes together and sometimes entirely on your own.

What You’ll Do

In this role you will own product design end-to-end — from discovery and interaction design to high-fidelity execution and the design system that holds it all together.

Design & Craft

• Own the experience: Drive the end-to-end product experience — flows, interaction design, and high-fidelity UI — for a complex AI product used daily by sales teams.

• Fix the legacy: Audit and systematically improve the experience and visual debt we've accumulated while moving fast, raising the overall quality bar without halting momentum.

• Design what's next: Translate the agentic, AI-native vision into concrete, usable interfaces — making novel AI interactions feel obvious and trustworthy.

• Design system: Build and evolve a pragmatic, scalable design system in Figma that lets us ship consistently and fast.

• AI-augmented workflow: Make AI a core part of your daily craft — to design and prototype faster, brainstorm and explore more directions, and accelerate the everyday work. We expect you to push how far AI can take a designer's workflow.

Discovery & Partnership

• Stay close to the client: Talk to users, sit in on calls, dig into product data, and surface the real problems worth solving — independently or alongside the team.

• Partner and challenge: Work hand-in-hand with the tech team and product founder; bring strong, well-reasoned opinions and the willingness to push back and explore alternatives together.

• Make trade-offs: Decide what to ship now versus later, what's worth the craft, and what's good enough — and communicate those decisions clearly.

• Work with engineering: Collaborate tightly with frontend engineers (NextJS, Tailwind) to ensure what ships matches the intent and feels right in the hands of users.

What We're Looking For

Core Design

• 5+ years of senior product design experience, ideally shipping complex B2B/SaaS or AI products.

• A strong portfolio that demonstrates mastery of UX and UI — you know the good practices, the good patterns, and when to break them.

• Fluency in Figma and modern design-system thinking.

• Comfort designing for ambiguity: novel AI interactions, data-heavy workflows, and products that change weekly.

• Strong sense of interaction detail, visual craft, and information hierarchy.

Mindset

• You are fast. You ship, iterate, and learn rather than polish in a vacuum.

• You are extremely accountable — you own outcomes, not just deliverables.

• You think like a founder: you make trade-offs, prioritize ruthlessly, and move.

• You challenge constructively and stay close to real users and their real problems.

• You're excited about AI as a design material, not just a feature.

International Environment

• Communication skills are a must — you'll sync constantly with stakeholders from Product, Engineering, and Business; you need to be willing to stay close to our users and their real problems.

• Fluency in English is required, and Spanish  is a plus.

Tools & Stack

• Design: Figma, modern design systems

• Frontend (partnered with): NextJS, Tailwind

• Product: AI-native, agentic workflows for revenue teams

• Optimize performance, latency, cost, and reliability of AI-driven systems. 

• Build and orchestrate LLM-powered agents (planning, reasoning, tool usage, memory). 

• Develop internal frameworks to manage: 

• Agent coordination 

• Tool execution 

• Memory layers 

• Event-driven workflows 

• Work closely with AI engineers, product, and founders to transform complex sales workflows into autonomous processes. 

• Use AI coding assistants effectively and experiment with AI-augmented development workflows. 

What We’re Looking For

• 7+ years of strong backend engineering experience. 

• Advanced Python expertise (async, typing, architecture patterns, testing)

• Experience designing scalable distributed systems. 

• You design thoughtful, well-architected systems and write clean, high-quality code, with a focus on performance and long-term maintainability.

• Experience with GCP (preferred) or AWS. 

• Mindset: You’re energized by building systems that can reason and take action—not just generate responses.

• You actively leverage AI coding assistants and are driven to push the boundaries of AI-augmented engineering.

• You thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ownership is real and impact is immediate.

As Aircall continues its transition from a multi-product company to an AI-first platform, product complexity and expectations around value articulation are increasing for both sellers and buyers. Ensuring deep product understanding—across Core, Integrations, and AI—is now critical to driving adoption and growth.

To support this shift, we are investing further in our Product Enablement motion by hiring a Product Enablement & Education Team Lead to own the end-to-end Product Enablement motion across buyers and sellers, both strategically and operationally. This role combines team leadership, operating model ownership, and hands-on contribution to high-impact enablement and education initiatives. The role is central to ensuring our teams and customers can confidently understand, adopt, and articulate the full value of the Aircall platform and our AI suite of products.

Responsibilities:
• Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Ownership
- Lead, coach, and develop Product Enablement and Customer Education Specialists, setting clear priorities, standards, and ways of working.
- Own & define the roadmap across seller & buyer enablement (certifications, GTM Kits, demos, internal programs, Aircall Learning Lab & Knowledge Base content strategy), ensuring enablement is mapped to release calendars.  
- Define and evolve the Product Enablement operating model across processes, tooling, and rituals to support customers as well as Sales and Support teams.
- Act as the primary enablement counterpart to Product and Product Marketing, ensuring tight alignment between product strategy, launches, and enablement execution.
- Partner closely with Customer Marketing to ensure product enablement and education are integrated into customer-facing communications, including webinars and campaigns.

- Own the strategy, structure, and governance of the Aircall Learning Lab and Knowledge Base, ensuring content quality and relevance for our customers, with the support of the Customer Education Specialist. 
- Develop an intentional content strategy and framework to allow optimized content ingestion by AI (e.g. Aircall AI Chat or Aircall AI Agent).
- Continuously optimize the customer onboarding learning journey in the Aircall Learning Lab in collaboration with Small Business leadership, enabling scalable, self-service onboarding for 1–10 user accounts.
- Design and deliver strategic courses for Tier 1 product launches within the Aircall Learning Lab.
- Contribute hands-on to strategic enablement initiatives when needed, particularly for priority launches or high-impact programs.

• Demonstrated experience supporting or enabling GTM teams, customers, or partners within Aircall.
• Prior exposure to Product Enablement, Sales Enablement, Customer Education, Product Marketing, or Customer Success motions.

title: STAGE - Développement durable et Business development (F/H)

title: STAGE – Chef de Projet Transformation & IA (F/H)

description:

Vous analysez l’impact des évolutions réglementaires sur notre cadre global de gouvernance, de risques et de contrôles (GRC), priorisez les actions à mener et coordonnez les différentes parties prenantes jusqu’à leur mise en œuvre. Vous contribuez ainsi à maintenir un dispositif de conformité cohérent, efficace et adapté à un environnement réglementaire en constante évolution.

Vos missions :
- Piloter et faire évoluer les processus opérationnels de gestion des demandes de conformité, en identifiant les points de blocage et les opportunités d’amélioration.
- Analyser l’impact des nouvelles exigences réglementaires et des évolutions de standards sur le cadre GRC et le modèle de contrôles du Groupe, identifier les écarts et proposer les évolutions nécessaires.

- Travailler dans un environnement international et matriciel, en coordonnant plusieurs sujets de conformité en parallèle et en arbitrant les priorités en fonction des enjeux et des échéances.

title: STAGE - Ingénieur IA Machine Learning NLP (F/H)
description:
Le stage se déroulera au sein de l’équipe R&D de NETVIBES, responsable du développement de Text Intelligence Studio, notre plateforme avancée d’analyse sémantique. Cette solution combine approches symboliques, techniques de Machine Learning et Large Language Models (LLM) pour extraire de la valeur à partir de données textuelles multilingues.
L’équipe est composée de spécialistes passionnés d’IA et de NLP, avec une expertise reconnue depuis de nombreuses années dans le traitement du langage naturel.
Vos Missions
Vous travaillerez sur des problématiques concrètes à partir de documents techniques, avec un accès direct à une infrastructure AI haute performance (GPU NVIDIA type H100, stack de serving de modèles).
Vous allez étudier et optimiser des approches de deep learning pour des taches NLP comme extraction de donnée structurée à partir d'un document, ou de la NER, avec un focus sur l’équilibre entre qualité du modèle (précision, robustesse) et performance opérationnelle (coût, latence, consommation mémoire, throughput).
Le cas d’usage central est l’extraction de données structurées à partir de documents PDF techniques (documents longs, structurés en sections, contenant des tableaux).
Le stage vise à :
•    Étudier et évaluer des architectures et stratégies d’optimisation adaptées aux tâches NLP (fine-tuning, distillation, modèles spécialisés, prompting avancé, RAG, etc.), suppose - génération de données synthétiques pour construire les jeux d’entraînement
•    Optimiser le compromis qualité / coût / performance en comparant différentes approches et en mesurant leur impact sur des métriques concrètes
•    Proposer des recommandations industrialisables pour réduire le coût d’extraction sans dégrader (voire en améliorant) la qualité
•    La spécialisation de modèles (fine-tuning, distillation, adaptation de domaine)

Au cours de ce stage, vous serez amené(e) à :
•    Concevoir et évaluer des expériences : définir des protocoles de test, mesurer la qualité (précision, rappel, F1) et la performance (latence, coût GPU, throughput)
•    Générer et annoter des datasets synthétiques : utiliser des LLM pour produire des exemples d’entraînement réalistes, valider leur qualité, itérer sur les prompts et les stratégies de génération
•    Spécialiser des modèles de langage : fine-tuner des modèles open-weight (Llama, Mistral, etc.) sur des tâches NLP (i.e. extraction d’entités)
•    Benchmarker des approches d’optimisation : comparer prompting vs fine-tuning vs modèles spécialisés, évaluer l’impact de la quantification, du KV-cache, du batching, et du serving optimisé (vLLM, SGLang, etc.)
•    Documenter et industrialiser : versionner les expériences (MLflow, Git), containeriser les pipelines (Docker/Podman), et produire une documentation technique claire

Vos qualifications
Etudiant.e en formation Bac+5 (école d’ingénieurs, master recherche) avec une spécialisation IA, NLP, Data Science ou domaine équivalent, vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.
Compétences requises : 
•    Bonne maîtrise de Python et d’un framework de deep learning (PyTorch ou equivalent)
•    Première expérience et connaissances deep learning et les techniques de prompting, fine-tuning, ou adaptation de domaine
•    Autonomie, rigueur, et force de proposition
Compétences appréciées :

title: Ingénieur Logiciel Rust - Serveur de stockage Git (F/H)
description:
Rejoignez notre équipe R&D au cœur de l’innovation en ingénierie système.
Nous développons une solution SaaS conçue autour de l’IA et de SysML v2 pour accompagner la conception, l’analyse, la validation et l’exploitation de systèmes complexes dans l’aéronautique, l’automobile, la défense, l’énergie, le transport et l’industrie.
Avec SysML v2, la modélisation système devient « as code » : le modèle s’écrit, se versionne et s’outille comme un langage de programmation moderne. Nous construisons la chaîne complète, du parsing et du modèle sémantique aux services de langage et aux API, jusqu’à un IDE web et une extension VS Code. La performance sur les grands modèles est un enjeu central.
Poste de Software Engineer Rust en CDI, basé à Vélizy-Villacoublay.
Votre mission
Vous participez à la création, en Rust, d’un service de stockage Git distribué et multi-tenant. Ce service devra répondre à un trafic soutenu d’utilisateurs et d’agents IA qui clonent, lisent et poussent des dépôts en parallèle.
Votre périmètre principal est le serveur qui stocke et sert les dépôts Git. Vous travaillez en lien étroit avec la personne responsable du coordinateur de réplication et avec l’équipe qui développe le serveur applicatif frontal.
Accompagné·e par des ingénieurs expérimentés, vous prendrez progressivement en charge :
• Les opérations Git côté serveur : lecture des objets et des références, gestion des packs, prise en charge des échanges Git et maintenance des dépôts
• Les API internes utilisées par le serveur frontal et le coordinateur de réplication
• L’amélioration des performances pour les clones répétés, les fetchs incrémentaux et les écritures concurrentes
• L’observabilité du service : métriques, traces et diagnostic des incidents
• Les tests de non-régression et de charge, ainsi que la documentation des choix techniques
Vous contribuerez également à préparer la réplication, notamment à travers les transactions sur les références et le suivi de l’état des dépôts.
Qualifications
Vous avez une première expérience en développement logiciel, acquise en emploi, en alternance, en stage ou dans un projet open source significatif. Vous pratiquez Rust ou avez déjà développé des composants systèmes dans un autre langage et souhaitez vous investir durablement dans Rust.
Vous comprenez les bases du réseau, des entrées-sorties, de la concurrence et de Linux. Vous aimez comprendre le fonctionnement d’un système en profondeur, mesurer ses performances et construire du code fiable, testé et lisible.
Une connaissance des mécanismes internes de Git — objets, packs, références ou protocoles — sera appréciée. Une expérience avec Kubernetes / Helm. Aucune connaissance préalable de SysML ou de l’ingénierie système n’est requise.
Vous pouvez travailler et échanger en français ou en anglais ; la documentation technique est rédigée en anglais.

Votre environnement
La stack comprend Rust, Kubernetes, Base de données SQL, Kafka, stockage objet et Helm.
Vous travaillerez directement avec les responsables techniques et produit, dans un cadre de décisions rapides et de revues de code exigeantes.
Les attentes de nos clients dans l’aéronautique et la défense placent la fiabilité, la traçabilité et la sécurité au centre du travail quotidien.
