Pernod Ricard, leader mondial des spiritueux premium, recherche un·e Infirmier·ère Santé au Travail pour accompagner ses collaborateurs et contribuer à une culture solide de santé, sécurité et prévention.
Vous évoluerez au sein d’un environnement international, pluridisciplinaire, structuré et exigeant, à l’image des plus grands groupes français.

Votre rôle

En tant qu’Infirmier·ère Santé au Travail, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la préservation de la santé des salariés et le développement d’un cadre de travail sûr et bienveillant.
Vous serez hiérarchiquement rattaché.e au service des Ressources Humaines, et sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle du médecin du travail (service de santé au travail inter-entreprise)

La discrétion, le respect du secret médical et la confidentialité absolue constituent des dimensions essentielles du poste.

Missions principales

1. Soins, urgences et suivi individuel
• Assurer les soins infirmiers dans le respect des protocoles.
• Réaliser les entretiens infirmiers d’information et de prévention (campagnes de vaccination, dépistages...)
• Réaliser toutes les visites médicales d’embauche des salariés temporaires
• Assurer la prise en charge des urgences sur notre site parisien (malaise, accident du travail, premiers secours).
• Tenir à jour les dossiers médicaux en garantissant une stricte confidentialité.

2. Gestion médico-administrative
• Organiser les visites médicales (convocations, suivi, dossiers) dans le respect et l’anticipation des délais légaux.
• Assurer la gestion de l’infirmerie et des stocks (matériel, pharmacie, dispositifs médicaux).
• Réaliser toutes les déclarations d’Accident du travail pour le siège et tenir le cahier des incidents bénins
• Préparer les reportings santé et assurer la traçabilité des activités du service.
• Coordonner avec les Ressources Humaines, le Médecin du Travail et les équipes sécurité.

3. Prévention, accompagnement et actions collectives
• Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation et de prévention (sommeil, nutrition, addictions, risques psychosociaux..)
• En collaboration avec nos équipes dédiées chez Pernod Ricard, identifier les risques professionnels et contribuer à la mise à jour des documents de prévention : DUERP, bilans annuels, fiches d’entreprise.
• En collaboration avec les services mandatés par le médecin du travail, participer aux études de postes, diagnostics terrain, et actions avec les instances internes.

4. Accompagnement individuel et maintien dans l’emploi
• Suivre les préconisations médicales et les restrictions d’aptitude.
• Soutenir les salariés en situation de handicap ou présentant des pathologies chroniques.
• Favoriser l’adaptation du poste et les démarches de maintien dans l’emploi.
• Établir un lien de confiance grâce à l’écoute, l’empathie et la confidentialité.
• Assurer une écoute active et orienter vers les acteurs internes/externes (médecin du travail, psychologue du travail, assistante sociale…).
• Participer à la détection précoce de situations de stress, RPS, harcèlement ou isolement.

5. Qualité de service, confiance et confidentialité
• Garantir une posture professionnelle irréprochable, fondée sur l’indépendance et la neutralité entre les différentes parties prenantes.
• Veiller à une gestion discrète de toutes les situations médicales.
• Contribuer à un service attentif, bienveillant et orienté satisfaction collaborateurs.

6. Référent Handicap & Accompagnement des collaborateurs
• Être identifié·e et reconnu·e comme référent·e Handicap au sein de l’entreprise.
• Accompagner les salariés dans leurs démarches administratives (constitution et dépôt des dossiers MDPH, demande de RQTH, renouvellements...)
• Participer à la mise en place d’actions de sensibilisation au handicap en entreprise (ateliers de prévention, sessions d’information, interventions lors de temps forts (Semaine Européenne pour l’Emploi des Personnes Handicapées, campagnes internes…).
• Contribuer à la promotion d’un environnement inclusif en veillant à l’équité, la neutralité et l’accessibilité pour tous.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans la description ci-dessous, n'hésitez pas à postuler pour nous rejoindre !

Formation

• Formation complémentaire en Santé au Travail (type DIUST, licence professionnelle ou équivalente)
• Détenir son monitorat de Sauveteur Secouriste du Travail serait un plus

Expérience
• Expérience significative en santé au travail ou environnement similaire.
• Maîtrise des gestes d’urgence et de la prévention en entreprise.

Compétences clés
• Sens aigu de la confidentialité et de la déontologie.
• Excellentes capacités relationnelles et sens du service.

• Connaissance des risques professionnels et des obligations réglementaires.

Travail étroit avec les équipes RH, H&S, Référents handicap, CSE/CSSCT, Médecine du Travail…)
Relations avec les services d’urgence (SAMU,pompiers) les Prestataires de prévention, Organismes spécialisés (AGEFIPH, ergonomes, psychologues du travail…).

title: Data Platform Intern - Paris - March 2027
description:
Do you want to join a fast-moving company and work among convivial teams? Pernod Ricard is looking for its next Intern for Data Platform, starting in March 2027 for 6 months.  

Context
As the Data Platform team, our mission is not to build business use cases ourselves—but to empower the teams who do. We act as enablers, providing the tools, infrastructure, and standards that allow data consumers across the organization to build, scale, and operate their own data products efficiently and securely.
To achieve this, we focus on delivering a “Triple S” data platform—Standardized, Scalable, and Secure. This means:

• Standardized: We define and promote best practices, governance models, and reusable components to ensure consistency and interoperability across teams.
• Scalable: We design and maintain a platform that can grow with the business, supporting increasing data volumes, users, and use cases without compromising performance.
• Secure: We embed security and compliance at the core of our architecture, ensuring data is protected and access is well-managed.

Our platform underpins a wide range of data-driven activities at Pernod Ricard, including the 10,000+ Power BI reports used globally. These reports rely on a robust and performant Snowflake-based data infrastructure, along with a network of integrated systems and services that we continuously monitor, optimize, and evolve.

Ultimately, our goal is to provide reliable, future-proof data foundations that enable business teams to focus on what matters most: creating value from data.

Your key mission 
• Become a part of the Data Platform team, owning and delivering topics with autonomy but also collaboration
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of the data platform, including data pipelines, data quality monitoring, and platform automation.
• Support data ingestion and transformation workflows using modern data tools (e.g.,  dbt, snowflake, etc.).
• Collaborate with data engineers and product teams to ensure data availability, reliability, and scalability across use cases.
• Participate in the documentation, standardization and communication of data platform components, processes, and best practices.
• Explore and prototype new tools or frameworks that could enhance the performance, observability, or usability of the platform.

If you recognize yourself in the description below, don’t wait to apply! 

• Currently enrolled in an engineering school or Master’s program with a specialization in Data, Computer Science, or related fields.
• Strong foundation in data engineering concepts, including SQL, Python, and distributed data processing.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern data stack tools is a plus.
• Analytical mindset and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and curious attitude.

description:
Want to join a fast-moving company, work among convivial teams, and take part in the global growth strategy of one of the most prestigious and comprehensive portfolios in the wine & spirits industry? We are looking for a Global Corporate Strategy & M&A Senior Manager! You will be based at The Island, our office in central Paris.

Your key missions:

Reporting to the Global Corporate Strategy & M&A Director within the Group Finance department, you will help shape and implement Pernod Ricard’s corporate strategy and M&A agenda, combining strategic analysis with end-to-end deal execution and providing fact-based recommendations to senior management.

• You will contribute to defining the Group’s M&A priorities, target universe and key areas of strategic interest.

• You have proven coordination skills in cross-functional and international environments, and the ability to lead projects and mobilize senior internal and external stakeholders without direct reports.

• You have a strategic mindset, you drive results and you adapt your approach to each situation.
• You are committed to excellence and uphold high professional and ethical standards.

Wait, there’s more…
We offer you an outstanding and collaborative workplace that embodies our sharing & conviviality culture, the possibility to work remotely (up to 2 days a week), a very complete mutual insurance, an attractive compensation including profit-sharing, the possibility to train daily, employee events…

description:
Vous aimez comprendre comment fonctionne réellement une ligne de production, travailler avec les conducteurs de machine et améliorer concrètement leur quotidien ?
Nous recherchons pour notre site de Lormont une personne de terrain pour accompagner les équipes de conditionnement dans l’amélioration de leurs pratiques.
Vous serez principalement présent(e) dans l’atelier, au contact des conducteurs et des équipements.

Concrètement, que ferez-vous ?
Votre première étape sera de vous familiariser avec les lignes de conditionnement et les différents postes de travail. Vous serez formé(e) sur le terrain afin de comprendre les machines, les contraintes des conducteurs et le fonctionnement quotidien de l’atelier.
Vous travaillerez ensuite sur des sujets très concrets :
• Observer les postes de travail et identifier les améliorations possibles en matière de méthode, sécurité, qualité, hygiène, ergonomie ou organisation ;
• Mettre à jour et finaliser les fiches de poste, modes opératoires et books métier utilisés pour former les nouveaux arrivants ;
• Analyser les non-conformités de production et presque-accidents, rechercher leurs causes et suivre les actions correctives ;
• Accompagner les conducteurs de machine dans l’utilisation d’outils d’amélioration continue : 5S, SMED, résolution de problèmes ;
• Vérifier sur le terrain que les standards de travail sont bien compris et appliqués ;
• Participer à l’intégration et à la montée en compétences des nouveaux collaborateurs ;
• Poursuivre l’utilisation d’un outil digital simple de communication et de suivi des actions en production ;
• Faciliter les échanges entre production, maintenance, qualité et les autres services lorsqu’un problème doit être résolu collectivement.
Selon les besoins de l’activité, vous pourrez également être amené(e), à venir ponctuellement en soutien des équipes sur une ligne de conditionnement.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si…
Vous appréciez résoudre des problèmes concrets avec les opérateurs dans l’atelier.
Vous êtes à l’aise pour observer, poser des questions, rédiger un mode opératoire simple, expliquer une méthode, suivre une action jusqu’à sa clôture et travailler avec des personnes aux métiers très différents.
Nous recherchons une formation Bac +2 / Bac +3 en production industrielle, maintenance, qualité, méthodes ou amélioration continue, ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente.
Vous avez une première expérience d’environ en environnement industriel. Elle peut avoir été acquise comme technicien(ne) méthodes, technicien(ne) qualité terrain, conducteur(trice) de ligne ayant participé à des démarches d’amélioration continue, assistant(e) amélioration continue ou dans une fonction similaire.
Une excellente maîtrise du français écrit et oral est indispensable pour rédiger les supports et accompagner les équipes. Un niveau d’anglais professionnel est également attendu dans notre environnement international.

title: Stage Analyse Sensorielle - Thuir - Mars 2027
description:
Vous voulez rejoindre une entreprise française emblématique et participer au rayonnement de marques prestigieuses comme Havana Club, Ricard, Absolut Lillet, Ballantine’s, Chivas ou encore Perrier-Jouët? Contexte du stage
Au sein du service TCOE et Qualité Usine, le/la stagiaire aura pour mission de structurer et développer l'activité d'analyse sensorielle du site de production. L'objectif principal est d'optimiser le panel interne existant dans le cadre de l'amélioration continue (habiliter, former et entraîner), puis d'accompagner la mise en place d'une méthodologie fiable et durable pour les tests sensoriels.

Missions principales

·       Identifier et recruter un panel de collaborateurs issus de métiers variés.
·       Habiliter les membres du panel sur des critères choisis (discrimination, reconnaissance d'arômes, reproductibilité...).

·       Suivre la motivation, l'assiduité et les performances des panélistes.

·       Participer à la définition des besoins : analyses discriminatives, descriptives, hédoniques.

·       Créer une trame méthodologique applicable après le stage.

3. Organisation et animation des séances de dégustation

·       Saisir et exploiter les résultats.

4. Rédaction et structuration documentaire

·       Élaborer les fiches d'instructions et guides de bonnes pratiques.
·       Concevoir les supports de formation pour les panélistes.
·       Rédiger les comptes-rendus d'essais.

5. Participation au fonctionnement du laboratoire sensoriel
·       Organisation matérielle de l'espace de dégustation.
·       Mise en place d'indicateurs de performance du panel.
·       Suivi des optimisations qualité et projets R&D nécessitant un support sensoriel.

Profil recherché

title: Global Tech Process Expert – SAP SD/MM & Intercompany
description:
LEAP is one of the major transformation programs currently at Pernod Ricard. It is focused on designing and building our future-proof ERP system, enabling the harmonization of all transactional processes across the Group. As part of this large-scale transformation program, the Global Tech Process Expert – SAP SD/MM & Intercompany will play a critical role in ensuring that Order-to-Cash (SD), Procure-to-Pay (MM), Intercompany processes and API-based integrations are accurately defined, designed, developed, and implemented within the SAP S/4HANA Private Edition landscape. This role requires deep expertise in SAP SD and MM modules, strong knowledge of intercompany flows (including Advanced Intercompany), and solid experience in API-based integrations, from both business and technology perspectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Process Design
• Act as a subject matter expert for SAP SD/MM processes, intercompany flows and API-based integrations.

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Finance, logistics and IT stakeholders to understand, challenge and translate functional requirements into robust and scalable SAP solutions.

• Contribute to the design of end-to-end intercompany processes, including Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay (standard and Advanced Intercompany).

• Ensure consistency and integration across modules (SD, MM, FI/CO, TM, WMS, PP-PI, QM).

• Define integration patterns using APIs (synchronous/asynchronous) to connect SAP with external applications through a centralized middleware.

• Contribute to documenting user stories and detailed functional specifications including processes, data models, interfaces and API contracts (payloads, endpoints, error handling).

• Secure convergence (standardization & harmonization) while fostering automation, scalability and data reliability.

• Stay up to date with SAP best practices, S/4HANA innovations and API-first integration strategies.

Build & Test
• Contribute to the documentation of use cases, test scenarios, test scripts and data migration strategy.

• Configure and customize SAP S/4HANA SD/MM functionalities including sales, billing, procurement and intercompany flows.

• Design and validate SAP standard APIs (OData, SOAP) and custom APIs via SAP Integration Suite / middleware.

• Work closely with development teams to implement and secure RICEFW objects and API integrations.

• Ensure proper end-to-end integration testing via APIs across SD, MM, FI and logistics systems.

• Support and lead testing phases (unit testing, integration testing, UAT).

• Ensure data integrity, consistency and performance of API integrations.

• Support the definition and execution of cut-over strategy.

Training & Roll-Out
• Contribute to training material documentation and deliver sessions to key users.

• Support roll-out strategy and deployment across entities, ensuring integration readiness.

Post Go-Live / Hypercare
• Support post go-live activities from both functional and technical perspectives.

• Monitor API integrations, interfaces and message flows in production.

• Troubleshoot and resolve system or integration issues.

• Support business teams to stabilize processes and ensure adoption.

Project Management
• Report on activities within the Program Management framework.

• Anticipate risks, identify deviations and propose mitigation actions.

• Ensure delivery aligns with timeline, quality and budget expectations.

• Promote CORE model solutions and SAP best practices.

Key Interactions
• Strong interactions with Supply Chain, Finance, IT teams, integration partners and external platforms (3PL, carriers).

• Facilitate workshops, design sessions and decision-making forums.

• Drive alignment on intercompany and integration design.

• Ensure strong documentation discipline and transparent communication.

YOUR PROFILE
• You have strong expertise in SAP SD and MM within SAP S/4HANA Private Edition. 

• You bring proven experience with intercompany processes, including Advanced Intercompany. 

• You have solid experience with API-based integrations, including OData, REST, SOAP, and SAP Integration Suite / CPI. 

• You have a good understanding of SAP BTP integration services and middleware architectures. 

• You are familiar with authentication mechanisms (OAuth, certificates), as well as integration monitoring and error handling. 

• You can design scalable, resilient integration architectures that support complex business processes. 

• You combine strong analytical capabilities with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Nice to have
• You have knowledge of SAP TM and eWM. 

• You have experience within the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry. 

• You have exposure to the beverage industry. 

• You are familiar with excise products and related regulatory requirements. 

• You have contributed to global transformation or SAP rollout programs.

WAIT THERE IS MORE 
We offer you an outstanding and collaborative workplace that embodies our sharing & conviviality culture, the possibility to work remotely (up to 2 days a week), a very complete mutual insurance, an attractive compensation including profit‑sharing, continuous learning opportunities, employee events, and more.

description:

En tant que graphiste stagiaire chez Pernod Ricard, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler avec plusieurs des marques les plus passionnantes du monde des vins et spiritueux. Ces marques ont un héritage très fort, mais se développent rapidement et s’adaptent à la mondialisation.

Vous êtes rattaché au responsable du design produit. Votre principale responsabilité est de développer et de mettre en œuvre des produits et des outils graphiques performants tout en respectant les objectifs de la stratégie de la marque.

Vos missions clés :
• Vous aidez à la création de l'identité graphique des marques : logos, emballages et étiquettes, affichage, mises en page (invitations, ppt, kit de relations presse...).
• Vous êtes en relation avec l'équipe marketing, les équipes de développement packaging, les marchés.
• Vous êtes le point de contact reconnu pour toutes les demandes et tous les besoins en matière de conception graphique.
• Vous accompagnez la création des fichiers techniques, des rendus 2D et des modèles pour les productions.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans la description ci-dessous, n’hésitez pas à postuler !
• Vous êtes actuellement en formation de design graphique et devez réaliser un stage de césure ou de fin d'étude
• Vous êtes très créatif et passionné par ce que vous faites
• Vous êtes dynamique, vous avez le souci du détail, de la qualité et vous êtes organisé(e)
• Vous avez une connaissance des logiciels 2D (Suite Adobe, InDesign)
• Vous êtes capable de mener plusieurs tâches de front
• Vous disposez d'une culture générale dans le domaine du design

Attention, pour candidater vous devez pouvoir réaliser 6 mois de stage et disposer d'une convention délivrée par votre école/université.  

En postulant, en plus de votre CV, n'hésitez pas à ajouter votre book de travail pour nous permettre d'apprécier pleinement votre expérience et vos compétences.

Et en plus …   Vous travaillerez dans nos magnifiques locaux au cœur de Paris, reflétant notre culture de convivialité et de partage. Vous disposerez de la possibilité de télétravailler (2 jours par semaine), d’une rémunération attractive, d’un restaurant d’entreprise et d’événements internes.

Working at our Paris headquarters, you will support the Brand Communication, Content, Partnerships & Experience team in making Havana Club a truly iconic and culturally connected brand across markets. • Supporting creative brief writing for agencies and production partners

• Coordinating content production (shoots, toolkits, social assets, guidelines)

• Ensuring consistency of brand tone of voice and visual identity across touchpoints

• Identifying emerging content trends (social formats, creators, platforms)

Creative & Strategic Support
• Be a creative force within the team, bringing fresh ideas for creator content and cultural activations

• Conduct monthly benchmarks on competitors and top-performing brands (events & influence)

• Track emerging large-scale cultural talents and trends

MISSION 3: TEAM SUPPORT AND OPERATIONNAL EXCELLENCE (10%)
• Support operational coordination (events logistics, orders, seeding, shooting preparation & deliveries)

• Contribute to internal organization and cross-team alignment

• Share insights, trends reports and cultural inspiration with the team

• Good project management skills and autonomy

title: Global Procurement Intern - Creative Content - January 2027
description:
Would you like to join the world's No. 2 wines and spirits company and grow within an international, creative and fast-evolving environment?
We are looking for a Creative Content Procurement & Sourcing Intern to join our Global Marketing Procurement team based in Paris.
At the heart of Pernod Ricard's marketing ecosystem, you will contribute to building strategic partnerships with leading creative, production and content agencies across the globe. You will support marketing and business teams in identifying the right partners, optimizing ways of working and creating sustainable value for our brands.
You will join a passionate, collaborative and friendly international team operating at the intersection of marketing, creativity, innovation and procurement.

Key Responsibilities
As part of the Global Creative Content Procurement team, you will:
• Support marketing and business teams with their creative, production and content agency needs.
• Participate in global sourcing projects and supplier selection initiatives.
• Contribute to the management and activation of our Preferred Partner Program.
• Conduct market analyses, benchmarking studies and supplier research.
• Support the preparation and management of sourcing exercises, including RFIs, RFPs and negotiations.
• Analyze supplier data, spend trends and performance indicators to identify efficiency and value creation opportunities.
• Help prepare strategic presentations and materials for internal stakeholders.
• Support the coordination of projects involving multiple teams, markets and external partners.
• Participate in supplier performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support the deployment of digital tools and innovative solutions, particularly around AI, both to serve marketing teams and to optimize our ways of working.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!
• You are currently pursuing a degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Procurement, Law or Management.
• You are passionate about marketing, creativity, innovation and brands.
• You have a strong interest in AI tools and new technologies and understand how they can drive efficiency.
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint and comfortable working with data and creating high-quality presentations.
• You are analytical, proactive, organized and detail-oriented.
• You enjoy working collaboratively and are comfortable navigating a complex, international and multi-stakeholder environment.
• You have excellent written and spoken English. French would be a plus.
• Previous experience within a creative agency, production company, marketing team, consultancy, international group or advertiser would be an advantage.
• You have a strong aesthetic sense and an eye for high-quality visual communications.
What You Will Learn
This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience - beyond procurement - at the crossroads of:
• Marketing and content creation;
• Agency and strategic partner management;
• Procurement, sourcing and negotiations;
• International, multi-brand project management;
• Data analysis and value creation;
• Artificial Intelligence applications in marketing and content.

You will collaborate with teams and partners from around the world while developing a global perspective on marketing procurement within a leading international company.

About the Global Innovation Team
At Pernod Ricard, innovation is at the heart of value creation, driven by a dedicated global organization. Working at the intersection of strategy, consumer insights and brand development, the Global Innovation Team identifies growth opportunities, develops consumer-centric innovations at scale across the Group’s portfolio and accelerates growth in strategic and emerging categories. 
Within the team, the Non-Alcoholic Beverages division leads the development of Pernod Ricard's non-alcoholic spirits portfolio, helping drive the Group's ambitions in one of the fastest-growing beverage categories globally.

We are looking for a curious & analytical intern to join the Global Non-Alcoholics Innovation team at Pernod Ricard HQ in Paris. The role is suited to someone who enjoys turning data, market signals and consumer insights into clear business recommendations and strong presentations.
As Global Innovation & Business Analyst Intern, you will support the team across three concrete workstreams: category and business analysis, innovation project delivery, and knowledge building for the non-alcoholic spirits portfolio.
You will work on live strategic projects across priority markets including the UK, Germany, Spain, France and the US.

Key Responsibilities
Category Analysis & Business Intelligence
• Report & analyze Nielsen, IWSR, and internal data to identify category performance drivers, market opportunities and risks.
• Track global non-alcoholic spirits and adjacent beverage trends, including competitor launches, pricing, formats, claims and route-to-market choices.
• Support local market strategy work by sizing opportunities, benchmarking competitors and translating analysis into practical recommendations.
• Build clear Excel analyses and executive-ready PowerPoint slides

Innovation Project Management
• Support Non-Alc innovation projects through the internal NPD process, from opportunity framing to launch readiness (business case inputs, competitive benchmarks, tasting summaries and decision documents)
• Contribute to consumer learning plans, concept tests and analysis of results to define clear implications for product development.
• Coordinate tastings, sample shipments and stakeholder feedback collection.
• Track launch performance, consolidate learnings, and identify improvements for future non-alcoholic innovations.
Knowledge Building & Strategic Framing
• Prepare monthly competitive and trend updates covering non-alcoholic spirits and adjacent categories.
• Maintain internal FAQ decks, market trackers, competitor benchmarks and project resources used by the global team.
• Run focused deep dives on emerging brands, consumption occasions, consumer needs, ingredients, formats and pricing models.
• Organize category tastings to help the team assess products, claims, liquid quality and consumer relevance.

Profile :
• Master’s student in business school, engineering school or university
• Previous experience in business analysis, consulting, FMCG, category management, market research, or strategy
• Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with numbers, building structured analyses and turning findings into clear recommendations
• Strong interest in innovation, beverages, consumer trends and moderation
• Knowledge of Nielsen, IWSR or similar databases is a plus
• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; ability to build clean analyses and concise slides
• Structured, reliable and proactive, with the ability to manage several workstreams
• Fluent in English (French is a plus)

Pernod Ricard recrute son.sa futur.e stagiaire Juriste en Droit des Affaires et Contrats (H/F) pour 6 mois de Janvier à Juin 2027. Vous travaillerez à the Island, notre bureau situé au centre de Paris (Gare Saint Lazare, Paris 8).

HAVANA CLUB INTERNATIONAL (HCI) est une Joint-Venture née du rapprochement en 1993 entre Pernod Ricard et Corporación Cuba Ron. HCI produit et commercialise dans plus de 120 pays le rhum cubain de la marque Havana Club qui fait partie des marques stratégiques du Groupe Pernod Ricard.

Description générale du poste :
Au sein de la direction juridique en charge de la marque Havana Club basée au siège de Pernod Ricard à Paris (composée d’un directeur juridique et d’un juriste corporate), le/la stagiaire juriste sera en charge de participer aux différentes missions de la direction juridique.

Vos mission clés :
• Vous préparerez les assemblées générales et conseils d’administration des sociétés composant la Joint-Venture Havana Club et contribuerez à l’activité de conseil en droit des sociétés (clôture des comptes, modification des statuts et accords de JV, changements de mandats, KYC, etc.)
• Vous participerez à la rédaction de divers contrats commerciaux dans les domaines suivants : achats, industriel, accord financiers, distribution, etc.)
• Vous rédigerez et actualiserez divers documents juridiques (CGV, CGA, règlements de jeu, lettres d’intention, guidelines juridiques, notes juridiques internes, accords de confidentialité, etc.)
• Vous participerez à l’activité de conseil juridique auprès des équipes opérationnelles (marketing, finance, communication, opérations, affaires publiques, etc.) sur les dossiers de droit commercial, droit des contrats, droit des données personnelles, etc.
• Vous participerez à la mise en place et au déploiement des programmes de conformité du Groupe auprès des équipes Havana Club (e.g. rédaction de politiques de conformité, préparation des outils de communication, préparation des formations, etc.)
• Vous effectuerez de la veille juridique, recherches juridiques et rédaction de notes de synthèse et d’actualités juridiques liées à l’activité de la Joint-Venture, au secteur du rhum et à l’environnement réglementaire.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans la description ci-dessous, n’hésitez pas à postuler !
• Vous avez un Master en Droit des Affaires (double diplôme droit français et espagnol / Amérique Latine est un plus).
• Vous avez réalisé un ou plusieurs stages (d’au moins 6 mois) en cabinet d’avocats en droit des affaires et/ou dans une direction juridique d’un grand groupe à dimension internationale avec travaux en anglais et/ou espagnol et idéalement une première expérience dans la rédaction de contrats et/ou en droit des sociétés.
• Vous maitrisez couramment l’anglais et français juridique et avez une bonne maîtrise de l’espagnol.
• Vous êtes rigoureux, proactif et aimer travailler en équipe.
• Vous avez une excellente capacité de recherche et d’analyse et un esprit de synthèse.

Attention, pour candidater vous devez pouvoir réaliser 6 mois de stage et disposer d'une convention délivrée par votre école/université.  

Et vous bénéficierez en plus de ces avantages :

description:

title: Global Head of Sensory and Technical Insights
description:
Want to join a fast-moving company, work among convivial teams, and take part in the global growth strategy of one of the most prestigious and comprehensive portfolios in the wine & spirits industry? We are looking for a Global Head of Sensory and Technical Insights! You will be based at The Island, our office in central Paris. 

Your key missions:

Reporting to the Global Research, Sensory and Analytical Sciences Director, you will lead the development and application of sensory science, technical product understanding and consumer-relevant insights to support innovation, product quality, reformulations and strategic decision-making across our spirits portfolio. As the bridge between consumer understanding, sensory perception, analytical data, product development, quality and brand strategy, you will make sure product decisions are grounded in robust science and translated into meaningful business outcomes – building the capabilities, best practices, expert teams and panels that unlock growth.

Sensory strategy & leadership
• Define and own the global sensory and technical insights strategy, driving capability development, scientific excellence and business impact across innovation, renovation and quality

• Shape portfolio decisions by identifying sensory whitespace opportunities, product superiority drivers and emerging consumer preferences

• Monitor emerging scientific developments and translate them into competitive advantage

• Drive the development of novel sensory methodologies, predictive approaches and insight-generation techniques

• Build external scientific networks with universities, research institutes and industry bodies

• Establish sensory science as a core capability supporting product innovation, quality improvement and competitive benchmarking

• Ensure sensory methodologies are fit-for-purpose, scientifically robust and relevant to business decision-making

• Build a clear vision for how sensory and technical insights contribute to consumer preference, product superiority, premiumisation and brand differentiation

• Contribute to long-term product and technology roadmaps across categories

Product & technical insights
• Lead the generation of technical product insights across spirits categories – whisky, gin, vodka, rum, tequila, liqueurs, aperitifs and low/no alcohol products

• Translate sensory and analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for R&D, marketing, quality, operations and brand teams

• Support the identification of key product drivers, sensory attributes, flavour profiles and technical levers influencing consumer perception and product performance

• Connect sensory data with analytical chemistry, processing, maturation, packaging and consumer research to build a holistic understanding of product experience

• Provide sensory and technical guidance throughout the innovation process, from early concept screening to final product validation

• Ensure product changes are assessed with appropriate sensory and technical risk evaluation

• Help protect brand consistency and consumer trust by ensuring sensory-critical attributes are understood, monitored and controlled

Sensory data
• Drive the adoption of a digital sensory platform, advanced analytics, AI-enabled insight generation and predictive modelling approaches

• Ensure data quality, governance, accessibility and knowledge management across sensory activities globally

• Drive the integration of sensory, analytical, consumer, quality and product data to generate deeper technical understanding

• Define and oversee the development of sensory data models, product landscapes and insight platforms

• Champion the use of digital tools, sensory software, databases and data visualisation to improve knowledge management and decision-making

• Translate complex scientific and sensory information into clear narratives for technical and non-technical stakeholders

Capability building
• Build and lead a global sensory and technical insights community of practice, aligning methodologies, capability development and knowledge sharing across sites, brands and business units

• Lead the development, training, calibration and performance management of sensory panels, including expert, descriptive, discrimination and quality panels

• Define standards for sensory panel governance, panel reliability, data quality and continuous improvement

• Ensure consistent application of sensory methodologies across sites, markets and categories

• Build internal capability through training, coaching, tools and best-practice sharing

Collaboration
• Partner with R&D, brand, marketing, consumer insights and quality teams to support new product development and reformulation projects

• Act as the company’s leading expert in sensory and technical insights, influencing strategic decisions at senior leadership level

• Represent sensory and technical insights in executive reviews, innovation governance forums and strategic portfolio discussions

• Define and govern global sensory standards for product quality and brand consistency

• Provide sensory expertise for quality investigations, product changes, supplier transitions, process modifications and market complaints

• Work closely with blenders and liquid R&D teams

• Represent the company at industry forums, scientific conferences and external collaborations

Team leadership & development
• Lead, develop and inspire a team of sensory scientists, technical insight specialists, panel leaders and product researchers

• Set clear priorities, objectives and performance expectations aligned with business needs

• Develop and manage the sensory and technical insights budget, prioritising resources, external partnerships, technologies and capability investments

• Build a culture of scientific excellence, curiosity, collaboration, impact and continuous improvement

• Coach team members to strengthen their technical expertise, influencing skills and business-partnering capabilities

If you recognize yourself in the description below, don’t wait to apply! 
You have:
• an MSc or PhD in Sensory Science, Chemistry, Flavour Science, Consumer Science or a related scientific discipline (training in sensory statistics, consumer research, flavour chemistry, data science or spirits production is a plus)

• Significant experience in sensory science, product research, consumer science, technical insights, R&D or product development – ideally within spirits, alcoholic beverages, food, flavour or FMCG

• Proven experience building and leading global scientific capabilities or centres of excellence

• a track record of influencing senior leadership and shaping strategic business decisions

• experience leading organisational change, capability transformation or digital initiatives

• a strong external network within sensory science, flavour science, consumer science or related disciplines

• a strong command of sensory methodologies, including descriptive analysis, discrimination testing, preference mapping, quality sensory testing and product benchmarking

• experience working with technical product data, analytical results, consumer insights and product development processes

• experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing senior stakeholders

• previous people management or team leadership experience

• familiarity with sensory software and data visualisation tools

You are:
• able to translate scientific understanding into commercial and brand value

• a confident scientific writer, storyteller and presenter, at ease turning complex data into clear narratives for technical and non-technical audiences

• curious, collaborative and impact-driven, with a passion for scientific excellence and continuous improvement

Nice to have:
• hands-on experience with spirits, flavour chemistry, maturation, distillation, blending, low/no alcohol or liquid development (highly advantageous)

• experience writing scientific papers, posters and presentations

• experience with predictive modelling and advanced statistics

Wait, there’s more… 
We offer you an outstanding and collaborative workplace that embodies our sharing & conviviality culture, the possibility to work remotely (up to 2 days a week), a very complete mutual insurance, an attractive compensation including profit-sharing, the possibility to train daily, employee events…

description:
Want to join the world's No. 2 in wines & spirits and work among convivial teams? Pernod Ricard is looking for its Responsible Drinking Initiatives Intern from end of January 2027 to June 2027.
Sustainability & Responsibility (S&R) is at the heart of the company's vision 'to unlock the magic of human connections by bringing Good Times from a Good Place'. The S&R roadmap is built around four key pillars that address all the material risks of our business, from grain to glass.
One of these pillars, the Responsible Hosting pillar, focuses on the Group’s commitment to responsible drinking and ensuring that the brands are always enjoyed responsibly. At Pernod Ricard, we place conviviality at the heart of our culture and promote moderation as a conscious, positive, and aspirational lifestyle. In line with the evolving consumers drinking habits, our ambition is to make conscious and convivial drinking the new normal.
The Public Affairs department is composed of 18 people, and the responsibility & prevention sub-department is a team of 5 people working to roll out the Responsible Hosting strategy across the group. It has a very transversal role within the entity, working closely with all departments such as S&R, Communications, Marketing, and others.
We are hiring two interns who will split the below-listed missions based on the project timelines, planning, workload, and the managers they will report to. 

Your key missions:
Mission 1: Assistance on the Responsible Drinking Strategy and Roadmap
• Assist and support the team on the implementation of the global Responsible Drinking Strategy and Roadmap
• Support with the monitoring of the creator content on the topic of moderation and ensure alignment with strategy & consumer trends
• Carry out desk research on alcohol consumption trends, moderation, responsible drinking & prevention programmes
• Assist in the coordination with the different departments of the HQ

Mission 2: Assistance in coordination of global roll out of the DRINK MORE WATER prevention campaign both online and offline (www.drinkmore-water.com)
• Support the markets in the implementation of the initiative as well as support in the organization of centrally managed events
• Follow the digital implementation of the campaign on the global social media channels targeting young adults
• Help with the preparation of material before events and the follow-up of events and digital campaigns afterwards (presentations, reports, monitoring, as well as collect feedback from affiliates & partners)
• Support in communication and promotion of the programme, especially to affiliates wishing to implement on-the-field – sharing of best practices, gathering information and insights from the markets, preparing presentation to communicate and showcase our efforts on the initiative.

Mission 3: Assistance on gathering and consolidation of Group Responsible Drinking Reporting and CSRD
• Assist in coordination of reporting process (e.g. help preparing pre-reporting presentations to affiliate to explain reporting process)
• Assist in post-reporting phase: validate affiliates’ reporting forms, consolidate reporting and prepare decks with analytics and highlights to present back to markets

Mission 4: Assistance on other external and internal responsible drinking projects
• Internal training programmes: Assist on the update of all internal trainings on the topic of responsible drinking and moderation and the creation of new content. Ensure the the promotion and communication of training sessions and support to the affiliates for roll out
• Bar World of Tomorrow initiative: support the preparation of tools and communications assets needed for the transformation of this program (presentations, flyers, posts…)[RG2]
• Support the team on transversal ad-hoc projects on responsible drinking

Mission 5: Assistance in promoting responsible drinking internally to make every employee an ambassador of moderation
• Internal initiatives to raise internal awareness about Responsible Drinking: assist in the preparation of events organized by the team, both operationally and for the communication of the events
• Internal engagement: contribute to the development of material to promote initiatives and trainings on responsible drinking

The Direct & Indirect Procurement Product Manager will lead the strategic planning, development and implementation of our solutions, covering areas such as direct and trade procurement, Point of sales procurement and Indirect Procurement. They define product roadmaps, prioritize features, and oversee product development processes. They will lead various product teams and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, design, and marketing, to ensure successful product launches. Their expertise in product management, market analysis, and technical understanding is essential for delivering innovative and customer-centric IT solutions. IT Product Managers play a pivotal role in driving product success, meeting market needs, and achieving business goals through cutting-edge IT products and services.

The ideal candidate will have experience in managing a product backlog, collaborating with cross-functional teams (portfolio management, Operations, Finance, manufacturing, S&R, compliance) and ensuring alignment with business goals. A relevant experience in a global CPG company is an advantage, preferably having a track record of implementing global procurement solutions.

o Demand Management : Collect, qualify and assess demands coming from the Tech Function itself, consolidate Business & Tech Product Demand backlogs, analyze and integrate them into right Squad’s Backlog

o Resource Management : Coordinate product teams work, animate PO community, secure engagement & collaboration, define squad’s resource needs for my scope, collaborate with tech leaders for resource mobilization and eventually adjust plans and roadmaps based on available resource capacity

Ad-hoc reviews with other Tech leaders to be planned depending on the needs.
Key internal stakeholders : Other Product Managers, product owners, Domain Proximity Lead, Architecture Teams, Service Management, Key Users, Resources Lead, Product Teams, Squad Members and Business Process Owners to be involved in monthly Sprint plannings and quarterly product roadmap reviews. Daily stand ups with the squad. Agility is expected to adapt the ceremonies frequency to the pace of the business velocity to drive maximum value. 
Key external stakeholders : Regular business review meetings to be conducted with our partners (editors, integrators, etc.). Involvement is expected in all aspects of the vendor relationship – selection, contract negotiation, budget and deliverables monitoring, resource management, etc.

You have at least 10 years' professional experience in e-procurement tool implementation (Ivalua and Coupa) with a perfect knowledge of procurement process.
Your experiences at a FMCG company would be highly appreciated, experiences in consulting firms are also valued.

description:
Meet Pernod Ricard and experience Our Convivial Spirit
Ready to join Pernod Ricard, the world’s the #1 premium spirits organisation with the industry’s most comprehensive and diversified portfolio of premium brands including 18 of the world’s top 100 spirits brands? As Créateurs de Convivialité, our purpose is to inspire authentic moments of sharing through our iconic brands, including Absolut Vodka, Jameson Irish Whiskey, and Martell Cognac, sold in over 160 countries. “Conviviality” is our secret ingredient, poured into everything we do, and rooted in every one of us who works here. Collective spirit drives our success, empowering you to craft your path and bring your authentic self to every occasion.

Role Overview
The Workday Product Owner Absence, Time Tracking & Payroll will be responsible for the governance, optimization, and continuous improvement of Workday Absence and Workday Time Tracking globally. This role will ensure that existing configurations remain aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and system best practices.
In addition, the Product Owner will lead the strategy and framework for global payroll integrations, ensuring efficient, automated, and scalable interactions between Workday and local payroll systems. This includes defining global standards for affiliates of various sizes, guiding payroll vendor selection, and promoting convergence toward approved providers.
This role sits in the Corporate Capability Product team, in Global Tech, under the HR Tech Product Manager. You will have strong links with our Tech proximity teams worldwide and local HRs local business operations.
We are looking for someone with strong system expertise, an ability to drive global alignment, and a mindset focused on process optimization and automation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Workday Absence & Time Tracking Ownership
• Own and maintain the global configuration of Workday Absence and Workday Time Tracking.
• Identify and implement enhancements to improve usability, compliance, and operational efficiency.
• Monitor system performance and adoption, ensuring seamless end‑user experience.
• Support and coordinate testing cycles for releases, patches, and configuration updates.
• Work closely with HR Operations and local HR teams to address process needs and ensure consistent global standards.

2. Payroll Integrations & Framework Management
• Develop and maintain a global framework for managing Workday-to-payroll integrations across countries and affiliate sizes
• Map and document all existing payroll integrations, identifying opportunities for optimization, reduction of manual work, and automation.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to standardize and streamline payroll-related data flows.
• Ensure payroll configuration and integrations align with Workday best practices and system capabilities.

3. Payroll Vendor Management & Convergence
• Define criteria and guidelines for selecting pre‑approved payroll vendors to ensure optimal integration with Workday.
• Collaborate with affiliates during their selection or renewal of payroll providers, ensuring alignment with the global framework.
• Build strong relationships with vendors, monitoring performance and integration quality.
• Promote convergence toward strategic vendors to improve global efficiency and system cohesion.

4. Animating product roadmap and coordinating work of the Scrum team
• Serve as the primary point of contact for all matters related to Workday Absence, Time Tracking, and payroll integrations.
• Communicate product vision, roadmap, priorities, and release impacts to stakeholders.
• Conceive and document product epics/user stories: break the product into Epics and implementable user stories, coordinate mockups creation and identify acceptance criteria for the stories. 
• Take part in relevant SAFe and Scrum ceremonies, lead backlog grooming sessions, and prioritize product backlog. 
• Validate overall achievements on the product. Gather and arbitrate feedback from users from multiple iterations of the product to continually improve and drive value. 
• Be accountable for ensuring that the team delivers value to the business on a frequent and consistent basis. 
• Organize, lead acceptance tests and define Go/noGo criteria for each sprint releases. 
• Set up and track metrics to measure product effectiveness and users’ satisfaction. 

5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation
• Stay informed on Workday roadmap changes and new functionalities.
• Evaluate new features and make recommendations for adoption.
• Promote automation opportunities to reduce manual tasks across HR and Payroll operations.
• Benchmark processes against industry standards to identify opportunities for transformation.

Job Scope:  
• Reporting to Product Manager for HR – Head of HR Tech
• Internal stakeholders: Tech proximity teams, HR Absence & Time-Tracking partners, Local HRIS Payroll teams, HR Tech Product Owners 
• Key External stakeholders: support and configuration teams (T2 and T3 AMS), consultants. 
• Job scope: 100% international (max 30% availability to travel)  

Skills & Qualifications
Required
• Proven experience as a Workday Product Owner, HRIS Specialist, or similar role.
• Strong hands-on knowledge of Workday Absence and Workday Time Tracking modules.
• Experience with Workday payroll integrations (EIBs, PECI, custom integrations, cloud connect).
• Understanding of global payroll processes and vendor management.
• Strong analytical and documentation skills.
• Ability to manage stakeholders across multiple countries and business units.
• Excellent communication and project management capabilities.
Preferred
• Experience in multinational environments.
• Exposure to Agile methodologies.
• Familiarity with integration tools, middleware, or Workday reporting.

Experience Requirements

• Experience collaborating with external payroll vendors or managing vendor selection processes.
• Project management experience in Agile, hybrid, or iterative delivery environments.

description:

Global Data Team has the mandate to drive data at scale by owning the data tech strategy and providing innovative building blocks for success at Pernod Ricard.
By this mandate, Global Data team ensures consistency, efficiency, scalability, and value generation to achieve on its area transformation programs. An armed wing of PR ambition to become a Conviviality Platform.

• Work closely with Data Hubs sponsors, data stewards / owners and data consumers to make Data Hubs a success and a key foundation for the digital transformation of each business department.

• Be responsible for making our data common, understandable, trustable, and usable by everyone to allow Pernod Ricard to be a data-driven company.

Role and responsibilities
You will initiative strategy and top management awareness:

• Define Data Hubs standards and framework to be common and replication between Data Hubs

• Embody Data-As-A product and self-service data approach in each Data Hub initiative

• Lead audit to understand the current situation & business ambition to confirm the value of having a new Data Hub for a specific data domain / data family

You will lead and/or oversee Data Hubs implementation:

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France and Europe?

Do you thrive in a trustful, fast-paced environment?

Do you feel like our Engineering principles https://medium.com/pennylane-engineering/our-engineering-principles-ab0613a0574d are aligned with your vision ?

 

Then Pennylane might be the right place for you — and you, might be the perfect fit for this role 🙂

 

Our vision

 

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of European SMEs.

 

We help business owners get rid of the time consuming hassle of handling accounting and finance, while giving them access to key information that they can use to make better decisions.

 

Meanwhile, we’re helping accountants. By using Pennylane, rather than doing manual and repetitive tasks, they can spend more time advising and guiding their clients.



About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1100+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Pennylane-France-Avis-E4171708.htm.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

👪 Team and context

 

The tech team is divided into more than 50 squads, each squad being led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer and composed of 5 to 8 developers (Frontend, Backend and Full stack). As we scale and increase the number of Squads, we are looking for Engineering Managers to help us drive and mentor those squads. 

 

Pennylane is based in Paris but our tech team is remote-first. You can work from anywhere in Europe. The team meets in Paris a few days every two months.

 

🎯Your missions

 

- Manage a team of 5 to 8 Software Engineers

- Keeping a mix between individual contribution and management (but that's something which can vary depending of your expectations)

- Collaborate with the product manager to make sure our standards in terms of quality and efficiency are respected but also that there is a good mood and that everybody is fulfilled in their job

- Identify our developers' key strengths and areas of improvement to help them grow

- Collaborate with the other Senior Engineering Managers and Engineering Managers to set up the appropriate process as the team grows

 

✨ What's exciting about our project ?

 

- The vision : We want to change the life of thousands of entrepreneurs throughout Europe with our solution

- The ambition : We are scaling at a very rapid pace and we want to become one of the fintech leaders within 2-3 years

- The learning curve : We have great tech mentors and experienced engineers whom you can share with and learn from everyday

- The product : Two years after its launch, our solution has received outstanding feedback from our users, and we still have so much to build and offer !

- The environment : We do our best to develop a culture based on trust, autonomy, and benevolence so you can feel like you're in the right place

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you..

 

- Have at least 5 years of experience in software development, rather using Ruby on Rails or React.js http://React.js ideally (we remain open regarding the technical expertise)

- Have a balanced blend of technical, business, and product skills.

- Have a solid management experience

- Are a team player and have experience working in an agile environment.

- Have empathy for your users and want to change their lives and you are pragmatic.

- Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to

💵 You’ll have a compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu https://www.busuu.com/fr/p/start-learning?utm_medium=cpc&utm_source=google&utm_campaign=FR_FR_Web_Brand_E&utm_group=FR_FR_Web_Brand_E&utm_term=busuu&gclid=CjwKCAjw682TBhATEiwA9crl34OqnbJDliinEXFZNqOcb6391KXrgq4ZDDwEiwMdtTdtuVULvuF7HhoCgZEQAvD_BwE&gclsrc=aw.ds to perfect your english or your french

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to Centerparcs and it was fabulous !)

 

And.. If you're based in France :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get between 6 to 13 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

🤝Hiring process

 

- First call with a Technical Recruiter

- Technical assessment and debriefing with 2 people from the Tech Team

- Product discussion with one colleague from the product team (PM or Designer)

- Final Round with one of our two people from our tech leadership 

 

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total. 

 
 

We have tried to give you as much details as we could about the purpose, missions and environment of this role; it is now up to you to tell us if you think this is a position in which you could a) have fun and b) bring value to our company.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply anyway: worst case scenario, you might lose a few minutes, and in the best case, it will be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

To end with a humble illustration of our commitment, we’ve recently signed the Pacte Parité https://lafrenchtech.com/fr/pacte-parite/ to set concrete goals in building a better and more inclusive workplace in the years to come.

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 
 

Design at Pennylane

Design sits at the centre of this mission and its purpose is to deliver a accessible, seamless and enjoyable experience for our two main users. Our team of 35+ product designers work across different tracks that are divided into cross-functional squads each consisting of Engineering, Product and Design. Autonomy, trust and transparency are the key values upon which our culture is built, this is directly reflected in how our designers operate on a day-to-day basis. At Pennylane, designers are expected to actively contribute all the way from defining the problem space, to research and testing.

 

We are seeking a Product Design Manager, with a strong strategic and design mindset who has extensive experience working in complex product environments. You will have the opportunity to mentor, coach and lead a team of talented designers to ensure our partners have the best user experience possible.

 

We are looking for someone with proven experience working directly with C-level executives and executive committees. You have the ability to simplify complex topics, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and naturally adapt your presence and influence in high-stakes discussions.

 

Your key responsibilities

- Scale and level-up your team of 5 product designers. You will partner closely with other design leaders, cross-functional partners, and HR partners to hire, develop and retain design talent in alignment with the growth trajectory of our organisation.

- Identify strategic UX opportunities that will help our users become more productive and drive these forward with your product and engineering peers at track level.

- Orchestrate user research with product leads and your team to understand the behaviour, needs and wants for our most important accounting partners and convert it into actionable insights.

- Skilled at measuring the effect of design on business performance and overseeing critical strategic directions.

- Continuously contribute expertise back to the business in the form of insights and best practices for our users.

- Help your team balance speed, quality, and design consistency, always focusing on JBTD and business goals.

- Shaping and establishing design processes. By driving design best practices, you'll enable more significant impact and efficiency across the team.

- Experienced in partnering with design ops teams

 

Your profile

- Fluency in French and proficiency in English is required.

- You have a strong track record of leading product design teams, better if in B2B organisations.

- You have an excellent eye for design and are capable to assist the team with ideas and creative inputs.

- You excel at aligning team decisions with the overall vision, JTBD, and design guidelines.

- You enjoy discovering and solving complex problems through data and insights.

- You have experience fostering an inclusive, open, and engaged design team culture.

- You are comfortable communicating future design directions with senior stakeholders, including founders and inspiring positive action within your team.

- You have a a collaborative approach. You have experience working closely with other Designers, Engineers and Product Managers. You value feedback and brainstorming ideas.

- Significant experience collaborating with senior executives (C-level, Executive Committee, etc.)

- Ability to simplify, synthesize, and translate complex issues for non-expert audiences

- Comfortable presenting and defending your decisions to senior stakeholders

- Skilled at finding the right balance in meetings—knowing when to lead, when to listen, and how to adapt your approach to the context



What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu https://www.busuu.com/fr/p/start-learning?utm_medium=cpc&utm_source=google&utm_campaign=FR_FR_Web_Brand_E&utm_group=FR_FR_Web_Brand_E&utm_term=busuu&gclid=CjwKCAjw682TBhATEiwA9crl34OqnbJDliinEXFZNqOcb6391KXrgq4ZDDwEiwMdtTdtuVULvuF7HhoCgZEQAvD_BwE&gclsrc=aw.ds to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.
