title: Lead Credit Ops H/F
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Pennylane-France-Avis-E4171708.htm.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!




ROLE CONTEXT

Pennylane currently serves around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model and distributes short-term financing to a subset of those customers through specialised financing partners. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams.



As Credit Operations Lead, you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes.

You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner.

This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

 - Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

 - Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

 - Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

 - Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

 - Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

 - Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.




FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

 - Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

 - Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

 - Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

 - Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

 - Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

 - By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

 - Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

 - Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

 - Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

 - Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

 - Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

 - Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

 - Experience with SME financing products, such as invoice financing or short-term working-capital facilities, would be a strong advantage.




LANGUAGES, PRESENCE AND LOCATION

 - Fluent French and English are mandatory.

 - Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

 - Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.




WHY JOIN

 - Build the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s future société de financement from the ground up.

 - Shape the operating model, tooling and team before the own-book financing activity reaches scale.

 - Take ownership of a critical function with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer experience and responsible growth.

 - Work closely with Risk, Product, Tech and our financing partner on a strategic company project.

 - Join a high-autonomy role with compensation that includes equity and reflects the level of responsibility.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Hippolyte (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

5. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min) 



What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

description:

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !




ROLE CONTEXT

Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.

Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs.

 - Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks.

 - Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records.

 - Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

 - Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

 - Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

 - Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.




FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

 - Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live.

 - Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

 - Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch.

 - By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

 - Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed.

 - Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

 - Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance.

 - Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

 - Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

 - Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

 - Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

 - Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

 - Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.




LANGUAGES, PRESENCE AND LOCATION

 - Fluent French and English are mandatory.

 - Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

 - Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.




WHY JOIN

 - Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up.

 - Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling.

 - Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth.

 - Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)

4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

TES RESPONSABILITÉS


 - Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

 - Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

 - Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.






CE QUE TU VAS FAIRE CONCRÈTEMENT



1) STRATÉGIE D’EMBARQUEMENT CLIENTS (TPE/PME)

 - Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

 - Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

 - Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

 - Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

 - Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

 - Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

 - Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

 - CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

 - Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

 - Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

 - Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

   - en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet
   
   - ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

 - Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

 - Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

description:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

At Pennylane, Growth Operations is crucial in transforming prospect data and marketing processes into an automated, reliable, and scalable growth engine.

 

We are hiring a Growth Operations & Automation Specialist to join our Growth team and work at the intersection of business, data, automation, and AI. Your mission: enhance how we identify, enrich, and activate prospects while building tools that boost Marketing and Sales efficiency.

 

You will also contribute to AI adoption by identifying use cases, creating agents and workflows, testing new tools, and empowering teams to use them effectively.

 


🌍 WHAT IS PENNYLANE?

Pennylane is one of France's leading fintech unicorns, creating the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we empower business owners to make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on client advisory.

 

A few figures to illustrate our scale and ambition:

 

 - 💻 1.3 million+ SMEs already work with Pennylane.

 - 🤝 7,000+ accounting firms use our platform.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 1,100+ Pennylaners representing over 25 nationalities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As part of our Growth team, you'll closely collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Operations, and Product.

 


BUILD SCALABLE AUTOMATION WORKFLOWS

 - Automate prospect scraping, enrichment, scoring, and activation

 - Identify CRM bottlenecks and replace manual processes with scalable solutions

 - Connect our data warehouse with Salesforce to generate opportunities and provide actionable insights to Sales

 


TURN DATA INTO GROWTH

 - Improve prospect database quality and usability

 - Build tools to help Marketing and Sales generate and activate qualified leads

 - Support acquisition initiatives: outbound, events, partnerships

 - Monitor project impact on lead generation, conversion, and efficiency

 - Create agents, skills, and reusable workflows

 - Support adoption via training, documentation, and pilot programs

 


CONNECT AND OPTIMISE OUR STACK

 - Integrate tools such as Salesforce, Modjo, Dust, and Livestorm

 - Translate business needs into technical solutions

 - Own projects from scoping to deployment and iteration

 - Ensure compliance with GDPR, CNIL, security, and data governance

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Hands-on experience in Growth Ops, Marketing Ops, Revenue Ops, or automation, ideally in B2B SaaS or a scale-up

 - Strong proficiency with n8n and complex, multi-tool workflows

 - Ability to translate business challenges into tech solutions

 - Familiarity with CRM systems, prospect data, scraping, enrichment, and scoring

 - Proven record of impactful automation projects

 - Practical experience using AI tools and supporting adoption

 - Strong communication and project management skills

 - Autonomy, curiosity, and an ownership mindset

 - Professional working proficiency in English

 - Bonus: Experience with SEO, SEA, or the broader acquisition funnel

 


🛠️ TOOLS AND ENVIRONMENT

You’ll use tools like n8n, Salesforce, Modjo, Dust, and Livestorm and experiment with solutions such as Cursor, Claude Code, and MCPs.

 - A role combining Growth, automation, data, and AI

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

Le Partner marketing specialist a un rôle essentiel dans le développement de notre écosystème partenaires en pilotant notre stratégie marketing via nos partenaires revendeurs (intégrateurs). Il a pour objectif de générer des leads qualifiés et de renforcer notre position de leader dans la gestion financière.
En collaboration étroite avec notre équipe partenariat et les partner account managers, ce rôle implique la conception et le déploiement de campagnes de co-marketing innovantes. L'objectif est de créer des synergies durables qui alimentent notre croissance tout en maximisant la visibilité de notre proposition de valeur unique.
Le succès de cette mission repose sur une approche méthodique combinant la génération d'opportunités commerciales, le développement de relations partenaires privilégiées et l'exécution de campagnes marketing à fort impact mesurable.




MISSIONS

 - Gérer les relations avec les équipes marketing des partenaires, en assurant une communication efficace et en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités de collaboration.

 - Élaborer et gérer des campagnes de co-marketing, y compris des webinaires, des événements, des contenus partagés, etc.

 - Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes pour optimiser les stratégies et assurer un retour sur investissement positif.

 - Collaborer avec les équipes internes (partenariats, marketing, sales, product marketing) pour aligner les initiatives marketing avec les objectifs commerciaux de Pennylane.

 - Former et accompagner les partenaires sur les supports marketing disponibles
   
   


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

 - Une première expérience en marketing BtoB SaaS avec animation de partenaires

 - Communication en interne et en externe

 - Maitrise des outils marketing

 - Bonne gestion de projet

 - Maitrise de l’anglais professionnel

 - Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles

 - Capacité à travailler en équipe

 - Autonomie

 - Proactivité

 - Sens de l’organisation

 - Expérience demandée : 3 ans

 - Connaissance du monde des partenariats revendeurs et logiciels

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

 

- Tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

 

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

 

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

 

Compétences requises

 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

title: Partner Account Manager, Intégrateurs de solutions de gestion
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Localisation et déplacements

Poste basé à Paris, selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.



Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

 1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

 2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

 3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

 4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

 5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.



Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

 - Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

 - Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

 - Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

 - Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

 - Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

 - Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

 - Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

 - Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

 - Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

 - Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

 - Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

 - Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

 - Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

 - Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

 - Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

 - Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

 - Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

 - Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

 - Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

 - Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

 - Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

 - Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

 - Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

 - Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

 - Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

 - Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

 - Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

 - Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

 - Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

 - Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.
   
   

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

 - Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

 - Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

 - Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

 - Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

 - Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

 - Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

 - Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

 - Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

 - Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

 - Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.
   
   

Atouts appréciés

 - Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

 - Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

 - Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

 - Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.
   
   

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

 - Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

 - Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

 - Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

 - Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

 - A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.



Process de recrutement :

 1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

 2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

 3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

 4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

title: Financial Services Regulatory Lead H/F
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Pennylane-France-Avis-E4171708.htm.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!






WHY IS THIS ROLE IMPORTANT FOR PENNYLANE?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

From day one of licensing, PFS must be able to operate in full regulatory compliance - not only through policies, but through reliable execution: clear ownership, predictable reporting routines, auditable evidence, and effective coordination across Operations, Finance/Accounting and Compliance & Risk.

This role is critical to organise and run that regulatory function, with the ambition to progressively consolidate regulatory reporting ownership within PFS.




HOW WILL YOU CONTRIBUTE TO THE PROJECT?

You will help build and operate the regulatory office of Pennylane Financial Services, working across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology.

Your initial priority will be to turn PFS’s regulatory requirements into a reliable operating framework: a complete obligations inventory, clear ownership, an integrated regulatory calendar, and effective controls over regulatory reporting and evidence.

In practice, you will:

 - maintain the authoritative inventory of PFS’s regulatory obligations;

 - coordinate the regulatory-reporting portfolio and directly produce selected returns;

 - establish clear responsibilities, reporting controls and escalation paths across contributing functions;

 - support supervisory responses and commitment tracking from day one;

 - coordinate regulatory change with Compliance, Legal and the relevant subject-matter owners; and

 - support regulatory governance through clear reporting, decision tracking and follow-through.

You will not replace the specialist accountability of Finance, the MLRO, Legal, Risk or Operations. Your role will be to make their contributions converge into a controlled, timely and inspection-ready regulatory process.

As PFS grows, you will help shape and evolve its regulatory operating model and governance arrangements.




WHAT WILL YOUR DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES BE?

 - Maintain the regulatory-obligations inventory: keep a complete and current view of PFS’s recurring and event-driven obligations, with clear owners, deadlines, controls, approval routes and evidence requirements.

 - Run the integrated regulatory calendar: coordinate contributors, dependencies and review milestones across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology, escalating delivery risks before deadlines are affected.

 - Coordinate regulatory reporting: oversee the end-to-end reporting portfolio and directly prepare selected returns, while ensuring specialist functions retain accountability for their underlying judgements and data.

 - Establish reporting controls: document and operate source-to-report lineage, reconciliations, variance analysis, maker-checker review, sign-offs, submission evidence, correction procedures and backup arrangements.

 - Coordinate data-quality remediation: document reporting-data issues, assign them to the accountable function, monitor resolution and escalate overdue or recurring problems.

 - Support supervisory responses and commitment tracking: maintain a reliable record of requests, responses and commitments; coordinate contributions and evidence under the direction of the ACPR relationship owner; and escalate delivery issues to PFS management.

 - Coordinate regulatory change: work with Compliance, Legal and relevant subject-matter owners to translate new requirements into impact assessments, accountable owners, implementation plans and evidence.

 - Support regulatory governance: prepare concise status reporting, maintain decision and action tracking, and ensure regulatory matters reach the appropriate management or governance forum.

 - Improve tools and processes: define practical requirements for workflow, evidence storage, reporting production and regulatory remittance, reducing manual effort without weakening controls.




PROFILE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must-have

 - Meaningful experience in a regulated financial environment, in one or more areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory operations, prudential reporting, compliance, risk, finance, internal control or regulatory advisory.

 - Strong understanding of reporting controls and data quality, including reconciliations, source-to-report traceability, review and approval controls, exception management and auditable evidence.

 - Sound regulatory judgement: ability to understand a requirement, identify its practical implications, recognise when specialist Legal or Compliance input is needed, and translate conclusions into ownership, processes and controls.

 - Strong execution discipline, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate recurring deliverables, manage interdependencies and meet fixed deadlines reliably.

 - Ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, while preserving clear accountability between functions.

 - Ability to build structured and durable ways of working—including registers, calendars, procedures, templates and knowledge bases—in an evolving environment.

 - Clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain issues, assumptions and required decisions to senior stakeholders.

 - Professional fluency in French and English.




Nice-to-have

 - Experience with ACPR reporting, supervisory interactions or the French regulatory environment.

 - Experience in a payment institution, electronic-money institution, financing company, bank, regulated fintech, supervisory authority or specialist advisory firm.

 - Exposure to more than one regulatory domain, such as payments, prudential reporting, statistical reporting, AML-CFT, fraud, incidents or financing activities.

 - Experience coordinating regulatory change, supervisory requests, inspections or remediation commitments.

 - Familiarity with regulatory-remittance tools, reporting-data lineage, workflow automation or evidence-management solutions.

 - Experience building or materially improving a regulatory framework in a new entity, licensing programme or operating-model transformation.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Laurent (1h), Compliance&Risk Director

3. Case Study with two Finance or Legal representative (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

5. Last round with Maxime and Felix (45 min) 



What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

title: Top talent wanted
description:
At lemlist, we don’t care about your fancy degrees, shiny company names and job titles.

We care about who you are, what you can bring, and how far you’re willing to go.

We believe greatness often hides in the outcasts, the underdogs, the grinders who don’t always tick the “traditional boxes”…

But people who show up, show heart, and break ceilings.

That is why we are launching the lemstar program – a talent rocket ship designed to find and elevate future stars who will shape the future of lemlist.

If you’re in the top 1% of potential, creativity, and hustle, this is your launchpad. 🚀



This is not a usual job application.



We want you to pitch us a moonshot project, something bold, original, and wildly ambitious that could 10x lemlist (or create a new revenue stream entirely).

How to apply?

 1. Think of a moonshot idea for lemlist (e.g. product, growth hack, feature, marketing campaign, new vertical, mini-tool, podcasts - whatever gets you fired up)

 2. Build a prototype, asset, or MVP, it could be a landing page, a scrappy demo or Figma, a Notion doc, anything tangible and real.

 3. Record a 5-minute elevator pitch video explaining:
    
    - The idea
    
    - The why
    
    - The impact
    
    - Your process
    
    - What’s next

No resumes. No fluff. Just raw creative fire.




WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

At lemlist, we believe the best people don't always fit into neat job titles or polished LinkedIn profiles.

We want builders, doers, the misfits, the relentless doers who turn wild ideas into real things.

 - You are young and talented — you have less than 2–3 years of experience

 - You're scrappy, resourceful, and not afraid to roll up your sleeves.

 - You've got that extra-mile mindset and are willing to show your impact since Day 1.

 - You spot opportunities where others see limits - even ones we haven't thought of yet.

 - You don't wait for permission or find excuses. You pitch, you build, you launch.

 - You're hungry to learn, resilient in the face of failure, and bounce back stronger.

 - You bring energy, originality, and heart into everything you do.

You can apply for any role across Marketing, Product, Tech, Sales, or Operations.

If you've ever been told "You don't have enough experience or the right academics," this program was made for you.

 - Real ownership from Day 1 - no babysitting, no micromanagement.

 - Let's see your moonshot first

As a Senior Product Designer at lemlist, you’ll work hand in hand with Senior Product Managers and Senior Developers across squads to deliver meaningful impact for our users. You’ll own design from problem discovery to shipping, and help shape the future of Sales tech.



You will:

 - Develop a deep understanding of our market, industry, users, company, and product vision

 - Dig beneath the surface to uncover real problems and opportunities

 - Own the delivery process with Product Managers: from discovery to launch, ensuring users feel the impact

 - Identify problems, proactively suggest improvements, and help shape the roadmap

 - Own the overall quality of the product by driving consistency, simplicity and ease of use

 - Create world-class design experiences that position lemlist as the leading software in our space

 - Be hands-on, move fast, and learn fast, whether working within a squad or shipping directly to users

 - Work and switch between multiple opportunities

 - Shape what the future of Product Design looks like (including AI)

 - Shape what the future of Sales looks like (including AI)

 - Make your role evolve based on where you believe you can create more value
   
   

We’re not looking for designers who:

 - Only deliver Figma files

 - Wait for instructions instead of being proactive

 - Are uncomfortable speaking with users or digging into real value creation

 - Don’t make user impact their priority

 - Enjoy their comfort zone

 - Spend more time in processes and complexe methodologies than bringing value to users
   
   

What’s in it for you:

 - Drive innovation in the Sales tech space

 - Work with only senior talents

 - Challenge the statut quo of the industry

 - A lot of autonomy on how your squad should thrive to be successful

 - A place where best ideas win

 - A remote friendly environment

 - A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action
   
   


KEY RESULTS


WITHIN 3 MONTHS YOU WILL HAVE:

 - Gained a deep understanding of our product, industry, and vision

 - Built relationships with lemlist users, and have a deep understanding of them

 - Owned the entire delivery process from end to end

 - Successfully created value for users


WITHIN 12 MONTHS YOU WILL HAVE:

 - Launched solutions that positively impact users and the company’s revenue

 - Established yourself as an industry expert with deep insight into our customers

 - Influenced and improved the roadmap

 - Helped shape the future of lemlist and Sales prospection
   
   


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE


MUST HAVE

 - You have 4+ years of experience in Product Design. Scale-up experience is preferred.

 - You have a big bias for action → You are a “débrouillard”, and understand the value of speed & execution

 - Strong communication skills

 - Fluency in English & French

 - Strong pragmatism and good taste for software

 - Solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms

 - Strong business acumen

 - Ability to inspire and lead teams

 - Humility, curiosity, passion and a growth mindset


NICE TO HAVE

 - Ability to easily process and synthesize information

 - Experience in Sales tech

 - High tech literacy

 - Background in Sales or Operations

 - Background in Product Management
   
   

Recruitment process

 - Interview with Victoire our Talent Acquisition Manager

 - Interview with Kévin, our VP of Product & Design

 - Interview with Mael, our CPO

 - Business Case (async.) + Live Q&A with Maël & Kevin

 - Interview with Charles, our CEO

 - Reference Check

 - Offer
   
   

We value people’s work and believe the best way to assess people is by looking at their work. Whether it's real or fake work, we don’t care. We want to see what you can ship.

If you “don’t have time” to show some of your work (even a Figma link), it’s probably not the right place for you.

ABOUT LEMLIST

lemlist is the AI-powered sales engagement platform helping sales teams build pipeline smarter, not harder.

Bootstrapped from day one, we’ve grown from 0 to $50M+ ARR in 8 years without raising a single dollar. Today, 40,000+ sales teams use lemlist to book more meetings and close more deals.

We’re building the next generation of outbound: AI-first, multi-channel, highly personalized, and deeply integrated into the way modern sales teams work.

And we’re just getting started.



This is a role on a newly structured team with a defined target ($10–15M ARR) and a playbook you'll help write. If you want a role where someone hands you a process, this isn't it. If you want to build the process - and own the results - read on.





MISSION

Historically, lemlist partners have been growth and outbound agencies running campaigns on behalf of their clients. It works, and we're not killing it. But as we move upmarket, we're building something different: a Solutions Partner motion with RevOps and CRM agencies that don't just use lemlist for clients, they implement it, train Sales teams on it, and embed it into the revenue stack.

The difference matters. When a RevOps integrator builds lemlist into a client's CRM workflows, the tool becomes infrastructure, not a vendor. Clients own it. SDRs are trained on it. When the agency offboards, lemlist stays. NRR improves, ACV goes up, and we finally have visibility into the end customer.

That's the motion you're building in the US and the UK mainly. A channel program is live, but the playbook isn't written. That's the job.



In practice, this means:

 - Hunt: prospect and qualify RevOps consultants, CRM integrators, and IT service firms that advise mid-market Sales teams. Depth over breadth.

 - Enable: onboard, certify, and arm partners with the tools, training, and co-selling support they need to close.

 - Grow: manage pipeline, track ARR with proper attribution, push for expansion within partner accounts.

 - Build: document what works. Feed insights back into the program, the pricing, the product roadmap.

You'll report to the VP of Partnerships and work closely with Sales, CS, and Growth. You're not a lone wolf, but you are the person who defines how this motion runs in your territory.




KEY RESULTS

After 1 month

 - You’ve become a lemlist  expert

 - You've mapped the US/UK Solutions Partner landscape and prioritised your first targets

 - You understand the partner IPP and dual positioning inside-out

After 3 months

 - You’ve onboarded at least 12 new Solution Partners

 - You've generated qualified pipeline through your partner base

 - You’ve built repeatable enablement and activation workflows for your markets

After 12 months

 - Your partner ecosystem is generating $1M+ in ARR/year

 - You’ve built strong relationships with top-performing partners

 - You’ve set the foundation for a world-class partner program
   
   


 SKILLS

 - 3+ years in Channel, Partnerships, or SaaS Sales with a track record of building pipeline from scratch, not just managing inherited accounts.

 - You've recruited and activated partners before. You know the difference between a signed NDA and a productive partner.

 - Strong enablement instincts: you can build a pitch deck, run a training session, and write a co-selling guide, without waiting to be asked

 - Outbound-native: comfortable prospecting into RevOps/CRM integrator firms with no inbound help on Day 1

 - CRM-fluent and data-driven: you track attribution, pipeline by partner, NRR. You surface insights, not just status updates.

 - Native or near-native English (you'll be building relationships in the US and UK). French is a plus given our geo mix.

Bonus if you have:

 - Experience in SalesTech, RevOps, or CRM ecosystems

 - You've worked with or sold to RevOps consultants, CRM integrators, or IT service firms

 - You've built a partner program before (even partially) and can show us the before/after

 - Familiarity with Partnerstack or similar PRM tooling

 - Multi-geo experience: we're live in US, UK, France, DACH, Benelux, and Nordics from Day 1
   
   


WHY JOIN NOW?

A lot of companies say “you'll have ownership here”. This one actually means it, for 3 reasons:

 - Ownership: you write the US/UK playbook. No inherited process to maintain, you build from scratch with 2 complementary products.

 - Trajectory: first hire in this function. Nail it and you’ll be able to grow with us.

 - Stage: we’re just started with Partnerships, the team is newly created. You join at the exact right moment.

The honest version: this is a high-ownership, high-accountability role at a company that moves fast and measures what matters. If you've been in a partnerships role where the motion was already built and your job was to maintain it - this will feel different. In a good way, if you're the right person.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Interview with Victoire (TAM)

 2. Discovery Call with Cindy (VP Partnerships)

 3. Business Case with Cindy & Yann (VP Sales)

 4. Informal meeting with Julia (Partnerships Manager)

 5. Interview with Charles (CEO)

title: Head of Legal
description:
ABOUT US 👇🏼

lemlist is the outbound platform for sales teams: find leads, run multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, calls), personalize with AI and book meetings.

lempire also builds lemwarm (deliverability), Claap (AI call intelligence), Taplio and Tweet Hunter.

We're at +$60M ARR, growing ~50% year over year, profitable and 100% bootstrapped, with 180 people.

We’re now moving upmarket, signing larger deals, expanding our partnerships, working with data providers, and integrating acquisitions like Claap.

Until now, all our legal work has been handled by external law firms.

We’re hiring our first Head of Legal to build and scale the function from scratch.




MISSION

Build lemlist’s legal function from scratch and help us move faster, close bigger deals, and scale without unnecessary risk



You’ll own legal across lempire, working directly with the COO, CEO, and business teams.

Your job: help us close deals faster, protect what matters, and make smart business decisions.

Commercial contracts will take ~50% of your time. The rest covers corporate, employment, privacy, M&A, and everything else a scaling SaaS group needs.

You won’t be expected to know everything. You’ll handle what you can, bring in specialists when needed.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Commercial contracts (~50%)

 - Negotiate enterprise SaaS contracts, partnerships, and key supplier agreements

 - Help Sales unblock deals and navigate complex negotiations

 - Build templates and playbooks to make standard contracts self-serve

Corporate & M&A (~20%)

 - Own corporate governance, board/shareholder decisions, BSPCE, and our US entity

 - Lead Claap’s legal integration and support future acquisitions with external counsel

Employment (~20%)

 - Partner with HR on contracts, terminations, disputes, CSE, and profit-sharing agreements

Privacy & other legal matters (~10%)

 - Oversee GDPR, data privacy, and data provider agreements with external specialists (DPO)

 - Handle T&Cs, NDAs, leases, and other legal matters

Build the legal function

 - Become the go-to person for all legal matters

 - Decide what to bring in-house vs. outsource and manage external counsel

 - Build simple, AI-first processes that scale without unnecessary bureaucracy




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Business first: You give clear recommendations, not just a list of risks

 - Full ownership: You take responsibility, even outside your core expertise

 - Bias for action: You move fast, build from scratch and automate repetitive work

 - AI-first: You use AI and modern/ tech tools daily to work smarter




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 3 months:

 - Complete a legal audit and define your priorities

 - Become the single point of contact for legal across lemlist

 - Set up legal intake, contract templates, and Sales negotiation playbooks

 - Take ownership of external counsel, corporate obligations, and ongoing employment matters

Within 12 months:

 - Reduce standard contract review turnaround to 2 business days

 - Make NDAs and standard contracts self-serve

 - Bring recurring legal work in-house and optimize external counsel spend

 - Ensure corporate governance runs smoothly

 - Build a scalable legal function that helps the business move faster




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must have

 - 6+ years of legal experience, including significant in-house experience in a tech startup, scale-up, or SaaS company.

 - Strong expertise in B2B SaaS contracts and commercial negotiations

 - Business judgment: you understand trade-offs and recommend solutions, not just flag risks

 - Builder mindset: autonomous, hands-on, pragmatic

 - Comfortable owning unfamiliar legal topics and working with specialists

 - Fluent French and English (French law, international customers/ employees)

Nice to have

 - First or sole legal hire experience

 - US entity / international contracts

 - Employment law, GDPR, or buy-side M&A experience

We don’t need someone who knows every area of law; we need someone who knows how to get things done.




WHY JOIN LEMPIRE?

 - Build it your way: First legal hire, full ownership, direct access to COO/CEO

 - Front-row seat to $200m ARR SaaS: Enterprise sales, international expansion, M&A, AI

 - Real impact: Your work directly influences growth, risk, and business decisions

 - Speed over bureaucracy: Profitable, bootstrapped, ambitious




RECRUITMENT PROCESS

 1. Interview with Victoire (TA Lead)

 2. Interview with Oriane (COO)

 3. Business case (Contract negotiation & business judgment)

 4. Interviews with Sales & Partnerships Leaders

 5. Final interview with Charles (CEO)

 6. Reference checks & offer

title: Account Executive

TEAM

We pride ourselves on being a small, committed team of highly autonomous individuals. We value excellence, hard work and autonomy.

WHY JOIN DITTO

We pride ourselves on being a small, committed team of highly autonomous individuals. We value excellence, hard work, and autonomy. Join us to:

🌈 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe Marketing Digital, vous accompagnerez le développement de notre visibilité en ligne et contribuerez à des projets innovants autour des contenus, de l’optimisation de notre site et de l’intelligence artificielle
🌿✨ Vos missions au quotidien
• Participer à l’amélioration de la performance de notre site web : qualité des contenus, organisation des pages, parcours utilisateur.

• Aider à la structuration, la révision et la valorisation de nos contenus (produits, articles, tutoriels…).

• Analyser les performances de certains contenus et proposer des pistes d'amélioration.

• Contribuer au développement de notre image de marque en ligne.

• Participer à des projets d’innovation autour de l’intelligence artificielle : assistants de rédaction, exploration de solutions IA pour la production ou la relecture de contenus, agents IA d'automatisation de tâches répétitives, etc.

• Assister à la coordination de projets transverses mêlant technique, rédaction, marketing et automatisation

Ce stage est conçu pour un(e) candidat(e) curieux(se), polyvalent(e), avec une appétence pour le web, la donnée, l’innovation et la communication digitale.

• Etudiant(e) Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur ou de commerce), avec une forte capacité d’apprentissage et un esprit analytique.

• Excellente maîtrise du français écrit (syntaxe, clarté, rigueur).

• Anglais courant.

• Intérêt marqué pour le web, les outils numériques et la communication en ligne.

• Bon esprit d’analyse, sens critique, capacité à structurer l’information.

• Connaissances de base en informatique (HTML, scripts, etc.).

• Intérêt pour la gestion de projet et l’automatisation de tâches.

• Goût pour la découverte de nouveaux outils (intelligence artificielle, outils no-code, plateformes web, etc.).

• Connaissances en SEO et / ou GEO.
